Name: Manas Maheshwari
review: College life at VIT Bhopal isn't as good as you may see in most other colleges. This is due to a lot of restrictions and regulations. But there are surely a lot of good things which make college life here liveable like regular fests, activities, etc. 'AdVITya' is the annual fest that happens every year around February. Apart from this, various minor fests are organized regularly. Most clubs are pretty active and keep organizing meetings, workshops, etc almost every week. The library isn't very big but you'll find all the necessary books and a nice studying environment there. Classrooms are beautiful with modern infrastructure and furniture. Talking about sports, you can play Basketball, Cricket, Volleyball, Football, Table Tennis & Badminton here. Many sports tournaments are held regularly and winners are awarded. The campus offers you not only academic opportunities but also a lot of extra-curricular options to explore. Students often build projects like VITB Mess App that help fellows.I was interested in the functioning of computers and subjects like artificial intelligence, development, etc. Hence I opted for BTech. in Computer Science & Engineering at VIT Bhopal. The course curriculum here is updated and future ready. All faculty are Ph.D. holders with a lot of experience. Most of them are friendly enough and help us with our problems and doubts. There are around 70 students in a class hence the faculty: student ratio is decent. VIT Bhopal has implemented the Caltech learning method which helps students learn more efficiently. There are 2 major examinations per semester namely MidTerm Examinations and EndTerm Examinations. These exams aren't very difficult to pass. There is a relative grading system so your grades depend on the class average.

review:

Name: Kiriti

Name: Diptorshi Tripathi
review: Life at VIT is good. The campus infrastructure is great, and there are a lot of good people in-campus as well. VIT hosts an annual fest called VITOPIA, which usually takes place in the month of April, and a tech fest called VTAPP, which takes place around November-December. They're usually very huge fests and fetch a lot of attention. The libraries are vast, with loads of on-topic and out of topic books available to rent and return. All classrooms are equipped with projectors and whiteboards, and almost all classrooms seat 70-80 students, other than the gallery classrooms, which seat 150 students. There are a lot of extra curricular activites on the campus. Besides a massive football court and cricket field, there are two basketball courts, a tennis court, a volleyball court, a badminton court, and a squash room. Coaches come regularly to teach arts like karate and boxing too. There are several clubs in here as well, and opting for a technical club (like CSI or ACM) gives you credits.The fees are divided into three sections- Hostel accommodation, Tuition fees, and a caution deposit. Hostel accommodation is always optional, and students can opt to stay outside the hostel in the nearing city as well. Hostel fees depend on the number of beds you wish for in your room(2 or 4), or if you want a dormitory, and if you need an AC or a non-AC room. It also depends on whether you want a vegetarian, non vegetarian or a special mess(non vegetarian with juices, fruits and sweets.) Tuition fees entirely depends on the course you have opted for, and also the category you have attained based on the competitive examination that you have written in order to get into the college. For instance, for BTECH-CSE core, a student will have to pay 1.5 lakhs per annum over a period of 4 years in college through category 1, 2.5 lakhs for category 2, 3.5 lakhs for cat 3 and so on. There is a finance manager in the campus itself, and he takes care of any queries regarding finances.

review:

There are clubs for all kinds of hobbies you would like to pursue in college. 
The annual fest of IIT(ISM), Dhanbad is called SRIJAN, it's the biggest socio-cultural fest of eastern India and the tech fest is called CONCETTO. Also, we have KHANAN, Asia's largest geo-mining fest. TAKSHAK is also a tech-fest for deep-sea mining.I am currently pursuing a B.Tech degree in the Department of Mechanical Engineering. I am currently in the second semester, so a common course is going on for all freshers. The complete new admissions are divided into 8 sections and each consists of students between 130-140. Later, in the second-year students will study as per their respective department courses.
All the faculty members are doctorates and are highly qualified, but that doesn't mean they all are brilliant teachers. Some profs are boring but in college, you need to adjust, and you need to study by yourself.
We have our mid-semester exams after 2 months of semester start and then end semester exams after 2 months of mid-sem. You can ace a nice grade by studying hard a week before exams but for topper grades like a 9+ GPA, you need to study 15-20 days before exams.

Name: Vaibhav Seth
college: SRM Institute of Science and Technology - [SRMIST]
review:
SRM is popular for its education and placement.
I choose CEE because there is much to be coming in this field.
There is a huge opportunity to be successful in this course.
Faculty in SRM are highly qualified and there are surely reachable to all of us.The fee structure is around 400000 tuition fee and 150000 for the hostel and mess.
Many interesting internships are offered.
You'll get a scholarship if you occupy a specific rank in the SRMJEEE test.
Easily accessible structure.

Name: Rahul
review: Faculty members are very good people. I choose this course because I have a very deep interest in this stream. Faculty members are very good and all members are well educated. All faculty members are graduated. Term exams in my college are done every 6 months. There is no difficulty to pass exams.Fees structure of my college is medium everyone can pay easily opportunity of Scholarships are also available in my college there are many scholarships available for students like ST/SC/OBC you can easily available jobs on campus with high-paying packages.

Name: Chyan Nagpal
review:
I have choose this course because I have some interest in it and my sister also opted for this course and now she is an engineer. 
Faculity members are good here as they help us if we have any problem they tell us. Student ratio: there are 75 students in each class and we have the sections from A to L.
All the faculty members are qualified with Ph.D. and masters in their teaching subject.
Teaching is good if we have some doubts we can ask them freely.
We have our exams 2 times in a semester and they are bit a difficult to pass.It's our college main fest held in a year and tech fests held like tech wizards, ACM, etc. 
The availability of books in the library is quite good as there is no problem asking for books and journals and also there is discipline in library.
Sports and extracurricular activities are quite not good in our college but the small events held.
Social groups like NSS and NCC are the groups, and clubs available run by the students, and the websites available that our ERP portal is available by searching our college.

Name: Abhishek
review: I was highly interested in tech related branches but due to my low rank in jee mains, I couldn't get cse related branches. The teachers are highly qualified even though some of them are Ph.D. holders. Exams are held as per the university schedule.As per engineering fees right now this college takes minimal fees for this degree. But even if any student is unavailable to give this fee scholarship is offered on the basis of the patient's annual income. The fee for my course is only 170000.

Name: Harshit Mohan
review:
I chose ECE over AIML as my father and family members have experience in this field and they told me to go with ECE as it will have an extra edge in the future.
The faculty-student ratio is extremely good here as there are different teachers for different subjects in different branches and there's no same faculty teaching two branches.
Maximum teachers here are Ph.D. from IITs and foreign universities, their teaching methods are modern too as they teach using ppts, etc.
Exams are always timely here, however, syllabus completion is tough as we are in a short semester due to Covid, and also papers are not set easily, they are tough to pass. Everyone coming here must make his/her mind clear about studies because they will have to study very hard to get a good GPA.Campus life is peace. Weather and natural beauty are all pros here.
Bitotsav is the Annual fest conducted in February every year at BIT Mesra. Tech Fest till now has not happened so I don't know about that.
The library is very large and has all the books you would want to study so I can't say anything much about it.
Sports and extracurricular activities are being promoted here as there are different clubs for all the extracurricular activities.
I'm also a member of Dhwani - The music club at BIT Mesra.
There are many clubs like I can say whatever be your interest, you will find its club here for sure.
Location is what is the only one and biggest negative of this college. Ranchi is 13kms away from Mesra and Mesra is literally a village town.

Name: Ashutosh soni
college: Poornima Institute of Engineering  and Technology - [PIET]
review:
The campus life is not that much interesting according to my personal view.
But there are many cultural and technical events being organized on college campuses.
AAROHAN which is the greatest cultural fest of our college held in March. At this event, many sports activities have been done. During day time all the other activities like sports, drama, pot-making competitions, fashion shows, etc take place and during evening hours many famous Bollywood celebrities were invited to the college to make the evening full of fun.
Another event like AADHAR which is a technical fest in which every student must have to participate and represent their technical skills.AADHAR is conducted by the student group called ZERCON CLUB. 
There are many clubs in the college and the students can choose any of them according to their willings.The basic course curriculum is based on RTU based as it is an RTU-affiliated college.
 The student faculty ratio is approximately 1:20 which is quite good enough according to me.
Mostly all the faculty members are Ph.D. holders or have a degree in MTech.
There are two mid-term examinations in each semester before every RTU examination which are conducted an approximate period of 1.5-2 months.

Name: Krish Raj Anand
review:
Annual are conducted every year with big celebrities and stand-up comedians visiting, tech fests are also conducted as one of the biggest fests in India, many societies make drones and participate in or organize these fests.
There are 10 lakh books in the library they are issued on events free of cost and on non occasion days they are to be paid to issue them, which is a nominal charge. Classrooms like pragyabhwan and SPS are fully air-conditioned, and projectors to charging points in the classroom are available. There are many sports along with their team and ground facilities like 2 basketball courts 2 tennis courts, 2 kabaddi courts 1 cricket,1 football, and indoor sports like badminton and table tennis. Many colleges like bits Goa, nit's IIT's sports teams come to compete with college sports teams. There are over 100 societies in college giving immense opportunities to participate in fest competitions with cash prizes and exposure.The fees of college are really high as compared to other colleges and it rises every year by 10,000.
Colleges have divided their scholarships one get from college other from the Delhi government those having ration cards will get 100% scholarship and in college this year the scholarship was given to those students having a family annual income of less than 2 lakh, district scholarship is for that annual income less than 8 lahks those get 25% of tuition fees however the amount came in the bank after 1 year or more than that. The top 10% students of in college get 10k per month. There are internships even for 1st-year students they are just government programs like lab on Wheels with very less stipend, the real internship come for 3rd-year students and sometimes for 2nd year however a minimum of 8 cgpa is required to be eligible, and an academic need to keep in mind while doing the internship there after most students get the placement.

Name: Gayathri
review:
I choose this course because I had intrest in it. And now a days there are plenty af opportunities in software companies.
The faculty in my clg is better but not best.The students and the faculty ratio was 50prct
The qualification of many faculty is mtech. The teaching was not good enough.The JNTU exams was very tough mainly the paper correction is very tough. If we write the exam very good also we get less marks, and sometimes we fail also. The correction was very badThere is library in clg. All the books are available to the students.
The college environment was good. The fest is conducted awesome In the month of April or May fest is conducted.
Before conducting fest the sports will be conducted between the courses in clg. A championship battle is taken place among the students. It was very nice.

Name: Abhishek Purty
review: The social life here is quite amazing and engrossing with abundance of clubs to make up for the time after our classes.Dhwani being the music club organises a main event Naad each year.Then there are clubs like Firebolt racing and Team Srijan which have built their own buggy and formula racing cars respectively and have won races too.The companies start visiting the college from the 3rd year onwards.I'd love to get myself an internship as I love the mechanical engineering branch immensely.Also I feel quite inclined towards clubs like Firebolt racing and team Srijan they, according to me, are a must have experience for everyone who loves building stuff.

Name: Aditya Pandey
review: Civil engineering provides a huge opportunity in the government job domain which is the foremost reason I chose it. The first-year course will be the same for everyone irrespective of the branch. Exams are moderate but subjects like  BASIC ELECTRICAL ENGINEERING AND BASIC ELECTRONIC COMMUNICATION ENGINEERING should be taken seriously. The faculties are well-qualified.The campus is very large but mainly trees and vegetation. Campus Life is good but not much good. Bitotsav is the annual fest and is generally organized in January or February. The Library is the best part which is rich, you can avail all the books required. Classrooms are equipped with projectors, AC, and comfortable chairs.

Name: Abhishek Chaurasia
college: Chitkara Institute of Engineering and Technology - [CIET]
review:
I'd choose BECSE  because at chitkara University the campus recruitment is very good and big companies come and give chances for internships also

Name: Ritika Budhiraja
college: Dr. Akhilesh Das Gupta Institute of Technology & Management - [ADGITM]
review: The college keeps on updating the students regarding all the scholarship forms released but no as such special fee waiver is provided by the University. Tech will be completed.The Course curriculum is pretty much nice as it is the same for all streams of B. Tech in the first year and allows every student to have a basic knowledge of every stream. particularly speaking for the CSE branch, we have particular specialized labs for Various fields like AI, ML, etc..

Name: Divyansh
review:
The campus life at BIT Mesra is very good.

The hostel fee is around 40,000 per year and the mess fee is also the same.
You can grab GP Birla Scholarship if you score above 9 CGPA.

Name: Manas salunkhe
review: The life at the campus is so nice the cs amps are filled with different tones to do and some nice canteens also which have great taste and it also has a playground which needs to be improved the college has many social groups Too.The fee structure is simple the college takes the demand draft and cash is also taken the college also provides scholarships like MAHA DBT and also college scholarships and the college also gives opportunities for campus jobs

Name: Aryan Chauhan

They are very good for self-improvement

Name: Sameer Tomar
review:
I choose this course because I like to study about diodes, semiconductors, and many types of circuits  The faculty student ratio is very much better then in other colleges in the same area All the teachers are highly qualified and faculty is very helpful All the exams are conducted on the time given by the universityThe cost of the course is acceptable because the faculty provides you with all the things you need for your projects and study purpose
There are many scholarships available for low-income grades and according to your marks in competitive exams

review:

Name: Umang
college: IIT Jammu - Indian Institute of Technology - [IITJ]
review:
We got a cultural fest in the month of March ending and a tech-fest in April starting and the library got plenty of books and journals
There are too many classrooms apart from studies including the other activities it also got interdepartmental sports competition called pravaah and other activities such as inter-department dance competitions and even farewell sports matches with seniors too there are many clubs run by our college and students like coding, robotics, dance sports, nature and adventure, photography, kritash(for donation), astronomy.Due to my rank, I choose this course faculty student ratio is good about 1:50. We used to have an average of total 4 class tests in 1 semester and 1 mind sem and 1 end sem exams were not that much difficult we are able to score good decent marks

Name: Indrakant jha
review: Campus life is best. As the campus is about 780 acres of which 3 to 5 % area is covered through infrastructure. There is a huge sports complex with full facilities and anyone can play according to their choice. There are 35 clubs and all of them are highly laborious and due to that the connections and alumni network becomes strong.The best according to my rank I chose the chemical branch as per my interest. Faculty are sufficient and proper in their field accordingly. They have a good sort of experience in teaching like 10 +yrs of experience. Teaching is on point and a tutorial class is conducted once a week for the doubt solving

Name: Suraj
review: I choose B. Tech CSE because I was interested in it there are specializations here like gaming tech, IOT data science, and cybersecurity too, the no. of faculty is pretty good over here, and there is no change in teachers frequently it is compatible for students to get taught by a teacher the whole semester and the teacher here are pretty qualified most of them are the Ph.D. holder or even double Ph.D. holders you will have 2 internal exams 4 class text and 1 final exam each semester it is pretty easy if you just pay attention over the class you will surely score good marksAfter 6th semester you will be eligible for placements, there are a lot of companies, visiting here most of them are mass recurring companies but if you are good at studies and passionate about computer science you will get a lot of opportunities during placements, highest on-campus package was 34 lakhs according to college. 90% get placements but it should be near 70%. I plan to go off-campus because I think it will be easier to crack a good package off-campus.

Name: Ramendra Priyanshu
review:
The college provides various courses in B.Tech, IMsc, BBA, BHMCT, BArch, and BCA.
The college primarily focuses on B.Tech courses and has various branches of this course. It offers Biotechnology, CSE, AIML, EEE, ECE, Chemical, Mechanical, Production, and Civil. The faculties are always available to help. The ratio of faculty and students are good.The fee structure is quite hefty as it ranges up to Rs 17,00,000.
The mess fee is around Rs 20,000 per semester and after 4 years you will find that your total expenses have crossed over 20 lakh. Scholarship offered here is only GP Birla which is provided to the students who score over 9CGPA which is quite difficult.

Name: Satyam
review: There is an Annual program that is held once a year in the month of April and also there are big and small events going on around every 2 weeks people here are very interested in organising such events. There is a good library with the availability of books of every sort. The classrooms are well-maintained and air-conditioned. There are decent levels of sports and extracurricular activities in the university with professional coaches. Some of the clubs are Ninad, Natraj, Codeblocks, and GFG which are actively working on events.I am interested in coding so I choose this course. The teacher-to-student ratio. Most of the first year's teachers have done master's or PhD. The teachers have a very good concept of the subjects and they convey them well. The exams are accordingly to the date sheet and they are easy to medium-level exams

Name: Atul Pal
review:
The course curriculum of ECE is mid-on toughness in the first year as the year passing is going to be more difficult as compared to CSE, IT, and software.
Faculty members of ECE, majority of them are good and very professional as a teacher but some are just coming and wasting time so avoid such classes and utilize that time in your upscaling.
This course is the best and evergreen sort because it allows me to go for tech and non-tech placements, it gives me the freedom to choose whatever I am interested in whereas many branches have high placements but they are rigid in their job profiles.
Exams were difficult in mid-sems as compared to the end sem.Campus Life is amazing as the college has so much greenery and beautiful infrastructure and very huge campus.
Fests are an integral part which is enjoyed by the students, recently I experienced a fest moksha. Big stars like divine came and perform.
Books are in abundance but some books always short in the college.
There are lots of societies run by students according to their interest in one particular thing.If that thing is facinates you join and take that forward.

Name: Utkarsh chaudhary
review:
Unifest is the biggest fest in north India which holds every year at my college before the season of monsoon. An ample amount of books and e-books are available in the library. Classes of the college are air-conditioned, but the ac doesn't work through the season.
Ac works only in lab classes. Sports and other extracurricular activities frequently take place at university. E cell, noticed and many more clubs are run by the students of the university.Student gets eligible from 7 semesters for placement. According to records Around 600+ companies visited the campus and hired students average package offered was? 5.5 lakhs per annum Highest package on record is? 44 lakhs and the average package is ? 5.5 lakhs. Around 70% of students got placements. My plan after getting my degree is to join the Indian air force as a flying officer.

Name: abhinav singh
review:
As we all know NSUT is the top most govt college but according to me, its fees are very high. it is unaffordable for the middle-class family.
As it is a govt college its fees should be less so that becomes easier for everyone to study in this college without the burden of student loans.I am in the ECE department and I am very happy with it because it is a tech branch ..and all the faculty members in nsut are hardworking and always try to give you the best. I am very happy with all. prof. always give their best and that's why they are very strict.

Name: Harsh Kumar
review:
Campus Life is just awesome there are various societies in the college run by the seniors of the college in which students participate and excel in their field and make it open to all so that each gets a chance to overcome the fear of communication skills, hesitation to talk, etc. Our college has MOKSHA fest which is next level held every year in which students enjoy their best and get relax from the daily college routines.Students are eligible in the 7th semester for placements. Microsoft, Adobe, Google, Paytm, Phonepay, Bheema, Sprinkler, TCS, Deloitte, Samsung, NVidia, etc. are the top recruiters of the college which makes a lot of offers for different roles SDE1, SDE2, Web Developer, Data Scientist, etc.
90% of the students get placed every year by the campus. My plan is to get placed on campus placement.

Name: Shreeyansh Mittal
review: The college fees is quite affordable considering the fees of other private colleges. The students can avail of scholarship opportunities provided at the e-district scholarship portal. But there are some constraints on the applicant as to who can apply regarding the family income and all.The college has a nice track of placements till now. The average package was around 7-8 lacs per annum, whereas for CS branches it was around 9-10 lacs per annum. The internship and placement department is very helpful and active for the betterment of the students.

Name: Atul Sharma
review:
Sports facilities are not good, but fests take place around every month. There are many different types of games on campus like football, badminton, cricket, kabaddi, etc.
There are different social groups and clubs also such as Geeks for Geeks, GDSC, and Zircon.Placement is around 65% of btech students. Placement are given from the 7th semester and the average package is around 450000 per annum.
The highest package offered in this College is 3500000.
Internships are also provided at this College.

Name: Student (Anonymous)
college: Babu Banarasi Das Northern India Institute of Technology - [BBDNIIT]
review: The campus life of BBD is good as well. Babu Banarasi Das (BBD) has a big campus consisting of one university (BBD university), and other 3 colleges (BBDNIIT, BBDITM, BBDEC) affiliated with AKTU. We have college uniforms to wear except for the university. There is a stadium (Dr Akhilesh Das Gupta Stadium), Auditorium, Nescafe, 2 separate canteens, a photocopy shop and a temple inside its campus. BBD also provides a bus facility for local students for 30k per month as well. In front of BBD one can find everything one can need .. there is Crown Mall (which has a cinema), and a complex with restaurants and shops for stationery and stuff. The infrastructure of BBDNIIT is again like a school. But it is well maintained and one can find all greenery around.I am from CSE branch and first year has chemistry, physics, maths, electronics, electrical, etc. To be honest course and faculty you find in BBDNIIT is like the one you find when one is his/her school days. This thing can be look both an advantage and a disadvantage. But i take it as an advantage, having a school environment makes me feel that i am able to concentrate more and able to reach my faculty members more freely . All the faculty are well known about thier subject and help whenever needed. For the disadvantage, well you have to sit and do classes and would be asked why when not attending classes as its just 40 students per class

Name: Yuvraj Mehta
review: I was highly interested in studying computers and want to learn much about computers so I choose this field. Faculty are highly qualified and possess great knowledge of the subject. Many of the teachers are PhD professors and exams are held as per the schedule.The fees of the college are quite impressive as your whole course fee cost you under 7 LPA. Also, financially sound students are provided with scholarships based on their parent's income. Our college also offers on-campus placement.

Name: Ashutosh Sharma
review:
The campus life is not that much interesting as I think so. The class environment is not much interesting or updated. However, there are many technical as well as cultural events held on campus.
AAROHAN which is the greater cultural fest of our college held in March. At this event, many sports activities have been done. During day time all the other activities like sports, drama, quizzes, etc. take place and during evening hours many famous Bollywood celebrities were invited to the college to make the evening full of fun and enjoyment.
Another event like AADHAR which is a technical fest in which every student from every branch must have to participate and represent their technical skills. AADHAR is conducted by the student group called ZERCON CLUB.

Many others multinational companies like Amazon, Accenture, Flipkart, Genus, etc. come up seeking employees for their companies.
If someone is very good in academics performance can easily get a placement of about 20-30 lakh per annum.

Name: Sahil khan
review:
I interested in Maths. So I took maths in my 12th so I decided to give Jee main exam and then take admission in NUST. 1st semester ended too early only in 3 months. Senior Professors are good but not Ph.D. and MTech faculty. Many students failed exams.
Senior faculty had completed their Ph.D. Too much pressure on students in 1st semester. Should give more time for 1st semester. Most of the teachers are good. Colleges should follow all regulations that they write in the prospectus. College is good but management is not so good. Teachers are helpful. The exam level is soo good you have to prepare for it otherwise you will fail the exam. There are CTs, mid-sem, and end-sem examinations in the college. And we have to pass in overall. And in theory, and practical exams separately. Midsem of 15 and 25 marks and end sem of 40 and 50 marks. To pass exams and soo hard but to get a good CGPA is hard.The fees of college are too much for the middle-class family cannot afford the fees. Although many scholarships  are available for the students who belong to the category.
Total fees are 9 lakh 38 thousand excluding hostel fees. There are too many hostel fees.

Name: Teja
review:
Every year hundreds of companies visit your campus to recruit freshers in their companies. It’s, in fact, a matter of pride for students to get selected while being on campus.

Nowadays, companies are more demanding when it comes to campus placement drives.I choose a course because in future the software sector is developing so more jobs we can get.

Name: Arsalan

 You will get approximately every book needed for your study in the college Library.

review: I chose this course because I have an interest in computer science and for my bright future also. The faculty of this is very well educated. Name: Student (Anonymous)
review:
Frankly, I chose this course becoz of rank and also ECE is best after tech branches and I didn't want to go into tech branches. The best thing is we have 3 paths ie core, tech, and a consultancy where big 4 companies like Deloitte also recruit.

Name: CHAITANYA

Name: Harsh Pravin Udgave

Name: Adarsh Prajapati
review:

Our college has clubs like a reflex beta which is our dance club, euphony which is our music club, robodarshan which is our robotics club, catharsis which is our photography club, codifies our coding club and also there are clubs for many other things like volleyball, badminton, basketball etc. There are two big grounds called the Oval and The Lords named after famous cricket stadiums and it has courts for cricket, basketball, and volleyball inside it.Each year the number of visiting companies is increasing and also almost every student will be placed by the end of their period. 95% is the placement percentage for our batch and a minimum of 90% is guaranteed every year.

•One can attend any number of companies as long as they are applying for a better job than they previously got so that every student gets the opportunity to get placed.

Name: Arjun
review: Usually, you can sit for placement in the 4th year but you can grab a PPO in 3 Rd year during internships. Name: Manya Taneja
review:

Name: Priyanshu

review: In this college, mostly computer science students are found. I choose BTech from CS also because I have so much interest in coding and job opportunities in this field are very high. Teachers are very knowledgeable and their teaching method is understandable by everyone. The student ratio is not good. Girls in this college are quite low. But if you studied well, no need to worry about the exams. you can easily pass them.The placement in this college is very low. The average package is 10 LPA. Companies that visit the college are Infosys, HCL, Samsung etc. After getting the degree I will give interviews at various companies to find a good job or I will look for an internship in my 4th year.

Name: Anagh Verma
review:
I've Taken Electronica and communication Engineering keeping in mind the potential of its rise.
Every faculty member is supposed to manage 70 students(at max, but on average each class has 50-55 students).
Each professor holds a Ph.D., being a master's in his field. So you can expect in-depth knowledge from your professors.
The exam pattern is as follows: 2internal written exams (CATs), followed by one lab exam (lab-FAT), ending the semester with a FAT exam. Along with quizzes and assignments going along
Scoring a decent grade is easy as you are given multiple opportunities to maintain your score.There is no fee hike between your 4 years of study, the amount allotted to you at the time of admission remains constant. The cost varies on your VITEEE rankings.
People scoring high enough to get into 1st fee category get a 50% concession in fee, and the fee rises by a certain amount along every category.
The above is for the tuition fee, after that, you need to pay for the hostel and mess fee. Every hostel has a fixed amount depending upon the occupancy of that room and the type (AC/non-AC), except 2 Blocks (Q/R, as they offer apartment-type rooms).

Name: AMMANABROLU CHETAN SHANKAR

Name: Aditya Raj
review: LPU has a dedicated internship cell at the university to help students avail of internship opportunities. The internship cell at LPU provides students with a platform to explore the world of internship opportunities available to them. The internship cell works to provide students with access to the best opportunities available, including both paid and unpaid internships. Multinational companies like Google, Intel, Microsoft, L&T, IBM, Pega, Bosch, CISCO, Siemens, Cadence, Texas Instruments, Dell EMC, CompTIA, Vmware IT Academy, PEGA, Automation Anywhere, ASSOCHAM GEN, Informatica, NSE Academy, Cooper Surgical, Aitodesk, WileyNXT, Virtusa, Safeducate, Bioclues Organization, Hughes, Xebia, Transorg, GeeksforGeeks, Tech Mahindra, etc. have setup their Centres of Excellence at LPU, where students get an opportunity to get trained by them from inside the campus.There are many fests being conducted here. Recently the 'Oneworld' fest was conducted where students in lpu from various parts of India and the world represented their areas. Another tech fest of 3 days 'technocean' was also organized recently for the students where they could attend workshops, participate in coding competitions, and so on. There is a huge central library with 5 floors which has many books inside. The classroom environment is good with strict rules. There are many grounds, where we can have our extracurricular activities. Almost all sorts of games are being played here. There are many clubs of various types being run by the students where u can be a member as well. But the rules inside are very strict and the security guards sometimes can be really annoying.

review: We have two annual fests in our college, one is a technical fest called Gravitas, and the other is a cultural fest called Riviera. The fests are very well organized and they call a lot of big-name celebrities in our fests. Our library is the best I have seen in my whole life. It seems like there are billions of books in there and it has a great silent study environment. All the classrooms are equipped with smartboards and all labs have the latest technology equipment. We can play all the popular sports here on campus and there are gyms available as well. There are also more than 100 clubs and chapters where your seniors guide and train you to gain more skills.I always had an interest in CSE since the 10th grade when I was first properly introduced to coding I always had a keen interest in statistics so I chose the specialization of Data Science which is an emerging field. The faculty-student ratio is about 15:1. The faculties are very well qualified and have a lot of knowledge however, there are obviously a few exceptions and some are really bad teachers. We have term exams at the end of each semester and we have our continuous assessment tests almost every 45 days, however up until now, I have found them relatively easy as you can study only one night in advance and still get decent marks.

Name: Aishwarya Shaji
review: The annual fest called Vibrance is conducted around the end of February to the first week of March. It is a 3 day classy event with weeks of pre-events. The technical fest is called TECHNOVIT and it is held in September. Several other small events, workshops and functions are celebrated by the college as well as the clubs and chapters throughout the year. The Central Library which is a lavish 3-floor separate building has abundant books and journals which are always organised and easily accessible and can be borrowed with easy steps. There is also an e-library which expands the availability of books. The classrooms are equipped with projectors and speakers which the professors most often make use of during lectures. Sports and extracurriculars are given great exposure in college. There are professional teams who compete at the state and nationally in several sports and co-curricular. The VITC Instagram page is a platform to get familiar with the college and can also find the other groupsI chose this course due to my pre-existing background in AI and ML and also considering the future scope of the department in technology. The student-to-professor ratio is pretty well balanced; a single professor might have multiple or single batches in a semester depending on the subjects and each batch has a maximum of 70 students. The professors in this college are highly reputed for being highly qualified. Every professor is highly research-oriented and they keenly focus on practical learning along with the theory sessions in every subject. We are provided an academic calendar well before the start of every semester and it is followed to the date. The exams are conducted on the same days as mentioned in the calendar (the subjects depend on the student's own slots). We were taught enough and provided with plenty materials to study and as long as one is thorough with what their professor suggests, it is relatively easy to score a good average.

Name: Dasaroju Sarika
review: I have joined the course computer science and Engineering (data science). Name: Akash Kumar
college: Chaibasa Engineering College, Techno India Group
review:
I was interested in studying b.tech in computer science and engineering and learning about computer machines and their software so I opted for studying at chaibasa engineering college.
 In chaibasa engineering college the faculty-to-student ratio is very nice as here it's 1 teacher with over 40 students and the teacher can clarify every student's doubts and can also interact with everyone.
Here the teacher is also highly qualified with having P.hd in a particular field and many have done masters from IITs. The teaching style of the teachers is fabulous and explains very complex topics very easily and tries to reach every student's doubts.
during our first semester curriculum, the college took two main internal assessment exams which were what we were taught in the class and the difficulty level was moderate.The course fee for b.tech in chaibasa engineering college is very minimal if come through Jceceb counselling and having reservation benefits and which nearly goes upto  Rs 22000/- per year without availing the benefit of tuition fee waiver ( TFW) and on applying through (TFW) it goes upto Rs 13000/- per year.
The students can also get the benefit of a scholarship through the state of JHARKHAND for those who are listed under reservation. The college also invites many companies for internship and students can grab the opportunity from the first year onward if have the required skills.

Name: Deepti kumari
college: Chaibasa Engineering College, Techno India Group
review:
Life on campus is interesting. Sometimes it is fun and sometimes stressful. 
Two fests are celebrated in our college named tech fest named NAVKRITI and the cultural fest named ZEPHYR.

It was not difficult to pass but was difficult to get good marks.

Name: shruti kumari mahato
college: Chaibasa Engineering College, Techno India Group
review: The fee structure is moderate and the opportunity for scholarships is average. There are chances of internships. But the opportunities for scholarships could be improved. Name: Neeraj Modi
college: Chaibasa Engineering College, Techno India Group
review:
I preferred Mechanical Engineering at this college because the previous year's placements records were pretty good and of my personal interests also.

Name: Dhrutin gami

Name: Vaibhav
review:

Name: Vaishnavi
college: IIT Delhi - Indian Institute of Technology [IITD]
review: There are a lot of clubs at IIT. Students can do any extra curriculum activities in which they are interested. One of the largest fests is conducted in IITD called RDV every year. review: The name of our annual first is the fresher party and the tech fest is not held yet they are conducted three to four months after starting the course. There are a lot of books available in the library. The last day of the week is reserved as a sports day and sports meet is held at the end of every year between different departments of the college.I have chosen the course because I want to learn about modern technology. And to learn about the activities performed in the constitutional areas. The qualifications of our faculty are that they have done m.tech in civil engineering. The timely exams are held for a time duration of 6 months and it is not much difficult to pass.

Name: Raghawendra Dev Pathak
review: I am a student of ece in msit pursuing in first year and I am very satisfied with the course and teachers of the college and even with the seniors. teachers and well experienced and skilled with experience of more than 10 yrs. They complete the syllabus before time and also help us during exam preparation.Total fees of course are 5.5 lacs with Max fees for a sem being 85k and min fees for a sem being 64k twf category students may pay half of that. national and state government scholarships are available for financially weaker section students and students' credit card option is also open.

Name: Chaitanya Gohar
review:
The annual fest of bpit is malhar which is conducted in November and the techno-cultural fest is CORONA
The books in the library are mostly related to the subjects of the course provided. Very few journals are in the library
The classrooms are quite big and have proper ventilation. Amenities of the classroom are fans, projector, etc
The social life is good in bpit. The seniors are very Intractactive and guide their juniors kindly. Our campus is raging free.I wanted to learn coding skills and explore the online world that's why I chose to engineer in computer science. The ratio of faculty and students is good enough. Most teachers of core subjects have done PhD in their field and others also have done masters in their field. As the admission process for engineering was late in 2022 because of the delay in jee exam, we only got a semester of 4 months which has less time. The exam difficulty was moderate.

Name: Harshal Hemaraj Baviskar
college: SSVPS's Bapusaheb Shivajirao Deore College of Engineering
review: I chose this course for computer in engineering university because computer engineering gives a good package and the future is good there are good teachers and classes and good teaching after that Semester end exams are very tough and guys study hard to pass. There is a semester of four months in which there are two exams  CA1 and CA2. And the important thing is a mid-semester exam and end-semester exam.From the third year the student remains eligible for placement for campus interview. After TCS, many big companies come to the college Too many students of our college get placements in TCS Highest package has gone beyond 30 lakhs of our college The higher the CGP, the better the package, the more important the skill, Master graduation i.e intake is also available in our college so I plan to do MTech

Name: ABHISHEK YADAV
review:
In the case of fest and co-curricular activities it is not good as we expected because they are hardly providing any fest in even year also
The availability of books in the library is decent we can get books there but not all but yes we can go to the library and study there in peace
As for sports we have our ground and sports complex which is still in the construction phase and will be completed soon and we have several sports clubs also.

As for social groups and clubs we have.

For Coding-Fractal
 These clubs are mainly run by studentsAs for the course in chemical Engineering I don't want it but I got it.

If I talk about the term exams In One semester mainly You will have 3 main exams 
1st- Class Test(Mid sem)
Class tests are much easy to pass
2nd End Semester 
For this, we have to study quite good

Name: Arushi Rana
review:
Exposure is very good at Amity University and there are a lot of clubs like the data science club, artificial technology club, dance and singing club, grooming club and many more. The library is also good most of the reference books are available there but the only issue is with the due date as books are issued for only 2 weeks and you have to get them reissued after 2 weeks and there's a 5rupees/day fine after the due date. The sports club is also good like kabaddi, cricket, basketball and table tennis. Debating committees are also available.The course curriculum is very good and there's one foreign language is also provided as a mandatory subject. There are many foreign languages like german, french, Arabic, Spanish and Sanskrit. 
Most of the faculty members are PhD holders. There are midterm exams after 2 months of the semester starting and end-term exams are conducted after 4 months of the semester. The difficulty level of exams was a bit average but most of my classmates passed exams without having any back log.

Name: Madhur mittal
review:
The course curriculum includes all the basic subjects like english, engineering mathematics, engineering physics , basic electrcial engineering, basic electronics, python programming , c programming , special subjects like php and ai based on your stream. These will be provided subjects for you in your first year.
I chose AI as my course to pursue because i am really interested in this field and wanted to learn more here.

The faculy student ratio here is quite good. I would say there would be 1:70 ratio and there isn't any issue for teachers. Yes sometimes in first year , there are issues when new teachers join and they cant match up with students properly.
Most of the faculty in my first year. has done phd. Or mtech. From good colleges like NIT or IITS. There are lectures and tutorials to solve problems as well. You will be taught in lectures and you will be given sheets which you can solve and ask doubts in tutorials.

The exams here are semester wise and it wasnt very hard to pass.The placement provided by college is basic and depends solely on your skills.
 Students can start looking for placement from 6th semester or third year.
There are many great companies visisted here like google , infosys , etc. Around more than 600 recruiters came this year.

The highest packagae was of 44lpa in Microsoft. The average packagae here woulf be around 5-7 lacs and it depends on your stream as well.

Mostly all students get placement though it may be of less amount but they get placed.

I am thinking of taking placement if its around 15-20lpa otherwise i will look into doing masters.

Name: Anirudh narain kanojia
review:
There are many annual fests such as Engifest, Yuvaan, and Aahvaan. Tech fests are very interesting and cool. Engifest in February, yuvaan in February before Engifest, and Aahvaan (sports fest) in March. Sports complex and a cool campus.
Many sports and too many (in a good way) societies for music, dance, poetry, and tech societies (robotics and stuff).
Freesources is a website run by students (seniors) and volunteers which provides notes and assignments, it is a very important thing to have as it helps everyone on their exams and academics.I can handle physics and you are allowed to appear in the placement of all kinds of firms such as tech companies, and non-tech companies, and core is also an option.
The faculty is fine, not too involved, and rather strict in terms of exams and marking, labs are cool. The student ratio is very few girls compared to guys.
The qualifications of the faculty are good.
Exams are held every two months and they are manageable if you study properly.

Name: VISHESH SINGH CHAUHAN
college: Dr. Akhilesh Das Gupta Institute of Technology & Management - [ADGITM]
review: The courses are granted on the basis of jee mains rank and I found it sector quite interesting. The teacher and student ratio is good and teachers have quite well behaviour most of the faculty have PhD from reputed institutions across the globeVarious financial basis schemes are available and accepted by the college and this provides a good chance for students belonging to lower-middle-class family national schemes on the basis of financial assistance

Name: Arghya Chakrabarty
review:
The annual and tech fests are conducted in February and are called AdVITya.
There are quite a lot of copies of important books, mainly those recommended by the teachers. Other than that there are a decent amount of reference books. When it comes to fiction, it is a bit lacking.
The classrooms are as you would expect. Nothing very great, but meets the standards.
There are a lot of clubs and there are a lot of sports events that happen regularly
Discord and club-specific groups are there run by students.The fees are reasonable if you get ranked in the top 20,000 but if it is worse then the fees get very high. It is not recommended if your rank is greater than that. As a first-year student, I am not aware of the scholarship and placements very well but have heard good things from seniors, with an average of 7 lpa and a minimum of 4 lpa.

Name: Atul Kumar Singh
review: MALHAAR, the tech fest of BPIT was conducted in November last year, also ANUGOONJ, the cultural fest of IPU was conducted in March with many big celebrities as guests. The college has a pretty well-maintained library with a variety of books and journals and a cozy and quiet environment. The classrooms are built more like a school, but they are pretty spacious and comfortable. Air Conditioners are not available in the classrooms yet but they'll probably be added in the future. There is a pretty big ground on the campus along with a basketball and volleyball court. The university sports meet was conducted in January. There are many social groups and clubs run by the students to help out the students with studies, placements, entrepreneurship, etc.I chose Information Technology as my course because it has a very good scope for the future. A lot of companies require employees with technological knowledge so the IT branch will definitely provide an edge in that. The faculty of my course is very good. They're all very experienced and helpful teachers. The faculty : student ratio is around 1:60. Exams are held twice every semester, a mid-semester examination and an end-semester examination. The exams are easy to moderate in difficulty depending on your preparation.

Name: Dhananjay Aggarwal
review:
Placements of our college is below average. 3rd year students become eligible for internship opportunities and 4th year students for full time opportunities.
Companies like Microsoft,  Amazon, ZS, and Accenture do come and give good packages to a few students. other students are placed in service-based companies like Infosys, Wipro,hcl ,tcs, etc with the low packages.
The highest package is 45lpa(Microsoft) and the average package is 7 LPA only.
The percentage of students placed is very low over here ie 65 percent in reality.
my plan is to become a blockchain developer.Xtasy is our annual fest which is I would say decent enough. It is organized in the month of April every year. 
The library is big enough and has all the books for different departments in our college.
classroom infrastructure is old and small like any other old government college.
The sports facilities are good. sports theatre, gym, the big ground for cricket and football, and other sports equipment are present on our campus.
There are a lot of clubs in bvcoe according to the different interests of students like aagaz(music), zaahir(theatre), BVP-IEEE, ACM-BVP, etc.

Name: Dhruv Gaba
review: BPIT has a really good and experienced faculty. The Faculty ratio is 1:10. The exams are held timely and the knowledge of a student is given importance in BPIT.  Most of the teachers at bhagwan parshuram institute of technology have completed their Ph.D. The course duration is 4 years.As of 2022, the Fees for B.Tech. In the first year are around 1.7 lac. It was approx 1.3 lac in 2021. Students with bright minds can get a scholarship. And BPIT provides the facilities of on-campus placement in reputed companies.

Name: Anjali
review:
Life is really good here at LPU,  Social life is really amazing you can know people of different cultures and states.
The library consists of books in large amounts, you can issue them whenever needed. There is a huge craze for sports among students.As for the faculty members, the teachers are excellent and well-qualified.
Teachers are very friendly and you can ask your doubts whenever and wherever needed, teachers are always ready to help.
Teaching methods are excellent.

Name: VIGNESH
review: AI is a growing field currently so I took this course. The faculty-to-student ratio will be 1:70 / 1:100 depending on the size of the classroom. All the faculty have Ph.D. in IITs, nits and popular Universities. Term exams were moderately difficult.There are no fees hikes in the University. If secure a VITEEE rank under 100 u can get 50% percent concession in the category you got and below 1000 rank u can get 25% fee waiver. Indian Bank provides loan facility to students.

Name: Manisha Saini
college: BK Birla Institute of Engineering and Technology [BKBIET]
review: The course curriculum is quite impressive and good looking to the local college in this locality. We are having a wide range of courses which makes our college great and huge in this locality. The ratio of boys and girls is also quite good. Almost all the faculties are having P.hD. degrees.Our college allows you to do an internship in the 5th semester. Most internships is having a stipend and quite good accommodation is also provided at the time of the internship by the company which is so beneficial for students.

Name: Chaman Swami
review:
Life is very cool on our campus. There are many annual fests like Lakshay and Tarang etc.
Thousands of books are available in the library.
There is a large library. Classroom very good condition and less fewer features.
Sports and extra curricular are very good.
Their many tournaments are going in University.
Student clubs are very beneficial for students.
There are many student clubs present in University based on curricula.The course curriculum is very different from the government curriculum. University teaches you the very easy way. You can easily be passed with some effort.
Per 45 students a teacher is available.
Qualification of our teachers like masters and Ph.D. holders.
I gave the exam any time. I pass very easily with the help of some effort.

Name: Sriman narayanan
review: The fee structure is hideous, if you get below the 5000 ranks there is a high chance you can get the lowest fee of 200000 but if you fail to get so you will have to pay like 300000, 400000, 450000, 500000. There are even super dream offers that offer above 40lakh and the highest package received was a whopping 1.02 crore. The average package is 7.5 lakh with a 98% placement rate. My plan after getting a degree would be to find the super dream job.

Name: Aditya thakur
review:
The placement cell helps the students to get a good job and gives some training related to interviewing so anyone can crack it easily. Almost 80% of students get a job on campus. They also provide some summer training to get some skills and experience related to your career.
Different types of scholarships from IBM and OTHER platforms are offered for students.The highest salary package offered is 2.4 cr PA, and the overall avg package is 7 LPA. Avg package for the CSE branch is nearly 11 LPA. almost 94% of students got placements. Top recruiting companies are Zomato, Deloitte, IBM, Infosys, Amazone, JPMC, Reliance, Wipro, and much more. In the year 2022-23, around 1950 students were placed on campus.

Name: Shivam
college: Dr. Akhilesh Das Gupta Institute of Technology & Management - [ADGITM]
review: There is not a big playground in the college but it has a lot of sports societies and sports meet held every year games like cricket, football, kabaddi, chess, etc. college has an annual fest named Utkarsh. There are also technical societies here like CodeChef etc. And full assistance is provided by them.I have taken admission in course of B.Tech having branch information technology (IT). There is a good faculty here who have done Ph.D. in their respective fields and they have good teaching experience. The term exams are almost about 4-5 months.

Name: Sumit
college: Dayalbagh Educational Institute Faculty of Engineering
review:
Because i want to opt engineering and also it have good opportunities and placements also,Faculty have good ration of students and teachers.

After i will get degree then i will decide what to after

Name: Ankit kumar
review: Here the college life is just chill. But have to attend little classes. Here is no serious issue in getting attendance but u have to talk to teachers. The main fest is malhar. There is 2 end sem, with mid sem. The exam is quite easy. But u have study hard before exam to score good

Name: Vivek
review: The course curriculum is almost the same as other average btech colleges. Faculty members are supportive. I choose this course because it fits my jee rank. Also, I want to do btech. You can ask subject-related doubts without any hesitation to faculty members. I think maybe all teachers are of Ph.D. level. The teaching methods of some teachers are good and some you may don't like little. It also depends on the students.You can't expect too much from campus life because the campus size is a little small. But it's not bad. You will get a big ground to play and a canteen much more. You can visit the college to knowing more about campus life. And there are many societies some are paid and some are free, also society is good actors. There are also opportunities in society.

Name: Karan Baid
review:
The annual fest is called ADVITYA which is quite a refresh and enteratining fest offering various events such as drama , gaming , sports , concerts , dnacing , singing, art & literarture , anime events and many more. There is a 2 floor library and is good place if you want to do you work in peace. But the library timings is less according to me as it closes at 6 pm on weekdays and on weekdays it closes at 4 pm. Classrooms have a strength of 70 on an average. Some classrooms are too luxurious for a classroom but also there are few pretty ok for a classroom. There are quite a few clubs such as gaming club, robotics club, IOS club , android development club, sports club , even an anime club and many more clubs. Many of which are operated by students. The only thing I think to warn you about is that boys hostel is around 2 km far from academic block thus you have to walk quite a lot .But if you go with your friends,to be honest it dosent bother that much. Cycle is allowed also.I chose this course as I didn't want to take a drop year and it was the best college I was getting honestly it's not like I regret my decision much. Computer Science was all I could ask for and I have it here.
The university has a 100% doctoral faculty (all teachers have Ph.D.). This university also provides a CAL-TECH system of teaching. There are quite a  few excellent faculties and the rest are good too. It's just that personally saying, there are only a few teachers who aren't good.

Name: Akashdeep Singla
review: I chose this course because I was interested in learning about various computer technologies and mechanics from the very beginning. In my university, there are a total of 30 batches of 80 students each. The faculty is well qualified but sometimes doubts are not cleared up to the mark. The terms are too constant as after every 15 days there is an exam which is not so difficult to pass.Fests and sports events are held on a regular basis so that students can get an escape from their busy schedules and enjoy themselves. Various clubs are formed such as dance clubs, sports clubs, drama clubs, etc. A huge number of sports tournaments are also organized for various sports.

Name: Aryan soni
review:
THE NUMBER OF FACULTY MEMBERS IS MORE THAN 250.
AND ALL FACULTIES ARE PHD HOLDERS. THEY EXPLAIN THINGS IN THE EASIEST AND THE BEST WAY. 
FACULTY:STUDENT = 1:50
HAVING TWO OR THREE EXAMS PER SEM MEANS EITHER THEY ORGANISE 3 EXAMS PER SEM I.E. CAT I, CAT II, AND TERM END OR  TWO EXAMS PER SEM I.E MID TERM AND TERM ENDLIFE CAMPUS IS ALSO GOOD AT THIS COLLEGE. AND STUDENTS HERE COME FROM ALL OVER INDIA I.E YOU CAME TO  ABOUT DIFFERENT CULTURES OF INDIA INSIDE THE CAMPUS

Name: Devansh
review: In terms of placement, my college is very very good. I have joined this college just because of this criterion as placement at this college is increasing rapidly year by year. Almost 90 per cent of students are getting placed. This year's average package was around 9 lpa and the highest package was something around 82-83 lpa.Campus Life is also good not much of high quality like you get in big colleges where you give tons of fees but ya according to wise of fees our college campus is also good. There are many societies- cultural, Tech, Dance, Music, Art, etc. So you can enjoy your college life rather than only just focusing on your studies.

Name: Shobhit Chaturvedi
review:
Tech fests are organized per year latest fest is organized in the month of November and the next will be organized in.  March end. 
In our college library a lot of books are available and they issue books for students to study at home.
Regularly sports games are organized in our college.The course curriculum is easy and the faculty is good.
Sometimes it's hard to secure good marks but if you study a little more you can easily secure good marks and excel in the exam almost every faculty is a Ph.D. holder and have really good experience labs are good and well-maintained.

Name: Drish
review:
The course curriculum was nice and the faculty members are great they will support me with all kinda problems. I choose BTECH with CSE and it was such a nice course and all one class containing 60 students ratio.  
Faculty are qualified from great renowned institutes like IIT and dtu and they had done their masters in their field. Mid-term and end-term exams were quite medium means you have to study the course otherwise it will create your backlog.Life on campus was quite nice the infrastructure was quite decent and it has huge grounds where you can play any sports. Our college conducts a fest in the month between November and December it was named Malhar There is a library in our college which has good facilities for books and seating and there are so many clubs for your hobbies like a dance club, chess club and so on.

Name: Jaidev sarkar
college: Mangalmay Institute of Engineering and Technology - [MIET]
review:
The structure is you have to pay 60% of your fees in the first semester and the remaining in the second semester.
There are no issues with bulk payment you have the option to give fees in parts like installments.
Scholarships are given to students who are first in the examination.The life of this college is like a school, the area of this college is very small as compared to other colleges in Greater Noida.
Around 10000 books are available in the library.
Clubs are also made by faculty like the eco club, sports club, and game club.

Name: Sachin Kumar
review: I have a lot of interest in computer science and secondly, I talk about this with other also. So I decided to choose computer science as my course subject. My decision is now good. I scored good marks. The faculty also is really qualified and always ready to help us.Fee infrastructure is quite affordable. Everyone can afford this university. On the other, there are a lot of scholarship programs also like the mark scholarship, ewl scholarship and there are many more scholarships in university.

Name: Adarsh Kumar
review:
- There are no annual fests in the college, there are tech fests that usually occur twice a month conducted by societies of the college.
- Books can be issued from the library to the students and must be submitted at the end of the semester.
- There are amenities in classrooms like fans, tube lights, and two Air conditioners.
- There are sports facilities like football, basketball, badminton, volleyball, and cricket.
- There are social groups like Anveshan, Octave, and hash define which help the students to grow their technical skills.- I chose this course because I love coding, and I want to become a full-time software developer in the future.
-The Student-faculty ratio is 2500:100.
- Most of the teachers are Ph.D. qualified, and some of them have master's degrees. The method of teaching is very chill, they are very supportive towards the students and help them to motivate.
- In My College midterm examinations are usually after 2 months from the beginning of the semester and there are end-term examinations usually after 4 months from the beginning of the semester.

Name: Saksham
review:
The faculty members are quite good and compromising.
But a lot of work and pressure we had faced in our first sem only.
Each and every faculty member are Ph.D.
And teaching is AVERAGE. I have just given my mid and end-term examination
The difficulty was quite low.
If you prepare well or average then it's easy for you to pass.

The campus life u have seen on yt about iits and nit is not but u have to adjust at 1 lakh jee rank.
There are many societies according to your interest.
Dance
Music 
Good coding facility and really nice peers and seniors.
Classrooms are quite clean and average.

Name: Pratham Mittal
review:
Life on campus is good. Although the campus is a bit small, you can still have fun with your friends. The campus is very near to the G3S cinema and you can go there with your friends to hang out after college.
There are many different societies and clubs in the college such as IEEE, CSI, define, and many more. You can learn a lot by joining these societies.The first-year average fees per year are 1,69,000. From the 2nd year, it is around 1,40,000. 
There are also some scholarships for students who really need them.
For the placement part, there is a training and placement cell on the campus which helps us in getting good jobs. They organize workshops for helping us to know more about the corporate world.

Name: Aryaman Malhotra
review: I chose this course because I find computer science easy .. Faculty to student ratio is decent and their qualification is also extraordinary, some of them are even pursuing their PhDs while teaching. Exams are in every 1.5 months including mid-term and end-term because of the delay in the admission process and passing is not difficult.. The annual fest is Malhaar which occurs around December while there is another fest in ipu you can go round the year, Don't miss Anugoonj. There are all sports available but I think the ground is a little small. There are clubs and societies for everything, singing, dancing, acting, coding, cricket team, football, etc.

Name: Nikhil
review: I chose computer science because it has the most scope as compared to other courses. The faculty is good. All teachers are Ph.D. graduates. Their teaching method is also good. There are two examinations - mid-sem and end-sem. They are quite easy to pass as all the questions come from the university.The annual fest is called Malhaar previously called the corona. The fest is conducted in December. There are many books available in the library on almost every topic. There is a basketball court and volleyball court on the college ground

Name: Pradeep Reddy
college: Kandula Sreenivasa Reddy Memorial College of Engineering - [KSRMCE]
review:
I did my diploma in civil Engineering, and because of that I am continuing the same course in btech.

In our college every semester has six months to complete the syllabus, and after six months they conduct exams. In our college we study well, then it is easy to clear all the subjects at first attempt.In our college they are allowing for campus selection at the time of in the final year of course.
In my college top MNC companies like TCS, Wipro, mphasis, and HCl, are all visited 
In our college, one of the byius companies is offered the highest package around 9.5lpa.
Those who got above 60percebtage of marks are getting placements in our college.

Name: Aman Bhakar
review:
Life at the campus is very much pleasant. There are one annual fest and one tech fest held in one year. Annual fest in February and tech fest in April.
MNIT has a good scope for students in sports with the availability of every sport almost.
Sphinx and Blitzschlag is a site run by students for fests.I have interest in Electrical Engineering that's why I choose this course. Faculty members are pretty good with good teaching methods and qualifications. In the first year due to covid, the time span of papers was less but the difficulty of exams is moderate.an

Name: Student (Anonymous)
review:

Name: SATYAJEET SWAIN
review:

Name: khush
review: The library is quite decent according to the college. Sports is not that much in our college just a ground, basketball open court, and paid badminton court. Name: Anshul Jumnani
review:
- in the 6th semester we can be eligible for campus placements.

The placement process involves pre-placement talks, aptitude tests, group discussions, and personal interviews.
Students become eligible for campus placements from the seventh semester of their B.Tech program, and the placement cell provides ample training and guidance to prepare them for the recruitment process.

Similarly, Aaruush is a national-level techno-management fest of SRMIST, Kattankulathur. It is one of a kind because it comprises of multi-faceted events ranging from technical to management and sports. Events generally consist of competitions, workshops, speeches by eminent people, etc. It is usually done in October. 
The UB building classrooms are well occupied with foam chairs and joint desks, ACs, and free Wifi but theres no AC case only in Techpark where most of the classes are done. Similarly getting elevators to get to the 11th and 12th floors where your classes are, won't be so easy. It's usually a climb. DSA is a club here at SRM which holds many domains like data science, web development, music. literature.I chose CSE because it was my subject of interest from the beginning. The student-to-faculty ratio at SRMIST is fairly good as there are a lot of faculties for every domain in the college. However, fitting 70+ students in a class isn't really effective when there's just a single teacher teaching. The class gets out of control quite a few times.
The faculties that teach here are mostly Ph.D. graduates if not just Masters' Degree holders. Their teaching methods are modern and they often use ppt and written notes in order to explain the subject matter the best they can. review:
KL University is an excellent campus for students to live and study. The annual fest, Surabhi, and the tech fest, Samyak, are conducted every year in the month of March and October, respectively.

The institute has concluded its placement drive for the batch 2022, and more than 150 companies have visited the campus for recruitment. Students become eligible for campus placements from the seventh semester of their course. The companies that visited the campus include Microsoft, Amazon, IBM, TCS, Wipro, and many more. A wide range of profiles was offered, including software engineer, data analyst, business analyst, and many more. The highest package offered was 60 LPA, while the average package was 6 LPA.
The percentage of students getting placements is high, with more than 95% of students receiving job offers. KL University offers great job opportunities for hardworking and determined students. However, for students who don't get placed, the university provides training and guidance to improve their employability. Overall, it provides excellent placement opportunities.

Name: Rishabh
college: University Institute of Engineering and Technology - [UIET]
review:
Well this is something, which really needs to be worked upon, as campus placements are very less for tech field, and almost zero for core branches. Here companies do visit, but at a very bad rate. On campus placements do happen, but the amount is not very fair. The average package is of about 3 to 4 lpa. Something which is good here is that, students take off campus jobs from here, and this college also provides, quite a number of good ranks of gate exam from core branches. Yes, if you study here, and have a dream of having job, then you need to work on your skills, so that you can grab off campus jobs. In recent years, companies like infoysis, tca, etc have visited here, and provided employment to students. But it's not constant. 
Nearly 50-60 percent of students from cse and it get placed from here, but highest package won't go above 6 lpa on campus. I do look forward for an off campus job, with decent salary from here. Fee here, for whole year, for cse, cse ai, and is 10400, while for the core branches, it's 84400 per annum. Fee structure is quite decent, because there is no extra money required, once the fee payment is done, nothing else is required. As per taking my experience, apart from fee, if you live in hostel here, your per semester expenses can reach upto 5-6 thousands apart from fee payment. Here, college provides internships, which are unpaid, and if you want, you can go for paid internships too, but for that, you need to help yourself, and college won't be providing as such assistance. People here are getting off campus jobs mostly, and some of them are also getting on campus jobs, but they are little in amount. About 3-4 lakhs can be considered the average placement here, which is offered to limited students, so job opportunity is not very well over here. For jobs, you mostly need to rely on off campus jobs opportunities.

Name: Raunit kumar

Name: Aditya
review:

review: I choose this course because this college is very close to my house and also due to its excellent placements in the mechanical engineering branch. Faculty to students ratio is very good. Faculties are highly qualified and completed their education at the reputed Institute of India. We have two exams in a semester one midsem and the other Endsem. And exams are easy one scores excellent cgpa by just studying 1 week before exams.Our annual fest is Culfest which takes place in February and the technical fest is Ojas which takes place in April. Our central Library has lots of journals and books. Our classrooms are one of the best in India. Students get lots of opportunities to explore sports and other extracurricular activities. There are lots of clubs in college.

Name: Abhishek Kumar Rajak
review:

In a year we have 2 greatest fests, one is our Ayam which is our tech fest and the other is our moksha which is our cultural fest in our tech fest we invited many big faces like Aman dhattarwal,  Ishan Sharma, and Anubhav Singh Dubey, and we thought tech fest aayam is this good then how good will be our moksha so yes fests are very upto the mark don't worry you can count on us for this I promise as I'll be your senior when you will be coming I'll take the responsibility to give you the best experience

Name: Shashank Mishra
review: I choose this course as the college guided me as there are upcoming job requirements when will pass out and this is also becoming very popular so I choose it. The faculty ratio is good as compared to students every teacher is there for every student when needed. The teaching is good and teachers help a lot to students to help understand each term in books and outside books by giving practical examples.
