Name: Rajat hande
college: Tulsiramji GaikwadPatil College of Engineering and Technology - [TGPCET]
review: The college has a transparent fee hike policy in place. The fee hike is based on various factors such as inflation, maintenance costs, and infrastructure upgrades, among others. The college also offers education loans through various banks and financial institutions to help students fund their education. The placement cell works closely with industry partners and offers career guidance and counseling to students to help them make informed career choices.Our college provides students with a well-rounded education that prepares them for success in their careers. The college prides itself on maintaining an excellent faculty-to-student ratio, ensuring that every student receives personalized attention and guidance throughout their academic journey. With a faculty-to-student ratio of 1:15.students to score a minimum of 40% marks in both theory and practical exams to pass a subject.

Name: Isha Singh
review:
I choose this course because IILM has its name in the education world for business and the faculties of IILM are very knowledgeable, educated and interactive with the students. 
Every student is assigned a mentor and under 1 mentor 10 students are assigned. So the ratio is 1:10.
In IILM University, they believe that students should get practical and industrial knowledge along with theory. So, workshops, industry events and college activities occur often here. 
Every faculty of IILM holds a Doctorate degree in their specialized subjects and they teach in the best way using the best technologies. 
IILM organize a mid-term exam every 3 months and a semester exam every 6 monthIn my course, the students are eligible to get campus placement after the 4 semester and top companies visit our campus and offer a high package of 18 - 24 Lakh per annum. The students easily get places because our curriculum is industrial based and 90% of students are placed because our university is very supportive.
I plan to continue my studies after graduating from IILM.

Name: Khyati singh
review: NSIT has a strong culture of student activities. Numerous societies are active on campus that aim to inculcate team values and nurture talents within students. Canvas, crescendo, ashwamedh,junoon, mirage, are some recreational societies and IEEE, devcomm, CSI nsit, etc are tech Societies. There are several other societies.Technology courses were 1,45000 by 2018-19, it was increased to Rupees 1,65,000 and now for session 2022-2023, it is hiked up to 2,19,000 rupees for the first year. NSIT have some scholarship programs  too and offers fee waivers for students whose family income is low

Name: Abhishek Singh
college: University Institute of Engineering and Technology - [UIET]
review: College has a cultural fest called Spandan and a tech fest called techmart. All books on different subjects are available in the central library of CSJM UNIVERSITY which is issued on student ID. The classroom is well-equipped and has a smart board as well. Students can participate in different sports and extracurricular activities held in hostels and universities. There are different clubs such as film, literary, and coding clubs assisted by seniors.I choose this college as I got CSE at 129k to jee CRL rank. The faculties include mostly PhD qualified teachers. Each faculty holds two branches in a single semester and there are 66 students in each branch. Mid-semester and end-semester exams hold on time. The difficulty of exam papers also depends from teacher to teacher. Few are lenient but most of the teachers are difficult to score.

Name: Ishaan Gupta
review: I had a keen interest in this course that's why I chose this course. Also, teachers here are highly qualified and they have pursued their master's degrees from International Universities. Also, exams are at easier levels i.e if one has attended classes regularly he/she can score very well.Life at the campus is quite interesting. Tech fest happened last week many games like code wreck the game of codes were played there and a lot of debugging games were played there.  There is a whole lot of variety of books available in their central library.

Name: Shubham mishra
review: Social life is quite good there is a variety of students you get to know. You will find people of your interests. There are so many active societies which participate in inter-college competitions like iits iims etc. The infrastructure is very classy.The course is quite difficult and I am enjoying it very much. The faculty is very good and coordinative with the students. There is a good sense of communication between the both. The faculty members have done Ph.D. in their respective fields

Name: Yogendra Kumar
review: I choose to engineer in computer science because I love computers and coding. The student ratio in college is good and the faculty are in good numbers. The faculty is well-qualified and their teaching is good. There are two mid-term and one final semester exam in one semester and it is quite difficult.The name of the annual fest change every year and the tech fest is also held every year for three days. You can get all the syllabus books in the library and in daily newspapers. There is no club or sports event also held in college. The class is good.

Name: Karthik raj
review: I choose this course as the placements provided in this fields are good, the student ratio is kinda poor, it's 70:10 ofc fewer girls , faculty are highly qualified we have teachers who passed out of IITs and worked in companies like Samsung, exams occur twice every six, months excluding the tests they are moderate level I would sayLife in this college is amazing, it really feels like a new home, there is not a single day that passes when we don't enjoy ourselves,  library, sports ground, and classrooms everything is top-notch , and it actually has a very beautiful campus

Name: Amarnath C
review:
There is an Annual Tech / Cultural Fest names Azure usually conducted around April or May season it's an absolute blast, and celebrities come.
Apart from that there are many cultural fests like Open Base, Sound Booth, Mad Crew, and many more.
There is a central Library and each department's library and It's big.
There are many technical workshops available like in my case for python, JavaScript, etc.
There are 5 grounds with equipment for badminton, tennis, football, basketball, cricket, throwball, and many more.
There is a college FM Radio.From semester 6, I guess as I'm not sure as I'm still in semester 2.

The Highest package given was 77LPA.
My plans after getting a degree are if got campus placement go for it and then save some money to go for Mtech, or else go for MTech with my parents' money and pay it back later or take an education loan.

Name: Harsh swami
college: Mangalmay Institute of Engineering and Technology - [MIET]
review:
I chose this course as this matches my interest and I want to evolve in this field in the future as per my department Computer Science so I have a very dynamic field of job perspective like IT, programming, software development, etc. 
The faculty members are about 35 professors and around 1500 students including all 4 years and the professors are highly qualified in their fields like masters, Doctorate, etc exams are taken semester-wise with 5 subjects each semester and if you learn and focus you can score well but it's up to you the paper pattern are normal as all other examinations have.With the studies there are also many education and fun fest and events goes on throughout the year and it adds much skill to students and will help in future and there is a huge library where you can find your course book and many books only for reading like novels, poetry books, etc and the classroom have all the elements it wants like projectors, bench, fans, etc and there are many clubs which work on engineering and making new models which they show in various exhibitions.

Name: Somveer
review: NSUT campus is a very beautiful campus among so many colleges. It is a lush green campus where you can see peacocks at everywhere on lawns. It has a variety of flowers and trees. We have two annual fests named Resonance and moksha. They are winter and summer fest respectively. NSUT also organizes north India's biggest hackathon organized by IEEE NSUT. The library is very huge where you can get enough books related course curriculum and magazines too. The classrooms are quite big and lavish. Every year NSUT organizes many sports events like intercollege and intra-college. We have more than 30 societies in college. In tech, we have IEEE, DEVCOMM, GDSC, etc. Drama society - Ashwamedh, Dance society - capella and mirage, and many more societies. The best society of NSUT is canvas-the fine arts society of NSUT. You just bring your interest and we have a society for you.The course curriculum is a bit old and the faculty members are mostly good some of them are cooperative too but all are not. ICE is a very nice and oldest branch of NSUT. Student-to-faculty ratio is 1:40. Faculty members are Ph.D. scholars and they teach very well. Exams are held twice a semester and they are quite easy to pass.

Name: Soniya Verma
college: Indira Gandhi Delhi Technical University For Women -[IGDTUW]
review:
Tarangana fest will conduct every year in our college and another tech fest will also be there.
There is not much good availability of books in our library. But it's quite good.
There are intelligent boards, ac, and projectors in the classroom, And good hygiene and infrastructure
So many societies are there for sports and equipment related sports are there in our college.. and so many extracurriculars are also there like hackathons. Hackathon club, Tarangna society, etcI choose btech because I really want to become an engineer... I love to study technology and technical things. Our igdtuw faculty is very good, well educated, and teach us so well. All are Ph.D. holders. And they teach in the significantly easier way they are so good
It occurs 2 times in a semester, and it was a medium level

Name: Naushin Fatima
review:
The fee structure of IILM University is decent. For B.Tech in CSE, the tuition fee is 1.5L per year and for B.Tech in CSE with IBM, it is 2L per year. Other than this there are two types of hostel facilities available on campus, non-sharing and three-sharing rooms. The non-sharing rooms hostel costs 85k/year and the three sharing rooms hostel costs 60k/ year. Both hostels are decent and well maintained. Scholarship opportunities are also very good at IILM. Based on your academic performance you are given different scholarships. If you score above 85% in the 12th then you can avail 20% scholarship on your tuition fees, if you score above 90% in your 12th then you can avail of around 60% scholarship on your tuition fees. Also as per your every year performance in college exams, you are given different scholarships. There is a lot of financial assistance on campus. The faculty and admission department are always ready to help you. Campus placements are also very good. A lot of companies visit the campus.Campus Life at IILM is just amazing. The students are really good here. Things like gender or caste discrimination are nowhere around. Ragging is also not a thing here. Everyone is always very cooperative and supportive of each other. Every year an annual fest called Ignite is organized on campus. Students from all over India visit the campus at that time. It is conducted in March during the last week. The fest involves all types of activities like dancing, singing, sports, innovation ideas presentation, etc. Other than this a lot of activities happen on campus every week which is very informative and engaging.
IILM consists of 2 big libraries. Both libraries are occupied with several books and journals. Classrooms are also very large and equipped with excellent infrastructure. There are 2 badminton courts, 2 volleyball courts, 1 handball court, a basketball court and a big ground for cricket, etc. is given. A very good gym is also there. A lot of social groups are there.

Name: Kashish Yadav
review: I already had made up my mind I'll be choosing aerospace engineering. And one of the best colleges to pursue this degree is Kiit. The faculty members are very kind and helpful. The labs are too good. I'm pretty happy with the lab facilities provided here.Aerospace engineering is a very high-cost degree to study but kiit provide it to us at a reasonable price. Moreover, it allows us to sit in various scholarship exams to less our fees. It also gives leases to financially weak students.

Name: Sachin
review:
Our campus life is good I would say as our annual fest moksha is one of the best in north India and our tech fest conducts many activities for interested students. They were both conducted in the month of Feb and march.
Our library is also good it has many books related to every course and different magazines and journals for interested students.
Our classrooms also have facilities that are needed like smart boards, ac, and better sitting.
Sports facilities are also awesome we have every sport in our college and our college host sports fest and inter university tournaments also our sports faculty send us on different tours to play and show our skills.
Our college has almost clubs for every extra curriculum activity including drama, dance, singing, standup, social service,gaming,photography,literature,quiz, coding, etc.. I mean I can't even remember the no.of societies and clubs. Also, we have our official website and student sections for important information and instructions.I choose this course to get a mouth-watery package of course and another reason is my interest in the software field, especially in cyber security and ethical hacking.
The faculty is quiet good I would say a mix some are very good and chill but few are not friendly and helpful to the students and the student ratio is now improving as our college gives a 20 percent female quota.
All the faculty members are highly qualified and their teaching method is good needs to improve they need to connect the subject to students not just start teaching.
We have a back-to-back examinations from class tests to practicals to mid sem to another CT and finally end sem exam and it is not easy to pass the exam the students need to give a certain amount of time to each and every subject.

Name: Student (Anonymous)
college: IIT Delhi - Indian Institute of Technology [IITD]
review: I personally chose CS1 which is 4 years BTECH in Computer Science and Engineering because it was the best branch I was getting with my rank. The faculty-student ratio varies from class to class though on average in the first year it will be around 1:150. But from the second year onwards it will decrease. This is because, in the first year of IITD, all the branches have the same courses. Coming up o the part of academics in IITD, it's way different from JEE academia. One needs to give equal importance to labs and classes. Also to get good grades in IITD you should keep your jee mode on cause everything is relative to grading in IITD. Also, self-study is very important for a decent 9 CGPA.Fees at IITD are just like other government colleges but for me, the hostel and mess fees are a bit on the higher side. The combined hostel and mess fee in a year around? 80000. Though college fees are not increased regularly, the hostel and mess fees get a hike regularly. As per the Government of India, The tuition fees are 33000 per semester for someone having a family income between 1 to 5 lakh and 0 for SC/ST/PwD and someone having a family income less than 1 lakh. Also, there are various other scholarships based on merit and the need of students, so your financial condition won't be a problem to thrive in IITD.

Name: Student (Anonymous)
college: Anil Neerukonda Institute of Technology & Sciences - [ANITS]
review:
I want to Pursue Higher education first, and also I have an interest in both the Fields of Computer Science and electronics as well.

The  Teaching process is excellent and is good enough to get Knowledge. Each semester Has two mid-exams and a semester-end exam. They will be held timely and also within the scheduled time.The infrastructure of the Campus is good. A technical fest Will be conducted in March of every year. Also, separate fests are conducted by each department separately. The college is good and known for its library facilities.

Name: Vineeth a
review: Yeah our seniors had said that so many popular companies visit dsce to recruit students and they also provide some internship work in there company itself there and approximately 95 per cent of students get placement every yearThe campus is very wast it has nearly 50 acres of campus in addition to that it has 3 campuses of which one is a university and a green campus it's a student-friendly campus over the life of dsce is nice.

Name: SIMRAN JHA

Name: Student (Anonymous)
review:
I'm a fresher in the Btech CSE branch. Technology being on the cutting edge made me take Computer science and engineering. Name: Abhinav Tiwari
college: IIT Delhi - Indian Institute of Technology [IITD]
review:
Rendezvous four-day cultural fest - has celebrities like Sunidhi Chauhan, and Benny Dayal.
 Tryst is an annual tech fest.
Literati, BeCon, and Kaizen are some other fests
Also different clubs also regularly organize events and competitions. For eg. the Debating society of iitd conduct stalwarts where basically students showcase their debating skills and compete with others.
Thus, every club regularly organizes such activities.
Also, sports are given great importance and are considered a central part of campus life, particularly through the General Championship (GC) which is an inter-hostel sports competition. Additionally, there is the Inter-IIT Sports Meet where all the IITs compete against each other in various sports.As a first-year student, I have not had any personal experience with internships, but from what I have observed and heard, many students have been able to secure valuable internship opportunities with a wide range of companies. These opportunities have varied greatly in terms of compensation, with some companies offering staggering packages of up to 40 lakhs, while others offer more modest salaries. Many of the companies that offer these internships are well-known and respected and provide students with meaningful and valuable roles that can help them develop their skills and gain practical experience in their chosen fields.

Name: Mayank Gautam
review:
Many fests are organized around the year at NSUT. The main fest is "MOKSHA" which is organized roughly around the end of March. There are other cultural and technical fests like TeckWeek (Organized by IEEE), Resonanz, etc.
In the central library, one can find any book one's needs.
Classrooms are very spacious with high quality and comfortable seats with charging ports below the table for each seat. Classrooms have 4 ACs, digital screens, and computers for lectures, open Wi-Fi, speaker system. Classrooms are more or less like small auditorium halls.
Various sports facilities are provided in the college and one can hear about some sports competitions going on at any time.
There are a lot of clubs aka societies which have events every now and then. 
NSUTx is an app created by a student which has all the features from attendance, PYQ, syllabus, and Notices to exam results.I chose this course because my rank wasn't that good to go for a good branch in any NIT whereas ICE at NSUT is well-established and a good course for both tech and non-tech placements.
I believe that there are slightly fewer faculties relative to the requirement.
Faculty here at NSUT are well experienced and highly qualified and their teaching method suits all students.
Exams are held regularly. From class tests, mid-semester, and practical to end-semesters all are planned perfectly to enhance learning. The exams are easy to pass if one has a basic grip on the topics.

Name: Harshita Chaurasia
college: Noida Institute of Engineering and Technology - [NIET]
review:
I choose B. Tech in Information Technology because I was eligible for the CSE branch and after taking admission to NIET I realized I was right I m very happy with my college and my course my faculty members, and faculty are well qualified their teaching processes are best.

sports and extracurricular activities are good there are so many clubs here and future opportunities. 
Tech fests are conducted every year.

Name: Atharva Shrotriya
college: Madhav Institute of Technology and Science - [MITS]
review:

Name: Vartika Nathani
review: The opportunity of scholarship is commendable as they give a 100 per cent "institute fee" rebate to bright students who secure the top 5 percentile in their respective branchesPlacement opportunity of Nsut is almost next level as nearly every student gets placed depending on their skills.The semester has become short so there should be a reduced number of class tests and more focus should be on mid-semesters. We have continuous tests and exams so it is very difficult to actually bear the stress of the exam. It is not that difficult to pass the exam.

Name: Pranit
review: There are great opportunities in this course. We can apply for both the tech and core departments. That's why I chose for ECE department. The faculty-student ratio is approximately 100:1 for 1st year and 70:1 for 2nd year. Faculties have done their PhDs and are well experienced.Generally, students from the 5th semester are eligible for internships from the college. Many companies visit the college like Google, Infosys, Flipkart, and Oyo. Usually, the number of offers made is more than the number of students and hence all the students get placed.

Name: Shruti Sahu
review: the campus placement season begins in the pre- final/final semester. The companies visited are DXC Technology, Cognizant GenC Elevate, Infosys etc . There are so many books but still, most of the books are already issued by the students. A sports annual meet was held recently and it was a great success. One can join prayers, IEEE, etc.

Name: Nilay thummar
review: in our college end If the 7th semester and starting of the 8th semester we can be eligible for campus placement. in our college there mnc companies like ADANI, L&T,Byjus, TCS, and many mnc companies. in our college, the highest placement is around 20 lack and the average package is around 400000.There are many fests like Alumni If college and DHANAK events and there is improve our skills and interest in giving opportunities, and in summer there are cricket tournaments by the department of the college organized by Rotaract international club and many events are organized by our college.

Name: Soumyadip Changder
review: The fee structure is 6,28,000 in total 4 years of B.Tech. 8 semesters. Between each semester there are two mid-term exams for better preparation. College provides a scholarship for those students who have 100% attendance. Also, there are a lot of scholarships for financially challenged students. And there are 100% placements in this college.I choose CSE because, in engineering, there are a lot of opportunities for CSE, and we can get placements easily from CSE, so I choose this stream. About the faculty members, they are too good and very helpful. And for each section, there are two mentors to help the students.

Name: Ayushman Bhatt
review:
Placements are great in our college. Almost every tech companies come to our college. Many internship opportunities are also available. So technically you can get a place from the 4th semester. 95 percent of the students get placed. Avg package is around 15 lakh for tech and 11 for non-tech.

Many rankers in UPSC are from our college like ira Singhal who get 1st rank in UPSC is from NSUT.The fee structure for btech students is around 220000 a year. There are many scholarships available every year top 9 percent of a branch gets a scholarship(tuition fees are reduced), if you want to start a startup and your idea is great, the college provides some funds too for kickstarting your startup.

Name: Madhav Tanwar
review: From the 7th semester the students become eligible for the placements and can apply for the internship with all the leading MNCs's google Facebook flipkart amazon and the list continues, in the 3rd year. the median package is marked at 15,00,000/- and the average package is marked at 18,00,000/-. if a student maintains a decent CGPA of 7.0 he/she can secure a good package in all the leading companies irrespective of their branches. my plan is to prepare for the UPSC exam after my Btech degree for the betterment of my life and to make it more progressive.When it comes to the annual fest, it's MOKSHA to which not the college folks but all the Delhi students look forward. The books and journals in the library are well maintained and equipped too. the classrooms are well furnished and have all the necessary amenities in them. there is a sports complex too for the excel of students in sports. the debating societies acting singing and dancing and all other co-curricular activities, some societies can be joined by the folks of the college for the betterment and better experience in their respective skills.

Name: Animesh Mishra
college: Maulana Azad National Institute of Technology  - [MANIT]
review:
The annual cultural and technical fest of manit bhopal is Maffick . It is held in the month of march. And it has got so much in it like a treasure hunt, creators summit, Dj nights and so much more. Esummit is also organized in which this year Ashneer Grover, Mba chai wala(Praful billore), Anubhav Dubey, and money others came.

The student Activity center is also there with various clubs like robotics club, E-cell, zenith-programming club, vision club, and many more.First of all, in the range of my rank, this was the best-suited course and college and city as I am also from Bhopal. Name: Hansika
college: IIT Delhi - Indian Institute of Technology [IITD]
review: I chose chemical engineering because I am interested in courses that involve the environment and on researching, I got to know that there's a huge scope for chemical engineering in the future. The faculty are really good and have graduated from one of the top schools in the world such as oxford, MIT, etc. The exams are conducted once every 2 months and they are quite difficult to pass.There are lots of clubs available and lots of opportunities such as dance, music, art, quizzing, fashion, literature, and whatnot! There are also social groups to prevent discrimination on any basis be it sexuality or caste. A huge library is available for both academic and nonacademic purposes. All kinds of sports stadiums are available.

Name: Md Atib Gufran
review:

Name: Anisha Chowdhury
review: The environment of the campus is quite good and healthy it is all greenery everywhere and the seniors and students are quite helpful and supportive towards each other. The infrastructure of the college is neither very bad nor very good it is an average infrastructure. Talking about the clubs and the societies there is a huge problem because, in the first year, we students do not have that appropriate knowledge about every field and domain and when they are taking the interviews and conducting so many rounds one after the another it becomes very difficult for the students to join the societies they're interested into so this is a very huge problem.The first-year course curriculum is quite boring because it includes all the subjects that were a part of our j journey including physics chemistry electronics and mechanics. Name: Hardik Gupta
review: Placements in this college are great as they try to place all the students in the course and around 90% of students get placed and 80% girl students get placed and people from different states join this university only bcoz of its placement records. Avg package is 5-6 LPA. The highest package is 44lpa.This university provides nice internship opportunities from the 3rd year of btech and from big companies like Accenture Microsoft and others, Students can get an internship and work and get paid from 3rd year of their engineering course.

Name: Ankur Kshitij Sahai
review: College life at NSUT is very exciting, we get to meet a ton of amazing people with brilliant minds. And for every interest, there's a society from tech, sports, robotics, off-road racing, philosophy, photography etc. anyone can take part and excel in this society. The annual fest MOKSHA is among the best college fest in Delhi, students from different colleges come to attend it, and there are various tech fests held in college like HackNSUT, and TechWeek and many hackathons are held regularly. There are well-maintained grounds for Football, Cricket, Volleyball, Basketball, and Badminton and students participate in various events held in different colleges. The library is well equipped with every book and journal and has air-conditioned rooms. There is an app made by a society of college to check the student profile like attendance, marks, the notification from college etc in it.The academic fees of college for our batch i.e the batch of 2026, for the first year is Rs.219000 and it increases to Rs.10000 after every year the hostel fees for non-AC rooms for single seater are Rs. 51000 and for non-AC double seater is Rs. 49000 per semester (including the 19000 mess fees per semester) for AC rooms the hostel fees is almost Rs.60000(+ $750 mess fees) per semester. The college helps to provide the scholarship schemes from the government like the National Scholarship Program, E district scholarship, merit cum means scholarship etc. For a student loans, there is a branch of SBI inside the college campus.

Name: Aditya garg
review: The NSUT is very well known for its placement. It has been ranked 7th among the engineering colleges of India for its placement. The student is eligible for an on-campus placement from the start of the fourth year. Also, the student is eligible for an on-campus internship from the third year. Each year more than 90% of students get placed.The annual fest of NSUT -MOKSHA occurs every year in the month of March. Another technical fest, Resonanz occur each year in the month of October.  Also, two sports events are organised each year-Summer sports events and Winter sports event. Also, the college is well connected and have restaurant club nearby

Name: Vaibhav Singh
college: Netaji Subhas University of Technology - [NSUT] West Campus
review: I choose BTech. It is a 4-year undergraduate course. There are different branches in BTech. The student ratio is decent. Faculty are well qualified and good at teaching. Every year there are two semesters and there are two exams every semester (1) mid-semester exams and (2) end-semester exams.I am from the west campus, so campus life here is not good. Yes, sports facilities are good but there are not many extracurricular activities here. Books are available here in the library. About the fest, we can attend a cultural fest on the main campus named "Moksha" in the month of March.

Name: Riya Mehta
review: My course is Electronics and communications with the internet of things. I chose this course because it is a combination of tech and core branches, providing me with more opportunities for the future. The faculty is well-qualified and helpful and the term exams are well-spaced.The fee structure is moderate with around 10lakh fees for 4 years of BTech and seems worth it as the placement provided and environment is really nice. Though higher than some, it is still affordable enough, and options for scholarships are available.

Name: NAMAN
review:
There are a lot of societies in our university, u just have to say the name of which kind of society u want to join whether it is tech, dance, robotics, space, etc.

Keep in mind there is a lot of scholarship from central and state governments which will give approx 75% fees of 4 yr.

Name: Arpita Oberoi
review: Life at campus is amazing. There is annual gets called Moksha and tech fests, tech weeks, Resonanz and many more. Moksha is conducted in the month of March and Resonanz in the month of August and techweek was conducted in the beginning of February this year. There are Air conditionera in APJ lecture halls. There are all kinds of sports football, volleyball, basketball, cricket, badminton,table tennis, lawn tennis, kabaddi. there is Nsutx app maintained by students where attendance profile, results and college related info is updated. There are many societies as well in the name of extracurricular example dance, music, drama, debate etc. Newspaper is also published by our college.From 5th semester, students become eligible for campus placements. Amazon, Google, microsoft, oracle, Goldman sachs,etc. There are more than 200 companies visiting for the placement. Highest package was 1.25 crore and average package is 8-10lpa. More than 90 percent students get placed on campus. Others choose higher studies or startup. My plan after getting a degree is to go for higher studies abroad.

Name: Shivam Kumar

Name: Manu Raj

There is a different category in Scholarship which is given to you according to your Performance.

Name: Manu sainj

Name: Manish kuamr

Name: Anurag
review:

Name: Ayush Suroya

review: The fees do not hike or the college doesn't do so but the average cost to study here is 4 lacs for 4 years which means 1 lac for a year. review: A lot of events are connected almost every week. Students can enroll themselves in various organizations and clubs to showcase their talent in various extracurricular activities. The students become eligible for campus placements from the 4th year but can bag internships depending upon the skill set from the 3rd year itself. High-profile companies visit the campus like Amazon, Microsoft, and VMWare to name a few. The highest package is approx. 30-35 lpa CTC. The average package is approx. 6-6.5 LPA. CTC.

Name: Mithlesh mourya
review:
Starting from the first year at the time of admission you have to deposit an amount of 55000 or 60000 according to the course as the first installment. The second installment of 23 to 24000 at the end of the first semester in a total of 78000 or 80000 for 1 year then for the next 3 years there is 55 to 57000 per year.
Here you get two types of scholarships first MMVY mukhyamantri medhavi Vidyarthi Yojana and the scholarship given by the central government.
In MMVY you get a total refund of your college fees as well as if you reside in a college hostel that also.
In the central scholarship, you get a refund approximately equal to the college fee but that is only to SC/ST,  the OBC gets less refund.
The third thing is the TFW seat which is a tuition fee waiver in this you don't have to pay anything to the college your whole study is free of cost and this is given to only the 5% of students of any branch with their highest score in Jee.
Since I am in my first year I didn't get any stipend from college.The course curriculum is aligned the same as with RGPV and there are few variations in the subjects provided as SATI is an autonomous body.
Seeing the boom of CS and IT I availed this course.
The faculty-student ratio is approximately 1: 30. As this college is old and well establish so facilities are well qualified but this does not mean that their teaching method is also very good. In any branch of SATI you will get only 2 or 3 teachers with very good teaching others are not good. Some teachers use the digital way or you can say advance for your analysis while others do nothing. This means the main thing is that if you get the right teacher for a good subject like digital electronics and computer science you are at a good level, otherwise you have to do it all by yourself.
In 4 months of the semester, you have two mid sem examinations and one end sem examination in between there are assessment tests according to the respected teachers. The best of two medicine is taken for the final result.

Students waited for upwards of 45 minutes for a lecturer to walk in and start the class. If a lecturer didn't walk into the class within the first 10 minutes of the allotted time, the students should be dismissed and attendance for that lecture must be given. Also, the normalization of taking digital notes should be made common since it doesn't make sense to take handwritten notes for subjects like Computer Science which only has code (the same must apply to exams too)

Chandigarh University has a well-designed course curriculum that is regularly updated to meet industry standards and requirements. The university offers a wide range of undergraduate, postgraduate, and doctoral programs in various disciplines, including engineering, management, law, pharmacy, and more. The curriculum is designed to provide students with a holistic education and develop their skills and knowledge.
The faculty at Chandigarh University are highly qualified and experienced in their respective fields. The university has a diverse faculty from different parts of the country and the world, who bring in their rich experience and expertise. They are dedicated to imparting quality education to their students and providing them with a supportive and engaging learning environment. The university also invites guest lecturers from a reputed organizationthe campus life at Chandigarh University is vibrant and lively. The sports infrastructure is top-notch with facilities for various sports like cricket, football, basketball, tennis, badminton, etc. There are also various clubs and societies on campus, providing ample opportunities for students to showcase their talents and pursue their interests. The social life is also lively, with various cultural events, fests, and parties happening throughout the year. Overall, it's a great place to study, learn, and grow as an individual.

Name: Sanket Dhuri
college: Vivekanand Education Society Institute of Technology - [VESIT]
review:
The course curriculum is intense only during particular weeks (mostly a week or two before end-sem exams). You get too much pressure to handle this week, you have to submit your assignments + journal + study for exams + project submission + any other extra curricular activities if you participate. But after this week it feels like heaven, a feeling that you successfully cleared all these things, more specifically it's like running a sprint in which you have to run/work your best for a short duration. The rest of the time is all yours. 
Faculty is the best, yes it wasn't any grammatical error(intentionally wrote "the" twice), Specifically speaking our maths sir is really chill, he will let you do any stuff if not disturbing the class. But the faculty student is quite low in our college.
Exams are just chill you could even score out if studied a week before, only thing to keep in mind is you need to know how to study effectively with a deep focus.My social life was 0 before coming here. Seriously speaking the gender ratio is the best. There are lots of clubs, and groups, you could participate in and join. The fest is awesome over here. Illusion the main fest of our college was the best week of my life. Books don't ask about them, you get a ton of books just don't waste your money buying books.
Sports are too tough here, you could find every other guy being mastered in any one of the sports you pick. Getting into the athletics team was really difficult even though I used to be a silver medalist in 100 meters at my junior college. So no need to worry about sports activities the thing to worry about is how you become better at that sport.

Name: Krrish Khandelwal
college: IIT Kanpur - Indian Institute of Technology - [IITK]
review:
Annual fests - Here are the name of the fests in IIT Kanpur - ANTARAGNI (Cultural fest), UDGOSH (sports fest), and TECHKRITI (tech fest).
 Antaragni is conducted in the month of march, Techkriti is shown in the month of march or maybe April, and Udgosh is completed in October.

 IIT Kanpur has one of the most extensive libraries in India, called P.K.kelkar library.
Here are 223972+ books and 16000+ E-journals.

IIT Kanpur has the best classrooms. They are fully furnished, temperature controlled, and with internet facility.

Here is a compulsory course in IITK called CPA (compulsory physical activity) for first-year students. Students have to choose one of the available physical activities.

There is a student body called the student's gymkhana. Every clubs, society, and councils are in under that committee. There are many websites for students run by students like every fest has its websites.I chose this course because I am interested in research, and Kanpur has the best research culture. There is an excellent faculty-to-student ratio. There is 500 faculty member on 8000 students. All the faculties are Ph.D.-level qualified. There are some faculty which are not good at teaching, but there are lots of faculty which are very good at teaching. For the exam, it is not easy. You have to take classes regularly and complete assignments on time to at least pass.

Name: Sapna Singh
college: Ganga Institute of Technology and Management - [GITAM] Kablana
review: College life is quite good because there are many cultural and technical fests, debates and many compilations are held from time to time. 'Achiever' is the annual biggest cultural fest here which is organised in march and is for three days. The biggest Punjabi or Haryanvi singers are invited and there is an amazing star-like in the previous one ( Achiver 2K19) Parmish Verma came here. Mankirat Aulakh, Jassie gill, Babbal rai, Ajay Hooda, Sharry Mann and Annu Kadyan were the past guests. There is no Achiver in the previous two years because of the lockdown but this year it will be organised in march ( just a month left:)).prize distribution will happen for Gitam Achievers. And there is an annual sports event, in the previous one, Neeraj Chopra was the main guest. Techspardha is the annual technical fest here. There are many clubs like dance clubs, technical clubs, and singing clubs run by students. And there is a women's cell for women's welfare. I'm a part of a dance club, technical club and women's cell.Campus placement in our college is decent if you work a bit hard you'll easily get a package of 5-6 lakhs, in CSE it is an average package. In core branches obviously, it is low as compared to cse. FTS is a new branch so placement in that field is quite good tho. College is ti-up with 350 + companies, a few of them which I recall are Infosys, TCS, Axix bank, ICICI Bank, Micromax, shoperte, Aviotron airospace, Ashok Layland etc. The average package in CSE is 5-6 lakh and the highest package is 25 lakh ( by Amazon, obviously off campus) in CSE about 85 per cent of students got placed the same in ECE. But in core branches, the average package and the no of students placed is a bit lower than CSE. Students are eligible for placement in their final year. Coming to an internship, you'll look into it by yourself. You should look for an off-campus intership, the college only provide a link. My plan is to get a good job whether it is via on-campus or off-campus placement drive or in PSUs through GATE:-).

Name: Rishika Shresth
college: IIT Jammu - Indian Institute of Technology - [IITJ]
review:
The campus is designed to provide students with a supportive and engaging environment with a variety of clubs and activities to promote social interaction and personal development. Name: Satwik Sayan Ghosh
college: ISM Dhanbad - Indian Institute of Technology - [IITISM]
review: The course structure is very well planned. The micro schedule and the number of lecture hours for each topic are included in the lecture plan. The faculty members-to-student ratio is good enough. The professors are well-qualified, learned and helpful to students. However, Some professor cannot deliver their knowledge properly to students. Teaching is done in hybrid mode using both a smart classroom and a blackboard. Quizzes are conducted regularly throughout the semester and they carry marks to the end semester. Exams are conducted timely and strict discipline is maintained during the exam so that no one can do cheating. Even bio breaks are not allowed during the exam.The fee structure is similar to other IITs.Even the fee of IIT ISM Dhanbad is lower than most of the IITs.The course fee per semester is around 1 lakh. The mess fee is 23 thousand and another fee is 8 thousand. So, per semester total fee is 1 lakh 33 thousand. A total Fee waiver is given to those students whose family income is less than 1 lakh per annum. Those students whose family income is upto 4 lahks, have to pay only mess fee and other charges that totals to 33 thousand only. The scholarship amount of 6 thousand was given to tuition fee waiver students. Other scholarships are also given by the institute to the SC and St students.

Name: rishab
review: moksha is the largest annual cultural fest that happens in march of every year it is among one of the biggest fests in north India. the campus is enormous the library area is well-equipped with tons of the best books, and the classrooms are also well-equipped with ac and charging ports on each desk. the sports facility is available for almost every sport. there are a lot of societies in college like ashwamedh, ares,junoon etc.the fee for the first year is 219000 and it increases by 15 percent every year there is a scholarship option also available for financially weak students some of these scholarships include mcm the details can be found on e district Delhi website

Name: Bishal Sarkar
review: College life is pretty decent in NSUT if we put aside the 75% attendance policy and some strictness like there are lots of societies to join for a student as per their interest. NSUT conducts the annual fest Moksha which was so famous for the greatness and fun in Delhi and societies also conduct their annual events like Tech week, ethnic day, and all. The library of NSUT is pretty big and well ordinated, you will find all kinds of books and journals related to your interest and related to your course/branch. The amenities in the classroom for a first-year student are fabulous, for first-year students, their classes are held at APJ Halls and they are really huge and well advanced but after the completion of the first year, they shift to their department buildings that are a regular class like wooden desks and a blackboard / green board. There are lots of opportunities for sports and extracurricular activities on campus if you're interested and willing to do. There are lots of societies to join.I chose the course of CSE specialization in mathematics and computing because I want a CSE-related branch because all companies allow CSE-related branches to sit in their interview during placements session and I filled out the choice filling sheet according to the cut-off of the university and according to the rank of mine in JEE Mains I got the CSE'MAC branch. There is 1 faculty (professor) for the 89 student strength in each subject in my branch. The qualifications of the faculty are high, they are highly educated and trained, their teaching method is also very helpful and nice but there are always some exceptions are there. The term exams happen timely, the class tests happen regularly in the NSUT and the difficulty level of the term exams is moderate not to hard not to easy if you studied for it.

But here sports and extracurricular activities are being prioritized as there are martial arts sessions in the morning followed by the dancing girls of the society called HYPNOTICS and many more including basketball and football. The washrooms are well maintained. They have drinking water made available on each floor. There is free Wifi for students but is not made accessible everyday.
Campus: We don't really have a very big campus. It's just a building. You will get a Photo Copy and Stationary shop near the building. There is also an ATM nearby.
Events: Sinhgad Karandak is one of the biggest events in Pune. During that week, the entire college is decorated and has many events organized. Our theme for this year was Colors and NBN Sinhgad College was given the color Orange. We had a big Orange Dragon at the entrance of our college. Every floor had sub themes. There was Shivaji Maharaj, Super Heros, etc. Computer Department's theme was Rajasthan.There are technical competitions, inter college sports competition, Fashion I choose the IT course because it's the best course in the college's highest package of all only the IT branch gets all the time
Staff: Just like in every other college, there are a few good teachers and a few average teachers. Some teachers are really good and genuinely want to help students. Most of the teachers are strict and you are expected to write quite a few assignments. There is a TG ( Teacher Guardian) appointed to every 25–30 students. If you have any issues or complaints then you can talk to your TG about it. The teachers have been changing a lot recently and many of our favorite teachers did quit this year. But a good ones are still here. The teachers which quit are still helpful if we need any kind of help.
Attendance: If you do join this college, keep in mind that it is School of Engineering. That means you have to attend college regularly. In the first and beginning of the second year, the TGs even used to call our parents if we bunked lectures.

Name: Neerav Sreekumar
college: IIT Tirupati - Indian Institute of Technology - [IITTP]
review:
The students can start applying for placements in their last year. Many companies including top MNCs visited the campus. IITT doesn't promote the idea of advertising the college through placements, but the placements are actually jaw-dropping for a new college like this. Despite being a 3G IIT, the location plays a crucial role in the placements here. Tirupati is a prime location- 2 hours from Chennai, 3.5 hours from Bangalore, and 6-8 hours from Hyderabad. It has a lot of connections with close institutes like IITM, IISc, CMI, IITH, IIITH, IISERTPT, etc which makes it a must-visit spot for companies and their HR agents. 
The highest package in the year 2021 was nearly 72 lakh, which is insanely high for any new IIT and had overtaken the highest package at IITH and IIT Indore.
In 2022, in phase 1 of the placement, a student from civil engineering got the highest package of nearly 83 LPA, which again was the highest among all the new IITs by a huge margin (IITH had a highest at 63.5 L)I chose Chemicals at IITT because the chemical department here is very good at teaching and research. Having IISER Tirupati at a distance of 2 km is another huge benefit to improve the research culture of the college. 
The faculty-student ratio at IITT is the best among all the IITs (5:1). 
All the faculty members are very enthusiastic, young, open to ideas, and Ph.D. graduates either from IISc, IITs, or some university abroad.
IITT follows a continuous evaluation method with 3 exams- Quiz 1, Quiz 2, and End sem. The papers are very normal and scorable too. 
There have been alumni (students) who have gotten into top colleges like Stanford, ETH Zurich, Princeton etc from here too.
The packages here are also really impressive for a 3G IIT. 
This year, after the Phase 1 placement, the highest was 83 LPA, and last year it was around 70 LPA. In both years, IITT had the highest package among all the 3G and the 2G IITs (including IITH and IITI).

While the normal one just has about 500-600 seats with a proper and clear vision of the board. There is no end to sports and activities you can do here. It also provides ample opportunities for big petroleum companies, in pharmaceuticals, extraction sites, etc. Or you can take that free time and use it to code and go into the IT sector. About the faculty-student ratio for the first year, the course is the same for all the BTech students irrespective of the branch. That is because everyone should get a fair chance at branch change. So there is about 1 professor for each subject per 200ish students and 1 teaching assistant per 40ish students (for tutorials and such). All the faculty members are highly qualified and they have PhDs in their respective courses. Their teaching methods and style are amazing and the profs as well as TAs also take time out to clear your doubts (if you're willing to ask). The faculties here are highly educated and knowledgeable and supportive. review:
I opted for Bachelor in Technology in Computer Science and Engineering as I have a great interest in computers and associated devices. The future scope of this course is great as well.
The faculty: student ratio is 1:80 in the CSE Department for the UG course.

Nearly all the faculties are passouts from elite colleges such as IIT Madras, IISc Bangalore, IIT Kharagpur, etc., and hold Ph.D. degrees. Hence, they're more than qualified to shine their light of knowledge on us. The teaching methods followed vary from faculty to faculty. Some prefer teaching using presentations while some prefer the old-school method of teaching on board. Either way, they try their level best to deliver us the content we need, and make sure we understand every bit of it.
I haven't given a term exam as of yet, as our classes had begun on 28th November due to the COVID Pandemic. But we do have received a schedule for the exams, and our mid-semester exams are going to start mid-January, and end-semesters in March.The fee structure somewhere lies between that of prestigious institutions such as IITs and NITs and that of other prestigious institutions such as BITS Pilani. The overall fees for a 4-Year course in BTech are somewhere between 16 to 17 lacs, including hostel and mess charges.
However, there are various opportunities for scholarships as the GP Birla scholarship, where a student has to lie among certain top students of the college in a semester and can get up to 100% scholarship in that particular semester. Other scholarships include ranks in JEE Main examination etc.

There is financial assistance available for students whose parent's annual income is less than 3 lacs per annum.
There aren't any official campus jobs as of yet. However, there are various startups by seniors of the college which provide various tasks such as content writing, prospecting, etc., and one can earn pretty much enough by joining one of them to carry out their monthly expenditures independently.

Name: vankudothu dheeraj
college: IIT Guwahati - Indian Institute of Technology - [IITG]
review: The campus life and culture at IITG are great. U get exposure to a lot of things. Not only in academics but u get a lot of learning in many different fields like sports, clubs, dance, music many others. There are many clubs available like music club, coding club, analytics club, dance club etc.. where u can join any and learn anything. The annual fest of IITG is called "Alcheringa" which is generally held in February and is conducted in a very flashy and grand way. The tech fest of IITG is called "Techniche" which gives chance to students to share their ideas and improve their practical skills. Classrooms and lecture hall complexes are very comfortable and do have high technology and they are very modern. IITG has a sports complex cum gym called "GYMKHANA" where students can enjoy playing indoor sports like badminton, table tennis, etc. And for outdoor sports, u get enough grounds to play anytime. Many student groups and social groups are being run by students which conduct many activities.I was getting computer science and engineering(CSE) in 2nd gen IIT but I chose EEE in IIT Guwahati because it is an old and prestigious IIT and ranks 7 in the NIRF ranking among all engineering colleges in India. Electrical engineering is also a core branch so u can also get placed in core companies. I also feel that the Electrical branch has great potential in the future so I took this branch. The student-faculty ratio at IITG is pretty good it is around 1-10. U also have other teachers other than lecturers who will help u with your studies. Tutors, Instructors are also present who will help u to get a better understanding of lectures and they will help u solve questions after the completion of a lecture. The lecturers here are highly qualified and seem pretty intelligent but they fail to make average students understand the subject. There will be no person-to-person interaction always in the class so u have to work hard your self in order to get good grades and survive the competition.

Name: Jatin Suresh Varma
college: IIT Guwahati - Indian Institute of Technology - [IITG]
review: IIT Guwahati doesn't only focus on academics. Sports and culture are also the main things IITs are famous for. Spardha, Spirit, and Alcheringa are a few of the cultural and sports fests happening here. The campus life is really very thrilling and good. One can get all the facilities right from a huge sports ground to a good swimming pool. Thus enhancing students' athletic as well. The classrooms are really very huge and good with very spacious seating arrangements. Facilities like water dispensaries and washrooms are also the in the classrooms. Ecell of iit guwahati is one of the website in iit guwahati.I am very much interested in mechanical which made me choose mechanical as my career option. The student ratio at IIT Guwahati is around 1:5 .The faculty here is highly qualified and well-educated. The Ph.D. students and teacher's assistants help us clear our doubts very easily. Each term is of around 3-4 months. It is not much difficult to score well in the semesters. A daily study of around 2 hours is even enough for a good score.

Name: Sanyam Kumar Jain
college: IIT Guwahati - Indian Institute of Technology - [IITG]
review: The central library of our college is very big and contains almost all types of books and journals. It is a great place for self-study. in most of the new classrooms, there is a socket also for charging and the room is fully air-conditioned. In IITs, there is a huge opportunity for extracurricular activities and sports. Almost all types of outdoor and indoor games you can play like cricket, football, badminton, basketball, squash, and many more. The clubs of our college are very active, in a month there are 2-4 events. there are a variety of clubs are there for each individual like dance club, coding club, movie club, and many more.I choose this course because it gives me a variety of options in the future and helps me to follow my interest. Through this course, I can go to government jobs, core electrical and electronics jobs, and IT jobs. There are many faculty in a single course, they are also many Ph.D. students who are teaching assistants (T.A). The profs and other faculty members are all degree holders but their teaching skills are very poor or less interactive. They just read slides and their job is done. Exams here occur very frequently and to ace the exams we need to study regularly.

Name: Akshay A
college: IIT BHU - Indian Institute of Technology
review: The college host 3 major fest in a year. SPARDHA is the annual meet to showcase the sports and athletics strength of the campus. TECHNIC is the annual techno-management fest of the campus where people come together and collaborate to make the world a better place. KASHIYATHRA is the annual socio-cultural fest which is also one of the prominent fests in India. Besides these, there are other fest and workshops conducted by clubs and councils. The library on the campus is well maintained and almost all books are available in either physical or electrical form. There is even a special amenity for SC-ST students an SC-ST Book bank. The classrooms are also good. Every class has its projectors and screen and can accommodate at least 100 students. The campus has 3 grounds and a student activity center (SAC) to promote the athletic and sports hobbies of students. The campus has many achievements in sports, social and cultural activities run all India level.I choose BTech+MTech in Pharmaceutical Engineering and Technology at IIT BHU because the college is a pioneer in providing in BTech degree in pharmaceutical engineering. It is the first university in Asia to do so. Also, the course has a very high scope in the research field.  The faculty here are very good. Almost everyone has done their Ph.D. from premium institutes in both India and abroad. Most of them teach in both Hindi and English and use slides to teach. Although there are some teachers whose teaching methods are not so good. This is mostly because many of the students are from a non-biology background, but the course expects us to study some basic biology. The professors are very helpful and are available 24x7 for doubts and other help. We usually have a mid-semester exam and an end-semester exam. I have not yet attempted one, so I cannot comment on exams. But overall academics is good if you are willing to put in some effort.

Name: Harsha vardhan

review: I chose this course because l am interested in design and I want to become the best designer in the world. In this course, we have highly qualified faculty and all of them are Ph.D. holders. I am feeling bad to say that the girl ratio compared to the boy ratio is very less. All the faculties are Ph.D. holders, and the teaching method is good. For every four months, there is an end semester it's not that much difficult to pass.The campus life of a student is beautiful, there are many new places to explore on the campus itself. Name: OM SATYAM
college: Indian Institute of Information Technology Design and Manufacturing - [IIITDM]
review: I have chosen the smart manufacturing branch because of my jee mains percentile which was around 94. The course and curriculum of our college are very good. Most of the teachers are very helpful as well as very interactive so there should not be any problem for doubts solving as well as for communication. Every teacher/faculty of our institute holds a Ph.D. or doctorate from a foreign university. Exams are very much difficult you will get a 9.00 cgpa in your dreams, but not in reality.According to recent year data, the overall average package of our college is around 15 LPA highest salary package offered is 43lpa from the CSE department. The average package for ece was around 15 LPA and cse was around 19lpa which is better than many top nits.

Name: Poorvi Yadav
college: Guru Jambheshwar University of Science and Technology - [GJUS&T]
review:
University organises youth fest, talent search programmes, Diwali mela, athletic meet and a lot of extra curricular activities. There are several clubs like NCC, NSS, coding and many more.
There is a library in which books referred by teachers and many more apart from them are available. The library is provided with separate reading rooms, lab work, newspaper and magazine rooms etc.
Classrooms consist of fans and good-quality benches. Sports are too good at this university. There are separate coaches for basketball, badminton, football, volleyball, kabaddi, handball, etc. And different sports have different grounds. Students who are interested can play in the morning and evening as well. The coach is very dedicated to working with students.Dates are scheduled for exams and it is not very tough to pass, you have to study and that will get you good grades. If you are an average student you can score well i.e. if you study for like 2 hours per day.
The faculty is good and punctual, we have class from 8:30 a.m. and none of the classes is cancelled any day. There are approx 60 to 70 students per class. Faculty teachers are almost all Phd and they hold good and long teaching experience.

Name: Sudheer
review: Completed 6-semester students are eligible for campus placements. In best company placements.I choose this course because this course is very in demand in the now and future and the ratio of faculty and students is 1:10 and very excellent faculty and term exams are going on on time and very easy to pass term exams. Don't worry about term exams.

Name: Ritesh
college: Guru Jambheshwar University of Science and Technology - [GJUS&T]

The term exams are almost easy because our syllabus and revision have already been done by the faculties.

college: GB Pant Delhi Skill and Entrepreneurship University, Okhla-I Campus

Name: Atharva Badgujar
college: Modern Education Society's College of Engineering - [MESCOE]
review:
The college campus consists of 5 colleges and one of them is MESCOE.
COE has a single 5-floor building.
The building is clean and well-maintained.
Infrastructure is quite good.
Classrooms are ventilated but still in summers, you would feel like it's too hot inside the class.
Each class has a Blackboard,a whiteboard, and a projector.
The Library is big with all books available which you will need.
There are many reference books.
The college conducts an annual fest called Jhankaar.
There are clubs like robot club, google developers club, and nakshatra club for astronomy.
I don't know about sports activities because I am in FE, maybe it would be from the second year.I took Computer engineering because I had an interest in it.

Most of the teachers are pursuing Ph.D.

Each class is divided into three groups, each group has one parent-teacher.
So whatever problems you face you can discuss them with your parent-teachers.
Teaching is good, teachers teach with the help of a projector and at the end of the chapter they share the pdf.

Name: Vibhanshu
college: IIT Guwahati - Indian Institute of Technology - [IITG]
review: Alchreinga is the annual cultural fest of IIT Guwahati and is conducted in February. Techniche is the annual tech fest at IIT Guwahati. There are many clubs for students to join and there is a club for almost all the activities one can imagine. The library becomes a hotspot during exam time. Almost all the course textbooks are found in the library and students can either issue them and take them to their hostel room or can study from books sitting in the library itself. Classrooms have all the basic amenities like projector, screen, air conditioner etc.Fees at IIT Guwahati, being a govt. college is less than most of the Btech. colleges of India. There are many scholarships for students who cannot afford the fees of college and there is also a provision of interest-free loans in case the student wants to take a student loan. SC/ST doesn't need to pay tuition fees. There are many opportunities for students here. Many companies take students for internships and offer them PPOs. The stipend student get is also very high compared to other colleges in India.

Name: SUMIT SHARMA
review: I chose this course because this was the best I was getting on the basis of my rank. IIITD has the most qualified or we can say the best faculty over other colleges which comes under JAC counselling and the faculty-student ratio is decent you cannot say anything that there are few courses in which 2 professors deal with 400-500 students divided into 2 sections or sometimes there's only a class of 10 students. Most of the faculty are very well qualified from the top Institutes all over the world. Every sem you have midsem examinations and endsem examinations after that you will be having biweekly assignments and quizzes. If you keep going with the topics taught in class then it's easy for you but if you think you will study the night before the exam then it won't work here.IIITD's campus is far better than other colleges like DTU, and NSUT because they are large but they have old buildings and infrastructure. IIITD does not have that much area but still has better and well-maintained infrastructure. ODYSSEY is the annual fest and finally, it is going to happen in January 2023 CADENCE will also be announced soon. Each club has its own flavour and sports are at their best here we just had inter branch sports competition then after that individual sports activities and recently we had a Cricket Premier League just like IPL and next week there will be a football League so I guess that's enough to understand.

Name: Devansh Vora
college: Mukesh Patel School of Technology Management and Engineering - [MPSTME]
review:
There are loads of social clubs and groups in the college.
Every group Focuses on a different new thing to learn.

20% of the students who are good in academics and have good skills get a paid internship and the rest get a normal unpaid one.
But no matter what these internships are a great opportunity for us to learn new things and are very helpful.

review: Computer science and engineering are one of the most popular and effective courses in today's world. Scholarship namely the Swami Vivekananda scholarship provides Rs.5000 per month to engineering students who have come from West Bengal board background. One can also apply for private scholarships. Based on the family income we can also apply for a tuition fee waiver.

review: Life at the campus of this college is quite good and nice the students here are quite friendly so they just play here and have fun together seniors and juniors are also quite nice with each other, they play with each other, they eat and have fun together. review:

There are 5 categories in which fees for the same course increase. If you don't have a good score in VITEEE and you want a specific course that you can't get by your rank, then you can try by paying more in the next categories.

Name: Rythm Gupta
college: IIT Delhi - Indian Institute of Technology [IITD]
review:
Fees for general category students in IIT are 1,66,500(including mess, hostel, and other fees) per semester. So fees are roughly 3 lac per year with slight variations of around 10k-20k in other IITs.

If you are SC/ST cat. the student then your fees are around 18k-20k per semester or even less. You will also get a scholarship of 1000 per month from Institute no matter what your family income is.

If you are a gen/OBC cat. a student with a family income less than 5 lac/annum, your 2/3rd fees will be waived off.

If your family income is less than 1 lac/annum, full fees will be waived. Moreover, you will be provided financial support from Institute.

P. S. Banks will give loans up to 5 lac without interest, without any guarantee for all IIT, NIT students no matter what their financial background is. You can even avail loan of up to 9 lac and its interest will be paid by Institute, you just need to pay money. So, don't worry about fees, all things will take care of and aid will be providedIITD has the smallest campus at around 320 acres, but on the plus side, it's bang in the middle of Delhi. The campus doesn’t feel small though. On my first day here, I was totally blown away by the sheer size of it.

The academic area is pretty decent, and I really like the Bharti Building, and in particular the GCL (General Computing Lab), which is like a second home for our department. The classrooms vary from huge comfy AC-equipped to antique stuffy ones.

The studies are no cakewalk - this is an IIT after all. And you'll come to get exasperated with the multitude of exams: two minors, one major. So mostly you'll be dreading, preparing, or giving exams throughout the semester. Not to mention quizzes, assignments, practicals, etc. Your mileage with marks may vary, but it's not extremely hard to scrape through most courses.
The quality of faculty varies, but CS profs are thankfully comparatively chill. Overall though, IMHO, the faculty could be better

Name: Prashant Pandey

While for others, it is time to get serious about their career and study thoroughly for a brighter future.Most expect that by attending college and graduating they will be able to find a good paying career with benefits in a field that will interest them. Name: Kshitish Shekhar Jha
review: Previously the college followed the MAKAUT syllabus, but, since past few years as the college has been reframed as an autonomous institute, there's been a revolutionary change both internally and externally. Currently, everything is evaluated and sorted in terms of quality of education and teaching. Talking about the industrial visits; there were enough not only to have an idea regarding the type of work and environment in industries but also to have an early experience in it. Every year there are almost 5-6 industrial visits by our college for the students. Overall the faculties are great and quite student-friendly. There's nothing like a student-teacher relationship, rather a friendship relation. The teachers here are always interactive with the students and try to fix and resolve the issues that concern the students. In my opinion, every faculty is at their best because it's impossible to select good teachers among all, but still, I have a name who helped me a lot since my first day in college, he was none other than current HoD of Physics dept. i.e., our Honourable Mr Subhomoy Singha Roy.The college celebrates every festival irrespective of anything. The involvement and effort shown by our teachers are at a peak point. All the technical, cultural and management events held at our college campus. Events like- tech-fests, CSI workshops, Hackathon, etc., are major among all the events which create a deep-sensational impact on the students and influence them to participate more and more. There is only cricket, football and table-tennis played in sports and games. Events are held in our college from time to time. Some of them are for technical and some are enjoyment type fest. Almost the college life is better than any other college of this fees range.In my college, the number of professors is almost good and all are well qualified from great institutes. Most of the classes are taken by the guest facility, who have no good qualifications and knowledge is the bad point, which I observed and this happens many times. Our professors are good. Name: Vasudha Acharya
review: The Gender ratio is comparatively better in comparison to loads of college's in India, with girls and boys present almost proportionally with the exception of the mechanical engineering department. The students are incredibly diverse with people from all over the country seeking admission at SJCE. Students from different parts of the state, North India, North East and other places in South India study here. You can also see several students from different economic status, from immensely rich to middle class to rural students as well, but there's no stratification and everyone mingles with everyone. The labs are rather old but each branch conducts lab in sessions so that everyone gets singular access to equipment. The course curriculum is updated each year to always stay relevant. The syllabus though accredited is mostly theory based and practicals are less. We follow 5 event based system where each internal assessment or event is considered, leading things to get rather stressful at times. The syllabus is definitely more hands on with industry knowledge but I feel it's better to have more labs for better learning. Videos, smart boards and other tools are used to impart education and industrial visits are arranged each year. All in all, though the curriculum design is good there's still a little room for development.

Name: Ankit Jaiswal
college: IIT BHU - Indian Institute of Technology
review:
If there is something which every student likes about the college, it would be the ambience that the college offers. The college is strewn with tress and vegetation. Campus life at IIT (BHU) is simply amazing, which can be vouched by every student studying there. There are over 20 clubs under six councils which ensures that we have enough options to go after our hobbies and passion. The clubs include the Literary Club, The Aeromodelling Club, The Business Club, The Film and Media Club, The Robotic Club, The Kashi Utkarsh for social causes, The Club of Programmers among many others. Each of the clubs organizes competitions and workshops for the students regularly. It won't be an overstatement to say that the students learn more from these clubs than they do from their academics. Even the sports facilities are world class, there is an option for nearly every game- we have a cricket field, hockey and football fields, Athletics track, Lawn tennis and Basketball court. The construction of an indoor sports complex just recently begun in the lockdown. The availability of these facilities is the reason that we hold the largest inter-collegiate sports fest, SPARDHA, every year.
The diversity we see in the college is also unique. The college even though situated in the Gangetic plains boasts of having the highest number of people coming from south India to this college than any other. One even sees many students from the North-East. The percentage of girls has significantly risen after the introduction of supernumerary seats by the government. Hence, the gender ratio has substantially improved from what it was three or four years ago.
When it comes to tolerance towards the people of other race, gender, ethnicity etc. there is no doubt people respect others a lot. They are very encompassing the other people's beliefs and treating it with respect.
As of now, there is no student politics in our college. There is this student parliament whose elections are held every year under the purview of the college administration itself.The course curriculum is well laid-out and clear, offering only major in the branch one is enrolled in. The provision to bring minor in other courses of one's desire is under the process. The exam structure is pretty fair, though sometimes professors fail to complete the whole academic syllabus due to less time allotted under the academic course. On an average, there are 35 lectures of an hour each for a course, which is less; it must be around 40-42, as I see from the courses on NPTEL and also the complaints of professors to have a week or two more for their course. Moreover, the syllabus really needs to revamped according to the latest industrial requirements. There were two industrial visits that were organized by our branch society only. The college is yet to take any initiative on its own. Our placements are more than simply good because of a strong alumni network. As far as research facilities are concerned, the college still lacks at it. Though according to the latest news, many research facilities are being set up - the most recent one being the set up of a super-computing facility at the college. The college has been the place where I have seen the best growth in myself. Various clubs, sports facilities, academics, they all have been major contributors in making who I am today.
There are many opportunities to learn if one tries to.
