The main highlight of the college is that everyone is treated equally here and the environment is so peaceful. There are no discriminations Even talked about. Politics form a major factor in college but a healthey competition generally brews, with opposing party students holding friendships higher than politics. The main step in the admission procedure is passing the Kerala entrance examination, KEAM. 12th standard marks along with your KEAM score is considered during allotment and rank determination. 
I opted for chemical engineering here as it is widely regarded as the best college to study this course in Kerala. Also my interested towards chemistry made me choose this course. Once you've been allotted your rank you can apply to colleges from the KEAM web portal and there are 4 rounds of allotment in which after the second round you have to pay the allotment fees if you have been allotted a college. You can either fix the course at this stage or move on if you have given higher options. Further admission processes are done at the college itself.

Name: Niddha Basu
review:
The two primary events celebrated in the college is Technovit - technical fest for 3 days where we have multiple technical events going on from each school- QUBIT, DISENO, CONNECTIVITEE etc. We have several workshops going on in this period. This workshops are actually helpful for the students.
Another fest is the cultural one named as Vibrance, held in the month of February. This is also a 3 day event, where we have multiple showcase of talents, let it be in the field of dance, music, art, craft, drama we have it all. Different clubs do organise these events and make the three days filled with fun and frollic. Everyday we have one special guest from the bollywood industry performing in the evening. These fest is usually held to give a break to the student's monotonous academic life.
Other events include the celebration of cultural festivals such as Pongal, Lohri, Uccharon (bengali cultural festival), etc.
Apart from all these, we also do have celebrations of important days - University day, Independence Day, Republic Day, Women' s day etc.The course is divided into eight semesters with each semester being of approx four months duration. In every semester different courses are offered some from the core subjects as well as other field subjects. This is because VIT believes in acquiring as much knowledge as possible. On the completion of each course, we earn credits. At the end of the eighth semester, we need to have a total of 180 credits for earning the degree. There are 3 exams conducted per semester - 2 being CAT(cummulative exams) and one FAT(final exam). CAT has a weightage of 15% whereas FAT has a weightage of 40%. Moreover there are 3 digital assignments given per semester which have a weightage too. Industrial visits and seminars are also organised for each course in due intervals. We also have a facilty of doing research on topic of our interest under the guidance of any faculty we want to. After these many facilities and assessments, a student is bound to be industry ready and that's why perhaps VIT has a 100% placement record.

review: Well, it varies from person to person. There are ghots who read day and night and there are some guys like me who are relaxed all the times. Entrance exam name - MHCET
Exam date - 10th May
Result Declaration - 3rd June
After the announcement of the result, candidates are called for the counselling.
The MH CET counselling has been started from 7th June 2018.
Candidates have to report to the regional center as per the counselling schedule.
The documents & eligibility are checked by the conducting authority of the selected candidates.
The authority invite the application for admissions after the verification of documents & eligibility.
Candidates have to enter colleges & courses in the decreasing order according to their preferencesThere are atleast 5 subjects per semester of the course.
Course duration is about 4 months long and later 2 months are dedicated to assignment submission, preparation leave,examination and vacation.
Exam pattern - a) Online MCQ test of 50 marks.
b) Theory paper of 50 marks.
c) Internal points based on practical performance and assignment submission of 25 marks.
I consider it as a mediocre level of assessment. More emphasis on practical and regerous industrial level training must be inculcated in curriculum.

And it is good for the CSE and IT branch but you cant say the same for mechanical brance here. In campus placements go upto 12 or 14 lpa for cse and IT but if you really have worked hard during your graduation and had put in those extra efforts you can bag a good package at big companies likes amazon, Microsoft etc. Through offline mode. Also the alumni network is great here you will always get referals from the seniors if your resume can earn that. Ud chalo is a startup of one of our seniors.

Name: Heena Shah
college: Fr. Conceicao Rodrigues College of Engineering - [CRCE]
review: The course curriculum is pretty much what’s needed to build the basis. It arranged different seminars and extra curricular courses which widely helps in placements. Facult encourages students to take part in online quiz exams and courses. The college has different events where students have successfully build race car, taken part in coding competitions. This college falls under the top 8 engineering colleges in Mumbai. The faulty is very experienced. This is a well known college. I got into this college as a direct second year student after I completed my diploma. The availability of seats is 10% of the normal total seats for diploma students. The admission process is same like regular admission process.

Name: Student (Anonymous)
college: SRM Institute of Science and Technology - [SRMIST]
review: Campus Infrastructure is good. All the basic facilities are available like sports courts which include basketball, Football and Cricket ground, indoor badminton hall. The library is really good with automated entry system and a good collection of books regarding all branches and also books for preparation of higher education exams. The labs are good but there is a scope of improvement too. Computer science labs can have machines with a better and updated interface and all the rest of the labs can be upgraded too.Campus Life is very good. The college management conducts the cultural fest, Milan, which has a quite a big footfall with an impressive line up of guests. The Techno-Management fest, Aaruush, is conducted by the students and consists of some really good guest lectures, dicussions and pro shows. They attract a huge crowd with their exciting line up of guests as well.

Name: Student (Anonymous)
college: Chaibasa Engineering College, Techno India Group
review: Faculties of this college are very supportive and helpful not only in study but in life also. They are well educated and many faculties are very experienced and many faculties are done his PhD or doing his PhD and the maximum teachers are from well known engineering colleges like ism Dhanbad (now iit Dhanbad),nit jamshedpur,haldia University,jadhavpur University,iiest shivpur (previously BESU) etc. their teaching techniques are good we get something easily.Infrastructure of this college is very good, the campus of this college is awesome I like it so much. As the college is made in top of the small mountain the scenario of the surroundings are amazing.the college have separate buildings of all branches (but cse and ece are in same building). laboratory have good lab instruments and the library is also good

Name: Student (Anonymous)
review: I didn't put my mains score in government form due to which my rank was more than poor and had no other choice than joining here though it's a decent college having good teachers but the main focus here is only studies.it's good but please atleast give us some real coding make us learn more than what RTMNU asks only C and C++ does not workPlacements are fair enough if you ask the student they do everything possible to get job in our college the package provided is less but seeing other seniors who are successful by getting every experience they say college will not teach you how to learn but College will give you all facilities you need to learn experience that and work

Name: Eshita Singh
college: SRM Institute of Science and Technology - [SRMIST]
review: Due to its good reviews for science and technology department and it’s good faculty I chose this institution and also due to its good reputation within the private institutions and it has good job/placement opportunitiesThere are a lot of extracurricular activities that take place within the campus and all are nationally recognised. I am also a part of techno management fest of my college and I definitely get the best best exposure

Name: Student (Anonymous)
college: SRM Institute of Science and Technology - [SRMIST]
review: It is difficult for Mechanical Engineers and Automobile Engineers but CSE department gets a lot of offers from various companies. Even companies like Google,Amazon come for Placements but chose only 1 or 2 students.For mechanical engineers it's tough to get placed for a high package but I know a few who have done it, so it's possible.Campus life is okay, the fests are great but now they have lost the spark. Although extra curricular activities are very good. As a mechanical engineering student, automobile teams is the best option for skill development and growth.Highly recommended if you are in Mechanical or automobile department.

Name: Student (Anonymous)
college: SRM Institute of Science and Technology - [SRMIST]
review: During placements a lot of companies that you dream of working in come and they bring a lot of opportunities with a lot of perks. As well as the college helps and trains you for the placements so that you get the job you desire. They give you all the opportunities needed for a great profile and the stipends are also at par depending on the performance and exposure in the fieldThe college course is excellent and up to date. They give you a lot of opportunities for industrial exposure, the faculties are at par. Every single one of them is helpful. You will never feel any question unanswered. The great thing is that the academics are made easier with practicals and curriculum knowledge as well as understanding to a great level

Name: Student (Anonymous)
college: Shri Ramdeobaba College of Engineering and Management - [RCOEM]
review: Most of the course had been covered by the teacher and they also provide extra knowledge which can help you in higher studies and to find better jobs and they have experience and knowledge of the things that are trending in current industries and companiesMany companies visits our college and placement are quite good and the students placed have nice income and are happy. One must have good speaking skills and knowledge of particular department and aptitude must be good to get placed in good company

Name: Aryan Mishra
college: IIT Bombay - Indian Institute of Technology - [IITB]
review: These opportunities are good. The selection ratio is really nice with a good amount of median salary. Lots of famous companies come for the purpose of recruitment and almost every student gets placed in some company or the other.All the facilities, sports, gym, wifi, library, labs are amazing. They are available to all throughout the day. All these facilities are well maintained. It's a complete use of the money that we spend on them in the fees.

Name: Student (Anonymous)
college: SRM Institute of Science and Technology - [SRMIST]
review: The course and curriculum are vast and covers all the basics and advance level of the stream this giving the students a great sence of the subject and they are easily able to adapt to the course. The faculty members are great and are supportive towards the students and always ready to help them.Nice campus and great educational opportunities and good placement offers. It has a great co-curricular activities. The teachers and the staff are supportive and always there for help and the students are from all over the world hence providing a great exposure for the students.

Name: Ayush Jain
college: Sardar Vallabhbhai National Institute of Technology - [SVNIT]
review: MindBend, the official TechFest of NIT Surat, was the biggest technical festival of 2020 among many NITs. The biggest attraction was RoboWars which had prize money of INR 100000 which promoted participation from best teams across the country.It is pretty good. The major technical companies hiring Mechanical Engineering students(core) are L&T, Appolo, Morris Garages, etc. The average package by the top companies is around 12 lpa whereas the average companies give around 6 lpa.

Name: Vinamra Goyal
college: IIT BHU - Indian Institute of Technology
review: Campus life is awesome. Everything is just perfect, nothing to repent about. Every year there are 3 fests that occur, cultural, sports and technical. Our cultural fest, Kashiyatra happens to be the biggest cultural fest in North India. Spardha, the sports fest is huge. About 18 different colloeges represent themselves here. And in Technex, the technical fest also several colleges participate and there are numerous events in there. In every fest, there are 3 pronights. Celebrities like Bollywood singers, Punjabi singers come to make the event graceful.I have availed loan facility from PNB, Susuwahi branch, BHU. At the time of admission, the bank employees will themselves acknowledge you of everything required to avail a loan. They happen to be really helpful. And at the time of fee submission at the start of every semester, they will be of great help. One will not find any difficulty in the absence of their guardians.

Name: Student (Anonymous)
college: Mahavir Swami College of Engineering & Technology - [MSCET]
review: I have my own interest related to computers and more. It has good scope for students having interest in computers(softwares, networking, hardwares etc) There are further many such cources to learn, it's a scopeful subject which can lead to a bright future for serious studying student.Good behavior can be observed among the faculties. always ready to help, involvement in each and every activities, whether it's related to study or some fun activities. Except, of study they are even concern about celebrating different days of year.

Name: L sai teja reddy
college: Jawaharlal Nehru Architecture and Fine Arts University - [JNAFAU]
review: The course structure is more different than other normal courses, Most of the faculty are contract based and some are very young. Coming to examinations, in our course every semester we have studio(drawing) subjecr for sure, which is only Viva type, and every written subject has 8 chapters and there will be 8 questions in each exam, one from each chapter, any of the 5 should be written. There is most probably no role of these making me a professional, but we have seminars for every 2 weeks, from experienced people who are working in various companies. Coming to gender ratios it is of about 2. 5:1, our college has a full fledged freedom for the students. We have some sports events during the time of fest, but conducted on our own expenses, Even the fest is on our own expenses. Coming to workshops, we probably have a workshop every month and also attended a major workshop in National Academy of Construction, Hitex, Hyderabad. There are no bias regarding gender, religion, race etc.

Name: Muskan Kachhela
college: Shri Ramdeobaba College of Engineering and Management - [RCOEM]
review: Our College has started with a new curriculum this year itself. Now, the syllabus is much easier than the previous batches. We have practical sessions everyday. Our class of 60 students is divided into 4 batches for practicals so that all the students can gain deep knowledge from practicals. The faculty is very friendly, we have special groups on whatsapp where we can interact with our teachers personally and get our doubts cleared anytime.Our college organises many events every year. We have Pratishruti which is 5 day event in which we have various bands coming to the college every evening, it also involves a lot of competitions like treasure hunts, Tug of wars, sports etc. We have Technovision which is another 3 day technical event which involves quizzes, competitions, workshops. Also each branch has its own events and workshops organised every year.

Name: Tushar Patle
college: IIT Kharagpur - Indian Institute of Technology - [IITKGP]
review: Expect for the gender ratio the campus like is great, the hender ratio was around 7:1, the work culture is very good thecampus is free to roam 24/7. No restrictions. There are a large number of clubs, cells, societies in the campus for almost all the purposes varying from robotics to debating to dancing to eastern and western music. The sports facilities are very good. The diversity of campus id the same. As diversity of India, the economic status of the students vary from rich to poor but that does not keep you from doing anything in the campus. Yes as everywhere else there is some politics, the hostels and mess are student run and so they have Student Representatives, nso that is natural but I gener it does not affect your life much, the bonding between hall mates is that of brothers, we are a huge family, living eating, playing and growing together. It is a government institute, so depending on your family income, you have to different fees, and it is affordable but not very cheap. Yes the fees structure is very transparent. And no additional donations are required to get into college, the entrance exam is the only way to get into the college. Also if your income is less than 1lpa then there is no tution fee for you. There is a MCM scholarship. And also easily accessible student loan.

Name: Student (Anonymous)
review: The college is Reputed, has Good academic history, Good placement records. Many of my acquaintances have successfully passed out and are doing well. A lot of opportunities for the students including co-curricular activities. It is one of the most popular private engineering colleges in India.The syllabus is quite good. They all are on-trend and more conscious over their syllabus and taking slip tests, revision tests. Teaching us out of the box too. Moreover, there are a lot of facilities with enormous knowledge. Dr.A.kadhar Lal sir, Dr.Abith Basha sir, and Dr.Masthan sir.

Name: Praneeth Chandra
college: Jawaharlal Nehru Architecture and Fine Arts University - [JNAFAU]
review: I got admission into JNAFAU through the state entrance exam for undergraduate courses (EAMCET) and after opting JNAFAU in the college selection period I was allotted a seat after the scrutiny done by the government for allocation of seats to students with respect to their marks in 12th and score in the entrance exam, I chose this course as it is a multi-disciplinary course with which one can know all aspects of a building from inside and outside.The fee structure is feasible for may students added that state also provides with scholarships amd rewards for merit students. The mode of payments is either online/DD/ challan from the bank associated with the college amount decided by the board has to be paid to secure the admission for respective course and yes the college provides a breakdown of the fee that has to be paid.

Name: Ajay
college: Jawaharlal Nehru Architecture and Fine Arts University - [JNAFAU]
review: The fee structure is feasible on spot admission costs 10k and the yearly fee costs 40k  As the university is gov university it mostly accpets challan payment mode they provide us challans and gotta pay it in the bank There are additional charges for everything we want the college to  For any certificate xerox or anything theyll cost amount.Our college have campus interviews and also provides internships but those internships shud be joined by ourself  And those internships arent of much use regarding this subject yet as they provide certification we are joining for our own good and if you persue this course with a goood grades then you can get high class interns and jobs.

Name: Swatilekha Roy
review: There are namely two annual events, the technical cum cultural fest ESPERANZA and the Freshers to welcome newcomers called CROESO. Both events involve active participation and a variety of eventofto trigger the creative auras of every student. Apart from that, frequent independant low fund events are also conducted by the various college clubs.Since this is a state government affiliated institution, the entrance pricedure is conducted on the basis of the merit ranks acquired by students in the state technical entrance called WBJEE. This college has an outstanding location, right by the banks of River Torsha and is a relatively new college with newer and more advanced infrastructure.

Name: Reyan crasta
review: The core companies related to every branch will visit the campus.currently we have 140+ companies visiting our campus.as a process of recruitment companies conduct appitude , technical appitude , group discussion, and hr round.most of the students are likely to be placed on campus drive.yes institution provides the special classes to prepare ther student for campus drivesFee structure are based on the admission through which u have taken.if the admission is through entrance exam ther fees will be bit low.if the admission is carried out through management the fees will be bit high.but the concession will be given based on the marks of 2nd puc.yes college provides transparency in fee breakdown.no additional fees.cheques dd accepted

Name: Shravan Mattoo
review: In my point of view it is little bit expensive like my fee structure is 1. 5 lakh Per annum So I think it should be between 1. 1lakh per annum bcz it's hostel fee is 30thousand for 6month it is expensive and for non Ac room's for Ac room's you have to give 33, 000 or for 2 seater Ac room you have to give 37, 000 So it is expensive. You can pay ur fee offline and also online by UPI, Debit card, credit card, Paytm, Phonepe, Googlepay or also Rimt University have there website and app also. There are many events that occurs in the college like fresher's, Agaaz, Dj night, Celebrity night, Republic day celebration, Modelling, Fashion modelling etc there are many events for technology students also like Technophillia, web design, tech design for gaming there are also Pubg events that occurs in the college and in sport there many events that occurs cricket, basketball, football, roller skating tournament etc.

Name: Student (Anonymous)
college: Sant Longowal Institute of Engineering and Technology - [SLIET]
review: Labs are good and you can make great use of them personally if you convince the teacher enough. There is a gym in campus and timings for boys and girls are divided so that all of them can take its advantage and same goes for swimming pool. The library is fine with the right books available and most of the study material can be borrowed and there is a minimal need of buying books. Wifi is not the best because lots of people use them and you may sometimes find it annoying but it works great when less people are present or if people are sleeping. Infrastructure is good and becoming great with time passing as investments are being made for new buildings and good equipment.Life will seem boring if you choose not to do any extra activities. It is your choices of that are going to decide how your your life is going to be in campus. There is no burden from college and students have a lot of time and can take part in as many activities as they want without any attendance issues or workload. Events like techfest and cultural fest are the best and you get to meet and compete and have fun all at the same time but it takes efforts of people involved in organizing and bringing sponsers.

Name: Harish kumar
review: Due to less fee when compared with other institutions and also it will provide campus placements for students and also helps to bunk classes. It is located behind the national highway and my friend is studying in that college so I preferred that institution.We have updated syllabus according to the time, the faculties was very good especially the political science.

Name: Harsh gupta
review: The whole 4 years of course has been divided into 8th semester.  Each semester consist of 3 internal written exams along with 2 10 min-quiz, 2 lab internals, 2 assignments, 1 lab external and 1 final semester exam.  1st week of 1st year college starts with induction program to introduce about the academics rules and regulations, culture, placement etc about college.  In 2nd year also, they organize industrial visits for Students to gain practical knowledge.  The overall academics of college is good as they don't skip a single topic of syllabus.  Further various branch-wisr and annual cultural and technical fest are organised in college by the respective departments and team. I gave the COMED-K Entrance exam on 13th May, 2018. Result came 28th May, 2018. Then counselling started on 16th July till 8th August in 2 rounds with different slots according to rank. In counselling center, there was big screen showing the latest update of no. Of vacancy seats available in different college and branches.  In first round, I got CSE in JSSATE, Bangalore then got upgraded to ISE in RNSIT in 2nd round.

Name: Manoj Bahadur
review: As I am currently studying Computer science engineering.  The education is average as the all the faculties are new.  The college has only been 3 years opned.  There is no placement done as the finals year student havent passed out yet.  There has not been doen any industrial visits yet. I got throught The admission through writing the exam that is KCET.  All the details you can see from the kseebcet website for the admission procedure.  There are other exams also like jee which u can join.  Other method is through writing the entrance exam which is done by the college.

Name: Student (Anonymous)
college: Adi Shankara Institute of Engineering and Technology - [ASIET] Kalady
review: Nearer College, good placements, One of best college, Known friends, Proper bus route, Proper Guidence, calm college surroundings. I'm from a below Average family all other colleges I got selected were told to pay one time payments. At that time we could n't able to it. Here ASIET college they helped they given time to pay 1 year money within 2 semesters. So that was helpful for us. I took an education loan.Sports facilities good, WiFi less but I have my phone network, library OK, equipment in Lab clean and perfect. In computer labs network is free so can use the computer in library, labs etc. Evening sports activities but I could not stay for practices due to my bus timing. Hostel facilities are available with good facilities and food.

Name: Student (Anonymous)
review: Many companies have visited our college for placements and there are many notable alumini in sports,technology and film industry. Our college as said is one of the prestigious colleges in the state and there is an e cell in our college,club capitalize which is very successful and organizes and even know as enantra every year. There are companies,startups approaching the events who give internship and job offersThe sports facility is very good and the college offers wide range of sports,it also consists of gym and indoor sport.Tamil Nadus biggest library is the library in anna university, wide rage of sylabus books and engineering and technology books are available. The labs are quite equipped with modern equipments.

Name: Argha Kundu
review: Campus Infrasturcture, well, doesn't matter how much I say, it will still be less. So, its better, if possible for you, then you can visit our campus, or get campus tour videos on YT. There are 8 gates, well equipped with indoor and outdoor stadiums, canteens, hostels for boys and girls, food cafe, departmental store, and many more. The campus provides us with wifi facilities in departments. Even hostels have wifi connections too. The labs are well furnished, with lab assistants of very well behaviour. Last but not the least, NEHU has got a central library which was established along with it in 1973. It is truly a wonderful library.First and foremost is that, NEHU is a central University, providing all the facilities that are available in any other central universities, which undoubtedly are much better than private colleges. Secondly, the soothing climate and scenario of Shillong pretty much increases your urge to study, as studying in such an enhanced environment is a bliss. As my course is B.Tech(ECE), the professors of our School Of Technology are really very good and much qualified. It was my wish to pursue Electronics Engineering after 12th, and I got my dream stream in NEHU.

Name: Manisha kumari barnwal
review: There are almost 10-15 lecturers and they are fantastic in teaching. They help to clear all our doubts and give us the experience of lab and industry. They give us all the knowledge required for further study. They are punctual and make us do assignments and practicals to gain extra knowledge about the course.Through Indian embassy compex scholarship scheme. I am from Nepal. I had filled the form of compex scholarship scheme and I had given entrance exam via online. I passed the exam, then was called for interview and was sent to this university. Then I fulfilled all the requirements for admission criteria.

Name: Student (Anonymous)
college: University College of Engineering and Technology - [UCET]
review: The alumunis of ucet didn't get placed even.as this college is established in 2007 it is taking its all efforts to better the situation. Now placements are taking place. About 17 students were placed in companies like tech Mahindra with an average package of 3-4LPA. Since this college is in very remote area companies don't visit rarely. The placements are organised by the startup and placement cell of the College.Our seniors and we have same syllabus. A little bit of changes is observed in common subject of ECE and CSE. There is not much industrial exposure here but internships may help in exposure. The faculities are great. They are very cooperative and teachers are very friendly. Mr Pramod Goswami is a teacher who taught us chemistry is great and very friendly.he is a PhD from IIT delhi.

Name: Mohan
review: Engineering is all about applying science and mathematics practically to come up with solutions to problems we face in our daily lives. S.T.E.M. education is an important learning tool for today’s students. It encourages critical thinking, problem management skills, and uses real world applications to promote innovation. The Department’s program supports educators in providing students with more personalized learning—in which the pace of and approach to instruction are uniquely tailored to meet students’ individual needs and interests—often supported by innovative technologies. Comprising 800 systems in a single LAN, bandwidth of 400 MBPS with power backup  Auditorium - 1200 pax  Exclusive placement block equipped with sufficient GD rooms, individual interview panels and lounge.  Accessible campus from various locations in Hyderabad.  Strong alumni base.  Experienced training and placement team.

Name: Student (Anonymous)
review: I have chosen this college because there were very few college’s in and around Mumbai city which offers BE in Electrical. Despite scoring above 85% in my diploma final year, i didn’t get admission in any other college. Think i love most about this college is the campus, as it is situated little far from city, it really gives a nice felling and conducive atmosphere for studyingCurriculum is designed by Mumbai University and not by college itself. Not all but some of faculties are nice and helpful, but they lag in experience. That’s why the student can’t depend wholly on faculties, he /she will be required to learn themselves sometimes. Not sure about industrial exposure as i am just in my second year.

Name: Student (Anonymous)
review: Well our institute focuses greatly on sports because of some higher authority faculties who themselves indulge in sports with students creating an even more friendly atmosphere. We have a high speed wifi available 24/7 for the students and seperate for teachers. Library is equipped with all the subject books along with the facility of book bank, although there is a scarcity of literature books,novels, stories, mythology, etc. Labs are well equipped with the requirements for experiments, although electronics lab is not that well equipped with the proper equipments.Since the college is only 10 years old, but in accordance to its age, it already has overcome great growth. We have one Tech fest per year, which includes all cultural activities, games, competition, technical games and quizzes, open mics, mock parliament ( which is by far the biggest event of the fest ), our own fashion show and many more apart from that we have one sports class every week. We also have intercollege sports fest held by tge university which goes further to inter university tournaments on national level.

Name: Ishank Bansal
review: College having Very Good On Campus placement as around 200 companies visited the college and mostly ECE courses are preferred and with good percentage of placement every year i.e around 99% and with approx package of 450000. Yes, institution takes a well prepared step to prepare student for the placement season.A gender ratio is around 4:1 4 boys and 1 girl. There is less parties in college campus but you can go out for night parties. There is no tolerance regarding gender, religion, race and sexual orientation. There is no such polities activities as it is a disciplined college and It has good economic status.

Name: Aditya Dinesh
review: I have been qualified in ECET exams.  I have opted this college because it has large campus. It is student friendly. The campus and education in this college is great. They have some many campus recruitment every year. After qualifying in ECET exam I applied to choose college on online. After that I have been approved to join in the college. I got the admission letter in mail. I went to the campus and joined in the campus by paying the building fund.  After a week I've got register in the college and got my I'd card and etc.The course and the faculty who teach us the course are so great. We have every topic that we required to qualify any interview. We have great and spacious labs. The exam structure is good they help us to know that how much we have learnt and help to understand more. The exams are very helpful to us to build confidence and knowledge in us.  Our college consists of research which helps us to develop anything new and useful. It helps us to gain confidence and gives us new ideas to do and gives us better guidance.

Name: Sumant Kumar
college: Punjab Engineering College University of Technology - [PEC]
review: College location and the college reputation both are very good and i was getting my favorite stream that is mechanical engineering and PEC is known for its Mechanical and Civil engineering so that's why i choose this college and i am very confident till now that my decision was right Academics are good , course can somewhat improve but faculties are bit old and some of them don't have that much of knowledge which an engineering student needs so the faculties should be improved and about campus it is good very friendly environment and there is no ragging in college

Name: Jyotri maya swain
review: The faculty in my college is Very important part of my college. The faculty member is very talented. 6 lecturers in my course. Along with the average age is 30-40 years old and higher qualification, as per the hierarchy. Them in providing clarity about the subject is very good. I am ECE student. The course curriculum is very good. The exam structure is very good. Its role in making me a better professional. It is relevant, research-driven and fair. the exam structure is first 2 internal then one semester. The end of semester the results is diclear.

Name: Nisanth
college: Cochin University of Science and Technology - [CUSAT]
review: Its really good course with a very strong alumni. Course Details vary every four years. It Has a very good library and with good faculty. Examinations are on time and results come before the next semester. You have 8 semesters. Final Semester contain project in which you've to prepare ship of given specifications .First you have to write Cusat cat entrance and of which you have to get rank below 400 for general;so as to get this course. Then Through allotment got get it. It is best course in CUSAT. You'll receive email and message to bring the documents for admission.

Name: Student (Anonymous)
college: Veer Surendra Sai University of Technology - [VSSUT]
review: Campus life in burla is really busy and fun.we don't feel bore for one second here because of the college classes and clubs and events and some small trips.In our college we always have some workshop or event to Polish our skills and also we have some fun and singing and dancing events too.In our college we have one technical and cultural festival name as samavesh and vassaunt.It is the largest technical and cultural festival of odisha.All the events are managed by student itself by some precious and tiny tiny advice from our faculties.All the students from odisha and outside of odisha come to burla to enjoy these festivals.If you talk about our book syllabus then it's kind of old,but necessary one.But college give you different platform for your skills development like technical and cultural club. college also give fund for industrial visit and training.The faculties are good and helpful to all the students but not all the faculties are same but we got 90 percentage of good and supportive teachers.Its inappropriate to mention one faculty name all are quite nice teachers in both study and life lessons fields.

Name: Student (Anonymous)
review: Because aerospace engineering is offered by only this Institute in Delhi. It's really good in infrastructure and also has very good faculty. It's focused on all round development of an individual. It was also under a commutable limit from my house.My course is very interesting and taught very well. The curriculum is changed every year as per the industry requirements.also the faculties are very experienced in the fields they teach. Yes we are provided enough industrial exposure.

Name: Ashish Pal
college: GB Pant Delhi Skill and Entrepreneurship University, Okhla-I Campus
review: Every year maruti come and took 2-3 people with the highest package of around 12 lakhs and apart from it many of the students opt for further studies and scored good in gate and cat examination along with it last year 1 passout student ranked 1st in isro all India examination and myself and my friend has started a start-up named thescrap.in you can check it on Google and InstagramThis college was affiliated to ip university and a government college as well in the prime location of ookhla phase 3 where every facility is so near and also the course fee of btech here is very less as compared to other colleges. Also the college has very good seniors and since the college is small you get a family feeling as you know each and every face by their names.

Name: MD EZAZ AHMED
review: After qualifying JEE MAIN in April 2018 I took admission at Malaviya National Institute of Technology Jaipur.  I have intrest in circuit and power system that's why I have chosen Electrical Engineering Course. My college has good placement record, good infrastructure, location and connectivity of college is best. For taking admission to my institute firstly anyone have to qualify JEE MAIN with good rank and then councilling process is done with JOSSA after that college is alloted. Name: Justin Jenish
college: SRM Institute of Science and Technology - [SRMIST]
review:
I got my admission through the SRM entrance which I attended in Bangalore. After the results were out, according to the rank segment you belong to, you're invited to a counseling session at a certain campus on specific dates. I had ktr as my counseling centre. On the day of counseling, all the students gathered will be allowed to view all courses available and how many seats are vacant for each course in each campus. While you view this and remain seated, according to your ranks, you're called to submit your certificates for verification, application form, etc along with a DD of your annual fees and also have a small interview with the staff at the desk. Followed by this, along with one parent, you're directed to a hall of staffs with computers where you can approach any who are free and tell them which course you wish to opt and which campus. They will check the availability of seats immediately and if its available, in the next 3-5 minutes you're allotted a seat and you recieve a printed statement of your course, fee structure etc. With this your seat is confirmed. Later, on the mentioned dates, you are to visit the campus opted and submit your certificates, fill up a few forms and other formality to make it clear that you will definitely be joining the college. This aside, if you require hostel, you fill other forms and apply for it. I had not taken hostel and so I cannot give a very detailed guide to how it works, but I know it's very simple and one just has to submit an application along with a DD of the hostel fees.
I chose SRM because being a private institution, it has certain merits and better placement options. They had CSE with specialization introduced for the first time which back then was only available at SRM. There were many specializations such as cloud computing, cyber security, internet if things, artificial intelligence and machine learning, etc. I chose Big Data Analytics and my campus choice was Ramapuram which I'm certain of and supported by most that's its the best place for discipline and education quality unlike the other campuses where events and ither programs unrelated to the course are given priority and overall has a bad reputation for performance in exams. I'm happy with my choice of campus and course and would recommend it to anyone who wishes to complete the course well than have fun all the time considering its college.I do like the teaching quality. Of course I'm not saying all teachers are very good but most are impressive and have a lot of knowledge beyond what the course requires. Our subjects and its contents and curriculum fortunately are industry based unlike some colleges and their curriculum which just follow traditional engineering books and nothing more. We're taught what's really required and what's currently going on in industry rather than pointless topics which were once a part of traditional engineering. The course has additional subjects, some of them purely aimed at improving students in their physical and mental health such as yoga, critical thinking and creativity, soft skills, history and civics, evs, etc. One additional subject I greatly valued is foreign languages, all students must compulsorily study any of the various choices of foreign language. I chose German and they trained me upto the requirement to write the official German exam. Research opportunities are there and all support is provided to those who are innovative and prove themselves worthy. Placement training starts from first semester, providing us knowledge and practice of right etiquette, communication skills,coding skills, etc. Industry visits are held. As of now, as a 2nd year I haven't had one but my seniors have had and hopefully the same will be provided to us. They provide opportunities to continue your studies outside as well be exchange students or complete half your btech in a foreign university provided you have the required communication skills and cgpa and financing

We don’t mean to toot our own horn, but—beep beep—we have everything you need to find the perfect college. No, really. It’s like having your own fancy private college admission advisor. Except, you know, free. Now, before you dive into your college search, you may be tempted to just skim the subheads below and make sense of these college search steps on your own. But that won’t be enough to really help you. And, believe us, you do not want to take a shortcut through your college search. Instead, go through all of these helpful articles, because if you follow the advice inside, your college search will get way easier. An important note about college costs: We'll get to financial aid in a minute. But as you're figuring out your college search criteria, it's often best to leave cost out of it. Just ignore the "sticker price. " Not that cost won't be a factor—it obviously is—but your goal right now is to find colleges that really and truly fit you. Academic fit. Social fit. Career prep fit. All the fits. Because, when a school is the right fit for you, the financial aid tends to fall into place. And, believe us, financial aid changes everything. (In fact, you might find that the fancy private school that seemed out of reach is actually your most affordable option, once you get their financial aid award letter. ) Eventually, you'll have a spreadsheet (or two) listing out the college tuition and other costs for all your schools, along with the financial aid package they awarded you. You'll have lots of research and data points to look at when making your final college choice, a choice you and your family can afford. You're not there yet, but you will be.Teachers may also use the term “curriculum” to refer to the actual information they teach throughout a class. For example, a teacher may say, “This paper shows the curriculum for my introduction to health science course. ”
Teachers may also search the Internet or ask their colleagues for “more curriculum, ” which means the teacher is looking for more resources to use in a classroom setting. For example, a teacher may ask, “Where can I get more curriculum to fill my Microsoft class?”
Finally, a school, institution, or district can refer to their standards or class sequence as “curriculum. ”
For example, an administrator may declare, “Our career readiness curriculum includes the newest and most cutting-edge skills that employers require in new hires. ”
With that in mind, your standard curriculum typically consists of the following parts:

Name: Nimai Rathi
college: Birla Institute of Technology and Science - [BITS]
review: We have 3 major fests in our college, namely Waves (Cultural Fest), Quark (Technical Fest), Spree (Sports Fest). Cultural Fest draws the largest participation. It is a three-day-long festival held in the late October – early November period. It is a cultural festival that is held annually to celebrate music, dance, and art. It is an inter-college festival with students coming in to participate in events and competitions from across the country. With a footfall of over 40,000 recorded in recent editions, it is one of the leading college festivals in the country. There are many events in various categories like Dance, Drama, Literature, Comedy, Fashion, and Music. Elimination rounds to many of these events are held across various cities in India during the months before the fest. The Professional Nights, often called "Nites" in the college lingo, are a major attraction, with every night in the three-night festival dedicated to a different genre. Both Indian and International artists have performed in past editions. Quark is the annual techno-management festival. Quark usually takes place in early February and has thousands of participants. Launched as a local event in 2006, Quark became a national event in 2008. Since then, Quark has consistently seen participation from colleges across India. Quark usually features various events pertaining to the different engineering branches as well as the pure sciences but has more recently expanded the range of events to include various events, related to entrepreneurship. and business. Spree is the biggest Inter-Collegiate Sports and Entertainment festival of India, organized with the sole aim of promoting sports and social interaction amongst colleges from India and abroad. At Spree, we give you a platform to showcase your skills, learn from others, and grow as a community. Our goal is not only to conduct a sports competition but allow everyone to live an experience. It is in that spirit, that we include mesmerizing cultural nights and a plethora of off-beat events.Student Activity Centre (SAC) is constructed in an area of 37,000 square feet. It is equipped with indoor sports facilities like badminton, table tennis, billiards, squash, carom, dance room and well-equipped gymnasium with all the modern training machines. The SAC has outdoor facilities like cricket ground net practice arena, football ground, volleyball courts, lawn tennis courts, basketball courts and a futsal court too. This facility helps in the overall development of all students. There is a shopping complex inside the campus which provides the facilities of a supermarket, vegetable and fruit shop, cafeteria, gents saloon, beauty parlor, laundry, bookstore and stationery shop. HDFC bank has provided the ATM facility in the campus. Along with this, the State Bank of India (SBI) has provided ATM as well as its branch inside the campus itself. This bank branch provides for all the banking requirements of the residents. One bad thing about BITS is the gender ratio. Being an engineering college, it is dominated by males. Ratio is 7:1 (Boys:Girls). BITS has several departments/clubs which enable students to build their extracurricular activities. Each fest has their own organizing department. Other than that we have sponsorship department, Publicity department, Alumni Relation Department, Photography Department, etc. Various clubs are also there like Dance Club, AeroDynamics Club, Electronics and Robotics Club, Art Club, Nirmaan (NGO), etc. We have each and every sports team, namely Squash, Tennis, TT, Football, Carrom, Cricket, Volleyball, etc. We have students from all over India. We have foreign student which come through SAT's. We even have a LGBTQ community which is actively working towards sensitizing students about LGBT. There is no discrimination on basis of whatsoever.

A college may be a degree-awarding tertiary educational institution, a part of a collegiate or federal university, an institution offering vocational education, or a secondary school. In the United States, "college" may refer to a constituent part of a university or to a degree-awarding tertiary educational institution, but generally "college" and "university" are used interchangeably, [1] whereas in the United Kingdom, Oceania, South Asia, Southern Africa, most of Europe and Africa, and Canada, "college" may refer to a secondary or high school, a college of further education, a training institution that awards trade qualifications, a higher education provider that does not have university status (often without its own degree-awarding powers), or a constituent part of a university (See this comparison of British and American English educational terminology for further information). Etymology	Edit The word "college" is from the Latin verb lego, legere, legi, lectum, "to collect, gather together, pick", plus the preposition cum, "with", [2] thus meaning "selected together". Thus "colleagues" are literally "persons who have been selected to work together". In ancient Rome a collegium was a "body, guild, corporation united in colleagueship; of magistrates, praetors, tribunes, priests, augurs; a political club or trade guild".[3] Thus a college was a form of corporation or corporate body, an artificial legal person (body/corpus) with its own legal personality, with the capacity to enter into legal contracts, to sue and be sued. In mediaeval England there were colleges of priests, for example in chantry chapels; modern survivals include the Royal College of Surgeons in England (originally the Guild of Surgeons Within the City of London), the College of Arms in London (a body of heralds enforcing heraldic law), an electoral college (to elect representatives), etc. all groups of persons "selected in common" to perform a specified function and appointed by a monarch, founder or other person in authority. As for the modern "college of education", it was a body created for that purpose, for example Eton College was founded in 1440 by letters patent of King Henry VI for the constitution of a college of Fellows, priests, clerks, choristers, poor scholars, and old poor men, with one master or goRangrezz is the biggest event hold by college and many teams of about 20 different states participate in it. DTU is a ragging free campus and it is very rare to see some being made fun of about their religion or economic status.

Name: Shivam
review: Fee structure is very reasonable. It is 92000 for 1st year and 90000 2nd year onward anually. For hostel there are three of them with different fee as well. The hostel fee will be in range of 60000 to 90000 anually. Also the transportation charges are anywhere from 10000 to 30000 rs anually depending where are you from.Manipal universitiy is one of the best private college in the country so I have applied for it. I wrote an entrance exam test conducted by the manipal group through which I have taken the admission. I preferred this college because it is the part of manipal group and quality of education is good among other colleges.

Name: NUGALA CHAKRI
review: The faculty are from highly qualified institutes like Indian institute of technology, national institute of technology. By coming from these institutions they had got a lot of knowledge and they are serving their knowledge to us in a beautiful mannerI have not availed any of the scholarship that have been provided by the college. I have not utilised it properly, which have been provided by my college. Now I am trying to utilise it properly. In my view they are providing a lot of scholarships.

Name: Shivam Sakore
review: See I got my admission through the DTE Maharashtra Portal. So if you want to enroll via DTE you have to give MH-CET and there is also an option for JEE Main exam but the DTE people give preference to MH-CET more as compared to JEE. So here is the thing I enrolled to PDEA's College via DTE and if truly speaking this college wasn't my first preference I wanted to go to the AISSMS (RTO) college. But faith took me to this college and truly speaking this college is not also that bad, thing is that the college geographical location matters a lot, but in other sense college has quite good supporting staff's and our principal is the best, he took personal attention in student's academic's and also our TPO he also arranges quite a lot seminar for future references. At last if you are considering to enroll to this college I would say you should because at last college doesn't matter, the thing that matters is our efforts. So every college is best if you are worthy enough.Course structure is good but truly speaking they are also not that good, they teach us every topic of the course but faculty are also not that good is some topics to answer "the out of the box" question. I see you have asked about the research, but you are going to be disappointed that in the college I have never heard about any research of college faculties are pursuing. Other than BE student are doing researches but also not that world changing. And now you are asking about how my day goes in the college. Let me tell you some time it goes chilled and some time hectic, but most of the time it goes chilled.

Name: Piyush Mittal
review: Many cultural events held on a regular basis. Different clubs in our college do several events. The college fest is youthopia which held in the month of November. It is a 3-day fest. Big celebrities come to the fest. Different bands and teams from other colleges take part.The scholarship is given on the basis of marks of 12th and jee mains score during admission and further scholarships are provided on the basis of marks obtained in the semesters following scholarship criteria. Different scholarships are also provided to siblings and girls.

Name: Jayesh Patil
college: Nutan Maharashtra Institute of Engineering and Technology - [NMIET] Talegaon
review: Course Curriculum is quite good, all the people are helpful in new projects. These Projects helps us in developing our knowledge about our field and learning new things. We have many facilities available in our colleges. Digital Library, Library, Playground, Class Rooms, Digital Classrooms, Wi-Fi, Many kind of labs( CAD-CAM, CLP, OS, Thermodynamics Lab), Seminar halls, Canteen, Mess. Medical Facilities are also available in our college such as First Aid.There are many good events and activities take place in our college. Annual functions, traditional festivals are also celebrated in our college. Including that Political Interviews and many other guests lectures take place. Guest lecture often helps in giving info about something new happening around the world or in out surrounding/community. ESL Racing events, Sports Matches on District level are also there which are quite enthusiastic.

Name: Shivendra Vatsa Mishra
review: Our college has a large multiporpose ground also alongside the ground a gym is located and also a tennis court is present. For shuttlers there are two wooden courts present here. Also there are table table tennis boards and carrom boards are provided by the Management.There are various technical and non technical events held throught the year There is a cultural event named pleiades which is held in even semester. In this event a celebrity is invited to perform It has DJ night. Students response is pretty good for these events.

Name: Shlok Sahu
college: Institute of Engineering and Technology, Devi Ahilya University - [IET -DAVV]
review: offer three year LLB degree course. As the number of students grew, the department established its first Centre as Law Centre – I in 1970 and the second as Law Centre – II in 1971. The LL.B day classes of the Faculty of Law were shifted to newly established Campus Law Centre in 1975. The LL.M. and Ph.D. programmes are looked after directly by the Dean. We pursue the case method of teaching law; the department is not dependent on publishers' new editions of books as the case materials of LL.B. and LL.M. are revised by the faculty members every semester with dedication. Printed copies are distributed to all students without profit. In addition, we have a rich print library with e-resources.The faculty members are drawn with diversified knowledge and experience. Professors from other Universities including foreign Universities visit on various fellowship programs and conduct research in this institution. A number of delegations from foreign universities visit the department to share their knowledge and benefit the students. A few Memorandum(s) of Understanding (MOU) have been signed between the department and corresponding departments of the foreign universities. Law teaching has to be socially relevant, technically advanced and needs to concentrate on newer remunerative branches such as IPRs, insurance, negotiations, information technology and laws relating to wealth generation, finances including taxation shall be touchstone of future. The faculties in the department have been pioneers in developing new fields of law like Intellectual Property, Environmental law, Human Rights education, Gender sensitivity; uplifting women and poverty alleviation for the whole country. The faculties have successfully contributed by way of legislative interventions impacting the lives in fighting dowry deaths, introducing accountability of media in helping establishment of Prasar Bharati Corporation, promoting secularism, ushering rule of law for benefit of females and children and fighting against feudalism and oligarchies. It is desired to rise against female foeticide. The senior faculty members have a longstanding tradition of contributing prestigious books and literature in their fields of specialization which elevates the stature of Delhi Law Faculty as a tall academic leader contributing to the spread of legal knowledge throughout the country by training the trainers. We believe that learning does not end in the class rooms; windows have to be kept wide open to invite different perspectives and expertise from diverse sources and practitioners. National and International Seminars, Conferences and Workshops are organized regularly at the department level and in three Centres to share and deliberate upon legal issues and new ideas. Moot Court competitions, debates, group discussions, client counseling competitions are regular features in the three Centres of the Department. Our aim is to equip students to participate in providing good governance in democratic tradition and outshine the competition in all aspects of life. We consciously cater to the large masses and deprived sections through our 7000 students. I am confident that about 30% of our students outclass the best in comparison to students at high per capita expenditure national law schools with just about one tenth of budget allocations and fee.
