Name: DONGARA SAI ROHITH
review: First of all I applied for the online documents verification and then went to an ARC center personally to verify the hard copy of the documents. Then I enlisted the colleges where I can apply to get an admission after this through the cap rounds conducted by government quota I got selected in the above college which one I mentioned before. I chose this field because I like automobiles and I wanted to make a carrier in this field.Extracurricular activities like dance, singing, beat boxing, drawing etc. Students were more interested to participate in most of the extra Cuurricuar activities conducted by college. Workshops like c champ, codewars, robotics nearly same number of students participate from opposite gender. Ratio is nearly 1:1. 5

Name: Ashraya Ranjan Jena
review: The teaching faculty of the course are selected through an entrance exam, many of the teachers are on contract, while some are permanent. The department consist of an HOD and assistant professor for each subject, theory and laboratory. the teachers are quite qualified some of them even holding PHD degrees. My opinion of the faculty will be poor. most of the teachers do not indulge with deep involvment in the subject and explanation of the topic, most of them only teach how to pass for the exam and explanation is really bad. Discipline is also not maintained, numericals are hardly understandable, No relevance with real life scenarios. they ask for assignments which is joke, you have to fill irrelevant pages by copying each other and just fill pages and write blindly which will be bundled up and probably never open. Most of the teachers excluding the HOD and few others teach in native language and they explain mechanical without involving digital picture or diagramsThe process includes by appearing for the JEE exam. If you attain a certain cutoff for this college you might get admission. There is no interview process, after you get the cutoff rank you have to verify documents from PU on mentioned date and register yourself. I chose mechanical engineering because I could attain a seat only in this field due to my curoff rank. After getting selected the JAC panel will fix a date for verification of all engineering colleges affiliated to PU where your seat will be allotted and all documents and id proofs need to be verified, Even hostels may be alloted on the same day. After verification you have to submit the fees online through SBI pay and pay the printed reciept along with registration to the required staff. This college offers engineering in 4 fields which are mechanical, civil, electronics and computer science. The highest no of students who get placed are from computer science department

Name: YEDAPALAPATI BADARI NARAYANA
college: Vignan's Foundation for Science, Technology, and Research
review: This is a four years course. In my course there are 48 subjects and 30 labs We have 8 semesters every semester consists 5-7 subjects with respective labs and last semester contains internship. we have 6 weekend exams and 3 mid exams in a semester which are helpful for internal marks about 40 marks(18+18) 4marks for attendance (80%). For theory subjects external marks are for 60. For lab subjects 60 external are reduced to 40 20 marks for lab(minorproject+internal+external lab exam)Our faculty lecturers are phd scholars from top most IITS. Through projectors they explain to us in a digitalised manner. In a week they will have 7 periods of duration one hr per week. Based on weekly and mid performance they take care about each student. After completion if class they ready to clear our doubts in their cabin without hesitation. They are so friendly and works hard for objective of institutiona

Name: Shlok Sahu
college: Institute of Engineering and Technology, Devi Ahilya University - [IET -DAVV]
review: Placements and jobs are increasing each year, Some courses have higher opportunity as compared to others and some have none. The one with higher placement records are CS (Computer Science) and IT(Information Technology), while ETC (Electronics and Telecommunication) and Mechanical Engineering have comparatively low. And EI (Electronics and Instrumentation) and Civil Engineering have no campus placements from Core Companies. But All branches can sit in Placements. The Companies arrived for placement were Adobe, Accenture, AmDocs, Atos, Cognizant, Honda, Impetus, Zenstar, Bosch, Infosys, L&T, TCS, John Deere, Tech Mahindra. The Intership offers are also ample but most of them are unpaidThe course structure is really good and different from other colleges in state. As being Self Financed the college has all rights to change the course as much and as frequent as they like, this helps in adding new topics to syllabus and hence removing unwanted or old once. Classes begin from 10 a. m. and ends at 5 p. m. there is at least one lab each day. And there are 3 MST ( Mid Sem Tests) happening Once a month and One Sem Exam at the end of semester leaving every month with atleast one Exam. Days become even more Hectic during the time of co-curricular activities such as events, fests, seminars and sport practices.

Name: Shripad Nagpurkar
review:
About 3-4 months ago college came with an event in which you were told to make a project regarding your field and companies will come to check it if its nice they will buy your project and sponser it, this event was organised by "Accenture" company, there are many more events like
TECHETHON - Just like Techfest in IIT BOMBAY its full of robotics a 1 week event. RYTHEM EMBER - Its a college fest of 1 week where there are different competition eg. dance competition, PC gaming competition, SPORTS, etc. 1 FOR ALL, ALL FOR 1 ( Best One ) - its a event organised by college to honour the people who have worked hard for our eg. SOLDIERS, PHILOSOPHERS, fallen HEROES, etccollege organises different workshop, regularly, in past week it organised a workshop on Artificial Intelligence and data learning in which we were taught about AI and how it works from inside, its best its example is GOOGLE, ALEXA, SIRI
previously college also organised workshop on 3D printing, electronic components and their working. college also has and organisations called NSS ATHARVA which does the community work

Name: BALAJI PRAKASH GHAWAD
college: G H Raisoni College of Engineering and Management - [GHRCEM]
review:
In the college there is useful surrounding environment for studying and about course there is whole staff is always ready to support you at any situation according to Academic and also curriculum activities like sports, singing etc. and about to exam structure there is good management to CAE ( class assessment exam ) and ESE ( end semester exam ) which do their work properly and following the Academic schedule.All about to placements there is few percentile in Whole world of engineering whenever you go any colleges like Government/ semi government, private you will get some obstacles to getting placements but overview of our college the placements are going good as students having ability to do
and also our college provide some opportunities to do internships to so many Industries.

Name: Sagnik Sengupta
review: College holds several seminars throughout the semesters which helps the students a lot and also they provide certificates of the seminar, which adds a good touch to the students' CVs. They are very beneficial too as they add to the knowledge of us students on a particular field. Besides, the college holds several Cultural and Management Fests which are as big and entertaining as you would expect.Placements of this College are quite well and they have grown well in the recent years. You might not get a decent job just after the B. tech though, if you are studying Biotechnology. Considering other branches, if your SGPA remains decent throughout the course, you m8ght get a decent job in the IT sectors. The Internship programs of this college are good and beneficial.

Name: Vasu bhatnagar
review: The placement and job opportunities in chandigarh university is much appreciated as more than 200+ companies take a survey in the University in the form of placement drives and traning and placement programs. Gournteed placements for students who have an overall cgpa of 8. 5 and above as companies from all over India and other countries get into action in placement programsThe faculty structure in chandigarh university is much vast and qualified. The faculty has basic knowledge of the subjects and the studies here are basically subjective but less bookish knowledge is used as the faculty members need to be practical in their subjects for the better understanding of subjects for their students

Name: Avulasandeepreddy
college: AVN Institute of Engineering and Technology - [AVNIET], Ibrahimpatnam
review: The fees structure of my college is much feasible to every student if you have come through counselling then government help some what in your fees but the transportation fees is very high in my college but if you come through management you have to pay 65k+transportation fee extraYes we have a scholarship ship feature which is given by the state government but my college donot provide any scholarship facility and the government of state helps alot in students education and as it is a technical course parents can pay the fees there is no need of loans

Name: Lokesh Singh
review:
Gender ratio is approximately 2/4 for every 4 boys there are 2 girls. Fresher's party and ignitia dj night are parties for students, many highly qualified workshops and international conferences are held here. There are many clubs and groups
Realted to environment and awareness spreading such as utthan Ganges river cleaning club danzel dance club drama club arayabhatt maths club, IEEE clubBTech's course and curriculum are defined by AICTE all over india. Ant that are nice.
Exam pattern here is that : internal marks are decided by conducting class tests. am assignment. Attendance and pre semesters. And external marks are decided according to what you score in semester examination. Internal(out of 50) + external (out of 100) +practicals(out of 25) gives you total marks

Name: Nitin verma
review: There are less placements opportunities in our colleges. They bring the placements just like bpos marketing etc. But people from our college are placed in many good companies through pool campus drives etc. They are no internships in our colleges. But in 3-2 we have done an internship in ecil in Hyderabad. They didn't gave any stipend but we have done for sake of knowledgeThrough eamcet exam. And applied for counselling got selected here in a best college of karimnagar district the after I attended the counselling first I got seat in cse which I was not interested then later I applied for second counselling where I got admission in ece then finally I took as a challenge and complted my btech in the stream of ece

Name: Akshay m
review: b.tech is a Course where everyone needs to study but cant read because of higher fees or far from home colleges.although this college is also far from my home but I travel through bus.i enjoy classes and by the end of the day I will be chilled with friends but traveling in bus makes me tired reaching my homeAll the students in our college participate in all extracarricular activities without any gender discrimination our college union chairman is a lady and there is college teams for foodball cricket base ball soft ball volley ball and khoko and most of then has girls team also

Name: Likhith Kumar Raju
college: IIT Tirupati - Indian Institute of Technology - [IITTP]
review: The extracurricular activities are really awesome because there will be a active participation in the co curriculuar activities so the college staff also allow and they will encourage us to participate in the extra curriculuar activities. They will also conduct all sports games every year by making groups and there will award the overall performance trophy also.Placements and job opportunities in our college are given in the last year. Placements are also given through private limited IT company and foreign companies. The college offers us internships in the final year. Our seniors had gone to arcgate and zoomio & pc solution company for internship, they had very good results for internship in six months.

Name: Kumar Nayan
college: Institute of Technical Education and Research - [ITER]
review: The course which I am studying is the best field in the present scenario. I am a Computer Science student of 2nd year. The course basically focuses on improving the programming skills of the students enrolled here. We learn Java, C, Database, HTML. Exams are conducted in 2 or 3 months gap, which is sufficient and a healthy practice. But the labs are very frequent, around 5 labs a week which leave us exhausted.Annual technical and cultural fest called as Genesis and Chakravyuh. Genesis is the technical fest conducted in the college campus for 3 days. In the cultural fest which is also conducted for 3 days many competitions are held. Hackothan is also a techincal event which was held in our college.

Name: Arjun D
review:
Our college hosts India's largest multifest. VIDYUT. It is conducted by student and a team of faculty. It hosts technical and non technical events. Workshops, Pro- shows, Choreonite, DJ. etc
Other events like Onam festival, Pongal, diwali, kalotsavam, sports day, etc, are conducted.It comes around 3 lakh rupees for a year, including tuition fees and hostel fees. Hostel accommodation and food is good. College campus is vast and airy. Fee is reasonable as other colleges, of not this caliber charge 2-3 per annum.

Name: Seshu
review: I got admission in this college via convenor list. I got nearly 20000 rank in eamcet and I choose mechanical branch. The admission process of our college is at starting we have to submit all our original certificates of 3 sets to our college and later we should register for it.The positive remarks about our college is we have good infrastructure inside and outside of our college such as auditorium, play ground, sports facilities, labs, workshops and various things. The negatives in our college are very few which we can't describe.

Name: Reshma
review: Yeahhh of course this college has excellent Training and placement division. I too got selected in a big MNC company through placement. PG students will get more internships. they didn't limit us to attend interview for companies, we can attend many. Companies, it is fully based on our wish to attend or not. There is no restriction for attending the interview.It's is a anti ragging free campus here we can't find any kind of race, religious, or politics the gender ratio is also same here mostly their are almost equal number of girls and boys here and we have very good activities after college who are interested in any sports they can join in that sports.

Name: Yusuf Thanawala
review: Technovanza is the technical fest of VJTI college with about 50, 000 people coming from all over the Maharashtra. 150+ colleges participate in this event. Technovanza is the only technical event next to IITs Techfest in Mumbai. Pratibimb is annual Cultural fest with 10, 000 peoples and 59+ colleges participating. Enthusia is annual sports festival. SNC is a management fest by Ecell committee.Vjti is in the heart of Mumbai. It enjoys participation of big compamies for placements. L&T, Tata, HCC, HDIL are few companies which visit every year for core branches. Apart from these Samsung, Goldman Sachs, Apple, Microsoft also come in for Comps and IT dept. Internships are provided in the 3 year of your course through college interviews and screening test.

Name: shrikant malviya
college: Thapar Institute of Engineering and Technology - [Thapar University]
review: The course structure is very nice here. I am currently pursuing Electronics and Computer field which majors in Electronics and minors in Computers. We have 8 semesters in which 4 semesters we are taught Electronics and the other 4 we are taught Computers. The Labs are high tech and I love how everything works. We have 2 main exams, i. e. Mid semester and End semester exams. Followed by Lab practicals and unit tests.The college provides placements and Job opportunities. Highest package here is around 40 Lakhs per annum. Thapar college also provides Some internships and stipend can go upto 1-2 Lakh per month. DEShaw, Amazon, Samsung, Microsoft, Wipro, TCS and many more companies come and give placements to students.

Name: Aditya Sharma
college: University Institute of Information Technology, Himachal Pradesh University - [UIIT]
review: Among the positive are low and affordable fees structure, ease of living, the chill environment and the overall atmosphere of the place. The location factor the it's present in Shimla plays an important role to. Among the negative are poor placement and internships. And the unjustified fees as compared to the resources. The negatives definitely have an edge over the positive here.College extracurricular activities are very limited. There are commities formed but the are usually inactive throughout the year. The only time the commities are active are during the fest. Only computer and electronics labs are present in the college and the core branches such as mechanical lack proper lab facilities.

Name: Shreyes gedam
review: First I will give the jee mains paper through that first option is that the we should apply in jossa or we have to report directly on the college for spot round councelling in the basis of your jee rank you get rank wise list, before that we have to verify the documents first like 10th 12th migration tc jee rank etc and if you were in the reservation categary then you should verify the certificate alsoSpeaking about my department we have a ratio of 6:4 gender ratio( 6 male). There are no parties except one which we get at our first year of college. There are various workshops such as coding, microcircuit and others. There is no student diversity To Gender, Ethnicity, Race, Religion, Sexual Orientation, Politics And Economic Status.

Name: Gourav Amrutrao Patil
college: Smt. Indira Gandhi College of Engineering - [SIGCE]
review: Course Curriculum for engineering is good comparatively course is of 4 years each year consists of 2 SEM and boards each sem consist of 5 to 6 thory and practical examination so curriculum is great so that students will improve the extra curriculum taken by the university if Mumbai is also very important form students aspects so overall mentality of students to work industry built-inYes, There's different department for placements and job for students and will be handled bay Management and a staff including college students and committee so Yes every year more than 150 companies came for placement they even took interviews of juniors and as weel ass graduated students so that junior could prepare for the next and the best and 100 % placement

Name: Amogha Shayana
college: Sri Indu College of Engineering and Technology - [SICET] Ibrahimpatnam
review: In sports our college preference is somewhat less but the laboratories and really well equipment and the staff are really good in it and the fests are organized by our seniors and they really do good and they do in their own way and there will be no kind of discrimination and harassment in our college people are really so friendly and ragging is strictly prohibited in our colllege.It's yearly based like for us it is 71000 per annum and the library fees and the bus fees are all of seperate they are about 30000 per annum and the overall fee would be about 100000 per annum and the scholarship we get from government is 35000 per annum.

Name: Rahul Dhananjay shingan
college: Tatyasaheb Kore Institute of Engineering and Technology - [TKIET]
review: In our college is fees are taken by the college is 52000 thousands for obc and open category students. And fee structure is different for different category students. There actual fee is aroud is 1 lakh rupes. but other fee is give the as scholship by our goverment.The chemical engineering is very core branch in this college. and in this college chemical engineering department got 90 to 95% place the students. The chemical engineering is very powerful branch in this college. so all very good in condition.

Name: Sriram madhyala
college: Sri Venkatesa Perumal College of Engineering and Technology - [SVPCET]
review: I'm sorry but No Event happened yet In our college after my joining I've joined this college in 2018 but I saw no event here Only AAVISHKAR is the most famous event in our college where many students from different college will be participated and the total prize pool is 5, 00, 000I got admission in college by passing my entrance test called EAMCET I've got my allotment order and submitted in the college then my admission was processed and I joined the college basically any who passed EAMCET should follow the same procedure

Name: Venkat Dilip
review: For the local students fees is about 200000 for whole course but for the other state students the fees is mainly about 1000000 mainly for the if we came through ICAR Examination the fees will be less. But if you came through the NRI OR INDUSTRIAL QUOTA the fee will be so highWe have paece full college infrastructure. But the faculty will do more force and effort on students. They wont live freely for the students. They always be in fire mood no peace full in the faculty mentalty not all the faculty maximum of them are like that

Name: Naitik Rathod
college: Dwarkadas J Sanghvi College of Engineering - [DJSCE]
review:
Our college keeps internship fairs, and our placement is 100% in our course I personally havent done any internship yet, but thinking of getting one or two in future. Although the stipends are around 2k to 5k INR
It is all about learning more and more skills and practicing them on industry level, thats what internships are for.We have a good alumni network, many of them are founders of startups while many are at big big positions in big companies. They come for alumni meets, we get to interact with them, learn more about how to work in industry and all. This is very helpful as when you are in College, you don't get to know much about industry.

Name: Aditya Roy
review: Jadavpur University is a hive of extracurricular activities. Labs are okayish. The sports activities include- cricket, football, basketball, volleyball, badminton, table tennis, chess and a lot more. There are clubs for mountaineering, music, entrepreneurship, writing skills etc. The gender ratio is not an issue in the college. Anyone can play anything. This is one of the best things in here. Politics is a healthy practice here. Not the politics we know out there. This politics includes knowing different ideologies and creating a good background to see the things happening in the outside world.If you are admitted through the entrance exam the government provides you an reammbarsment of 35000.The actual College fee is 78000 removing this 35000 we have to pay 43000, this criteria is for OBC students.The OC students admitted through the entrance have to pay the whole college fee 78000.There is another category called management in which students have to pay around 4 Lakhs donation and the full academic fee.For SC and ST students there will be no fees.

Name: Monik Talagatla
review:
We celebrate many festivals and the main one is the Annual Meet. It is the time where many competitions are held and it is held in the spring semester. Inter-hostel Marchpast is the main one of them. Some other are wall magazine, cricket, running, kho-kho, khabadi, long jump, high jump, drama, Western chorus, dance and so on.Feasible BCOM is a three year course and the fee structure is less comparatively to other courses the fee structures is Haa follows In the first year it’s 22000 to 25000 In the second year it’s 20000 to 2500

Weekly activities can offer a welcome break from studies and homework — particularly for senior students if they can spare the time. They also help limit the time your child is spending in front of a TV or computer screen. They can help your child build their skills outside of the classroom
In addition to building skills within a specific discipline, extracurricular activities are great for developing general academic and soft skills. Think debating for public speaking, academic competitions for exam strategies and sport for teamwork. Balancing a number of commitments can help to improve your child’s time management skills, while finding an area they enjoy or excel at can boost self-confidence. They can open your child’s mind to new interests (and views)
While students usually have the opportunity to pursue a wide range of study areas through core subjects and electives, extracurricular activities allow students to explore an interest in more depth than what is covered in class — or maybe even find a completely new interest that they wouldn’t have been exposed to otherwise. Our lab examinations and academic exams were conducted according to the schedule of jntuh.Our faculty are very friendly towards students.They encourage students to participate in other competitive activities like hackathon,workshops.They motivate students in each and every aspect and give us moral support.

Name: Renuka
review:
We had a great interaction with them.Their will be many workshops held by seniors who tell their experience and guide us regarding future plans.They come to college.alumni can play an active role in voluntary programmes like mentoring students in their areas of expertise. They could also play a significant role in contributing scholarships to deserving students.MGIT offers undergraduate and postgraduate programs in the field of engineering. The tuition fees at MGIT for the different programs are given below:
The tuition fees for all B.Tech programs is INR 100,000 (1st and 2nd year) and INR 82,400 (3rd and 4th year).
The tuition fees for all M.Tech programs is INR 67,600.

Name: R.Swathi
college: Malla Reddy Engineering College for Women - [MRECW]
review: The college has around 50+ societies,clubs and communities. Other than that the school is just about the foremost lively place post the school hours, the whole campus is roofed with green areas of trees and shrubs and there are very less restrictions for the scholars to maneuver around within the campus the campus in time for college kids has recently been increased. The college sees many tests and events throughout the year.I give the entrance exam, so clear exam and got good rank then further proceed to counselling process where you need to fill your choice of colleges and after that you need to verify your document to your nearest centre which is give on the website and after these to steps you need to lock your choice or seat for the allotted college and then contact to the college for admission process.

Name: G.shruthi
college: BVRIT Hyderabad College of Engineering for Women - [BVRITH]
review: Our alumni students are very helpful. They sometimes come to our classes and share their experiences. They motivate us very much. They help us to explore uniquely. They provide good support whenever requiredWe have extracurricular activities like labs and sports. Despite of this we also have many other clubs for different activitied. We also have good trainers in particular activities.

Name: HARIPRIYA NANDULA
college: BVRIT Hyderabad College of Engineering for Women - [BVRITH]
review: I have never been through an internship. our college provides as the internship opportunities for different companies this stipend may vary from person to person basing on their knowledge. We have got companies like Microsoft, Mu Sigma and other service based companies. The packages are very good.Every professor in our college is an Mtech graduate and teach very well use Different techniques to help students understand the course effectively. We also have the smart learning and deep learning classes. I enjoy learning and I personally think our college has the best faculty.

Name: N.Akhila
college: BVRIT Hyderabad College of Engineering for Women - [BVRITH]
review: Yes it's good,for the people who are interested only in education.but after joining in that college we should not compare it with other colleges. our faculty will explain in detail.and they mostly prefer deep explanation.they will give activities to us.that should be done in time.placements and job opportunities are good in our college.our college provides internships.our college mostly prefer on big package companies.and weekly we have practice on interviews.and they will teach how the interviews should be faced.

Name: K Sri Satya Priya
college: BVRIT Hyderabad College of Engineering for Women - [BVRITH]
review:
We celebrate many events and hackathons in our college like Medhanvesh, We enable hackathons, etc.
Annual day, holi celebrations, sankranthi celebrations, etc
And also nss events like nss day, blood donation camps.The placements are good. And most of our seniors are placed in good companies with good package.
Our college is always ready to provide internships.
We get companies like adobe, IBM, Capgemini, Microsoft

Name: Tejaswi Dayyala
college: BVRIT Hyderabad College of Engineering for Women - [BVRITH]
review: Medhanvesh,Annual Day,Freshers Day, Nypunya Sports Fest,Women In Software Engineering,Master Orator Championship etc are the events that are conducted in our college.Even the hackathons,workshops and even the NASSCOM which provides the hands on training on cyber security etc are also conducted in our college.The graph of placements increase rapidly year by year.All the eligible graduates grab a minimum of nearly 2 to 3 job opportunities and some pursue higher studies.Top most companies like John Deere,Amazon,Capgemini etc visit our college and offer an average package of 4 to 5 lakhs.

Name: Harini
college: Vallurupalli Nageswara Rao Vignana Jyothi Institute of Engineering and Technology - [VNR VJIET]
review: Technical tests like Convergence, Cultural fest Scintillations, Many other events by 11 cultural clubs and 9 Technical student chapters at different national events and cultural festivals. They are celebrated on a large scale by all students of all dept with faculty support.Very Qualified, experienced and learned. They have more practical knowledge. They are good at latest trends in Technologies. They use digital teaching as well. Very cooperative and understanding. Many of them are Professors and Asst. Professors in designation

Name: Ashish Sharma
review: The fess is moderate not too expensive but it still depends on ones perception. There are many scholarships based on various categories. The college also provides a special schlorship for girls and the remissions are also provided on the basis of the academic performance of a particular student.There are many technical events such as the TECHNOVA, as well as my sports events. In this academic year it has organised a TED TALK Independently. The event was a great success. The events that are organised in the college attracts participants from all around the other colleges

Name: Kayra Kumari
college: Indian Institute For Secondary & Technical Education - [IISTE]
review: Our curriculum is up to date and every subject we have been taught is from employability point of view. Our skills are greatly enhanced. In addition to this, many workshops and trainings are conducted. Semester exams are conducted to test the knowledge we have gained at the end of each curriculum.Our library has so many resources to make use of. It has a pleasant vibe inside to sit silently and read. Many of our students and professors borrow books here to use it for their research work. Our labs are also very well maintained with systems containing latest OS and software updates.

Name: Rinshad Sidique
college: Al Azhar College of Engineering and Technology - [AACET]
review: The classrooms are really spacious and provide a conducive environment. They are equipped with modern technology to help the students learn more easily. Regular conferences are also organized in the conference hall that caters to approximately 30 people. The students are empowered and motivated to think creatively. The institute also provides a scholarship for deserving candidates.I am currently pursuing B.Tech in Automobile Engineering from AACET. After 10+2, I gave KEAM(Kerala Entrance Exam) and filed an application form for the college. The round 1 cutoff for my stream was 42138, hence scoring 41692 my admission to the college was accepted. It's an excellent institute helping us students build confidence and achieving knowledge and management skills.

Name: Gurdeep Singh
college: Aman Bhalla Institute of Engineering and Technology - [ABIET]
review: I applied for B.Tech in mechanical and got my admission on merit basis through my 12th class marks. The two-third of B.Tech seats are filled through merit. The remaining few of my batch mates got admission through management quota and some also joined in through lateral entry.The placement policy is pretty good. The placement cell assists us to develop a perspective about our career. A job fair is also organized for final year students. The college coordinates with companies and maintains relations with them for effective recruitment.

Name: Jose Karthika
college: NPR College of Engineering and Technology
review: The school has an exceptionally devoted personnel. The school gives a decent proportion of all around prepared and exceptionally taught employees who are well furnished with the cutting edge innovation. The educators likewise put in a great deal of endeavors to adapt the subject into the understudies mind. The instructors are agreeable and are accessible all an opportunity to support the understudies.The college has a vast opportunity for extracurricular activites. Not only it motivates the students for taking part in various games but also it keeps them fot and inspired that learning is a life long process. There is no discrimination or injustice against any student.

Name: Shivani Singh
review:
Almost 80% of students in our course got placed. The highest salary offered is Rs. 55,000 per month and the lowest salary offered is Rs. 20,000 per month and the average salary offered is Rs. 35,000 per month. Top recruiting companies like GlobalLogic, Informatica, Capgemini, TCS, Nucleus Software, Infogain, etc., visited the campus. Top roles offered are a systems analyst, network engineer, assistant system engineer-trainee etcAdmissions to First Year of B.Tech is based on scores in JEE Main/UPSEE.
Candidates seeking admissions to B.Tech should have passed 10+2 with minimum 45% marks in aggregate with Physics and Mathematics as compulsory subjects and Chemistry/Bio-Technology/Biology/Technical Vocational Subject as optional.

Name: Raj Bodade
review: The faculties that we have here are mostly visiting faculties. There are very confident and full of experience with this field. There are some permanent faculties who are as equally talented too. They teach us efficiently all the concepts of this complex course in an easy manner.The alumni network is quite strong there are a lot of passed out seniors who are in good positions in some great companies, they can refer you and also some of them help us academically. This is one of the oldest institutes in marine engineering hence the network is wide.

Name: Kaviya Kiru
college: VSB College of Engineering Technical Campus
review: Our College is a self financing co-educational institution with an objective to afford value-based technical education and mould the students for industry requirements. And therefore, the teachers are at their best to prepare students on professional terms.There is a seminar hall with a capacity to house over 1000 people. Ragging / any type of misconduct towards any student, either on the college campus or outside, is considered a criminal offence. A library, a playground and a canteen is also there.

Name: Meenakshi Saini
review: The campus is Wi-Fi enabled. This group has a medical college, so medical facilities are available all the time. There is no hostel for boys, though hostel facility is available for girls. Food that is provided in the canteen is really good. Classrooms are well furnished with speakers and mike setup, also smartboards. Extracurricular activities aren't paid much importance here.Our senior batch and the previous batches got placed in various companies. The placement percentage was approximately 30% back then , which have rise up to 70%. The salary package offered by the company is 4 lacs per annum, which is minimum.Campus placements are that guaranteed though, since most the companies do not visit our college campus.

Name: Pratibha Maled
review: The Curriculum is the standard government engineering curriculum, the system in this college is CGPA system we have 20 internals and 8 externals for the whole course. In the first year, all the departments have a common syllabus, after entering the second year we learn about the department related subjects.Companies like TCS come here for recruitment. Mostly everyone gets placed, internships are also provided for some students from all departments except civil. The training and placement department trains us well in aptitude and soft skills development.

Name: Sakthi Vel
review: Good faculty. All lecturers have good experience & are good in teaching. They don't do any private teaching & that's why we are getting good teaching in college. Good teaching is offered in our college which attracts many people towards it. The faculties are well trained to teach and they teach excellently too. They are selected on the basis of the entrance. So they are all very good and choosen faculties.Placements are good, means 100 percent students who sit in interview are placed. If you are interested in coding or development, then this is the best place. Data are available at institute's website. In this college, if you maintain your cgpa above 8 and know coding, then this is best place, you will be placed.

Name: Er Sathish Naren
review: Anna University regional campus Coimbatore placements criteria is growing its reach with each succeeding year for the sake of campus placements as the department strives to offer 100% placement and skill development training for self-employment. The placement cell also conducts pre-placement training, written tests, group discussions, mock interviews and other sessions relevant for preparation of placement interviews.Lab facility is average and our college management is working in it. Coming to sports and extracurricular activities, sports facilities are availiable and they are encouraging lots of students. Gender ratio varies based on respective departement. Several workshops and internship opportunities are provided in the each semester.

Name: Saloni Singh
college: IIT Dharwad - Indian Institute of Technology - [IITD]
review: Near about 45 students from our course got placed last year. About 30% of the students from our course got an internship at our college. The average salary package offered in our course ranges between 12 lakhs-20 lakhs LPA. Placements in our college are not good, but dean is trying to provide the best placements. IIT will need few more years to provide the best placements possible.The WALMI Campus of IIT Dharwad is the best among the newer IITs. There are facilities for all academic and welfare needs of the students. There are facilities for ebook learning, sports facilities, canteen, library, internet facility and security as well as workshops and seminars.

Name: Priyanka Yadav
college: IIT Goa - Indian Institute of Technology - [IITG]
review: Due to the worldwide pandaemic, college is closed now.The pioneers' batch is still in its third year right now. So, there are no placements conducted yet. However, we are expecting really good placements as the mentor institute is IIT Bombay. The first placement session will be conducted in 2020. Students have applied to various famous companies like CERN, etc.Here, the candidates before applying for B.tech courses in our college, should sit for JEE Advanced and also a pass in 10+2 examination or equivalent examination is required with a minimum of 75%. Both the scores with be take into consideration before a student makes it to the final list.

Name: Sathishkumar
review: There are a wide variety of streams available for the students to choose from when they are doing the bachelors of engineering course. The streams are mechanical engineering, civil engineering, electronics and communication engineering, computer Science and engineering, electrical and electronics engineering. The course curriculum is overall very goodJohn Bosco engineering college is one of the most reputed college in the country. The college is very good because the course curriculum and the quality of the faculty in our college is very good. The college also has a placement cell which help the students. The college also host many individual and group project for the students.

Name: Ghulam Hasan
review: We get good placement opportunities in our college. Our university has a good network of placement companies that visit our college every year to recruit students for jobs and internships and provide them good salaries.I had written the entrance exam for engineering that is JEE Mains. On the basis of my rank in the entrance test I was assigned this college in my counselling procedure. After which I paid my fees and got the admission.

Name: Pulkit Agrawal
college:
Vishnu Lakshmi College of Engineering and
Technology - [VILCET]
review: All the faculties here are well-qualified and inspiring, they motivate us well. Some of them are PhD holders, it is very useful to listen to their lectures as engineering is also about research, they guide us well with our final semester projects.We have a nice playground to conduct cricket and football matches. The gender ratio is almost equal, especially in departments like Computer science engineering. This is a anti-ragging campus and all the cultures are celebrated in here.

Name: Nidhi Gupta
review:
This college is verified by AICTE and hence as any other engineer college in this country, syllabus is more or less is same.
Curriculum is well structured and they keep updating it. Minor exams are taken throughout the semester and major are taken at the end of every semester.Comparing to other colleges offering the same course, the fees structure of this college is quite affortble. For the first year it is around 72000 and from second year onwards it is around 56000. So for total of 4 year it will cost you around 2.5 lac approximately.

Name: Mansi Suresh Sathe
college: Bhivarabai Sawant College of Engineering & Research-[BSCOER] Narhe
review: Shodh, jashan a youth festival , days like traditional day -retro day etc .also technical events in which the student are coming from another college for participating in it .the various events are held like coding, finding error from the snippets etc.and the fun games are also there's like Pubg ,counter strike Yes It is feasible to everyone like other college are having the fee structure . And you can pay fees in instalments also so everyone is able to take admission in college. And also a option like bank loan so if student is not able to pay the fees currently then he will pay later after his completion of degree.

Name: Barse Om Tryambak
college: Sinhgad Institute of Technology and Science -[SITS] Narhe
review: Course curriculum is good and there are 8 sem in whole course. Every sem have 7-8 subject including Practicals. Practical rooms and location are good. Teacher organise many industrial visit so we learn so much from that how work actually performs in industry. So overall it is help ful environment for me to be professional.My college is very special for events and programs. Technical and non technical events are conducts in our college like robotech, box cricket, auto CAD, ect. Students looks very creative in this type of events.We participated in 3-4 events in last year. Sinhgad Karandak is ends with EDM night.

Name: Akhil Radhakrishnan
college: Al Azhar College of Engineering and Technology - [AACET]
review: Transportation facilities are also made available to students with luxury buses. Separate hostels are provided for both boys and girls within the campus. A separate space is provided for indoor games and TV and reading rooms are also available within the hostels. We are also provided with a multi-gym and fitness facility that helps us to remain fit. Cultural and sports activities are also organized regularly.AACET focuses on giving direction to future technologists by offering them relevant exposure. Keeping the reputation of the college in mind, I applied for the course of B.Tech in mechanical engineering by filling out an application form for the college after appearing for KEAM. I scored a pretty decent rank leading to my admission to the university.

Name: Gaurav Jain
review: The placement and job opportunities are very good at some point. The job fairs are held in the college in which every people are allowed to take part. There are lot of companies which are called in that fest. The in-house trainings are done in the college. Till now I haven't heard about any internship.Yes, the seniors are very good. They are helpful. If you behave good and be good with them they will be good with you. There are no ragging in the college that's the best part. Only formal intro would take place between junior and senior.

Name: Arya Ammutyy
review: The college encourages student’s participation in various activities – co-curricular and extra-curricular – as a part of students’ total education. Infrastructure for sports includes a meticulously designed badminton court which can be played upon in day/night, equipment for cricket, table tennis, volleyball & other indoor games.I am extremely happy and satisfied with my college. The college has given me great opportunities and experiences as well as memories which is definitely going to help me in the future and has made my vision more broad towards the competitive approach of the society.

Name: Vidhya Thakur
review: Companies like Genpact, Imperial auto, Config, and many others visit the campus for recruitment purposes. We are guided by the college for internships though no stipends are provided. The placement cell works for the benefit of all the students to ensure recruitment assistance to them.The course curriculum helps us make use of computers to store, retrieve, and transmit the information. We have also started to understand the acquisition, processing, storage, and dissemination of information by a microelectronics based combination of computing and telecommunication.

Name: Utkarsh Anant
review: The fee is feasible even if not there are education loans available for those who cannot pay the fee. The fee is Rs. 2,25,000 for one year inclusive of the fee like hostels and mess. There are certain miscellaneous fee will be notified then and there which needs to be paid online.Scholarship of Rs. 75,000 is provided to the first 9 students out of 25 students who are academically excellent and the rest of the 25 get a scholarship of Rs 50,000. The education loan can also be availed by the students who could not afford to pay the fee.

Name: Jacsice Raj
college: Jayaraj Annapackiam CSI College of Engineering - [JACSICE]
review: Placement level of my college is low, some companies came for placement but that is only for computer engineering and electronic engineering students. Other branch placement level is zero. U have to take various interviews outside the college to get placement and job alsoI got admission into this college through my score in the common entrance test conducted by the college. The college takes in students on the basis of their performance in the CET entrance exam. I scored well in CET and could manage to get admitted into this college.

Name: Sneha George
review: Our college, as many might know, is famous for its sports fest, with games like football, cricket and basketball it is a very great arena for sports freaks. We have a gym to work out, with all the necessary equipment. The female ratio is more than men in this college. No discrimination is done against anybody based on gender, caste or religion.The faculties are extremely talented and qualified to handle this professional course. They have many years of experience in the field of teaching. Our professor K K Jena is working on a project called the "Golden rice project" which is very inspiring, our faculties encourage us to take up such work.

Name: Ashwini Ramakrishna A
college: Amruta Institute of Engineering and Management Sciences - [AIEMS]
review: As I'm a second year student, I'm yet to be familiarized with the placement process. However, I've been told by my seniors that the placement cell is quite active and provide them with training that helps them polish and develop appropriate skills.We also undergo internships for practical learning. The companies which come to the college for recruitment are Pathfront, CMS IT, Q Spider and many others.I am currently studying B.E. in Civil Engineering from Amruta Institute. I got my admission through COMEDK Under Graduate Entrance Test through which 30% admissions are done. Many of my batch mates also got in through CET and management quota. The eligibility criteria for my course was minimum 45% of marks in aggregate in PUC. The good reputation of the college encouraged me to opt for it.

Name: Karam Bhullar
college: SBS College of Engineering and Technology (Govt College)
review: The campus offers extraordinary placements opportunities for the students in top companies from around the world. The placement cell conduct workshop and other events to get the students exposed to those expectations that they will need to meet for placements in such companies. A few of the top recruiters in the past years include CSC, Smart Infra Business Projects, V-serve, Infosys, Vibetech Solutions PSEB, Sasken, Tavant Technologies, L&T InfoTech, Tech lab, etc.This institution realizes the need to train students and make them experience the real industry before they step to work. Hence, it conducts various workshops on different topics and other industry developments that benefit the students in keeping on par with the day to day changes in the industry. It also conducts guest lectures and seminars that help students understand the needs of the industry.

Name: Achu Kutty
review:
Regional Institute of Engineering offers four-year Bachelor’s degree in various disciplines of Engineering. Candidates who have passed Higher Secondary or 10+2 examination with minimum 50% marks in Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics especially 50% marks in Mathematics are eligible to take admission.
Admission is given on the basis of KEAM entrance exam.Placements are good, means 100 percent students who sit in interview are placed. If you are interested in coding or development, then this is the best place among other NITs. Data are available at institute's website. In this college, if you maintain your cgpa above 8 and know coding, then this is best place, you will be placed.

Name: Madhu Bheesetty
college: Gonna Institute of Information Technology and Sciences - [GIITS]
review: The Admission Process in our college is through e-cet exam. After I had completed my diploma ,I had to attend the exam which is compulsory to join in this college.If one is qualified in e-cet exam,results will be published and the university will announce a day for certificates verification then after we have to choose this college in web options.We have several colleges in the counselling while I chose this college to study.There are many labs respective to their departments available in the college.Sports activities such as basketball, football as such is also present.These sports activities provide entertainment to many students.They also take part in many events and won prizes. Apart from these sports events there are students who involve themselves in reading books at the library,which is also provided by the college.

Name: Saloni Darji
review: The college encourages student’s participation in various activities – co-curricular and extra-curricular – as a part of students’ total education. Infrastructure for sports includes a meticulously designed badminton court which can be played upon in day/night, equipment for cricket, table tennis, volleyball & other indoor games.I am extremely happy and satisfied with my college. The college has given me great opportunities and experiences as well as memories which is definitely going to help me in the future and has made my vision more broad towards the competitive approach of the society.

Name: Lipika Jena
review: For admission into first year B.Tech program, I needed to show up for JOINT ENTRANCE EXAMINATION through online assessment. After effective culmination of +2 Science with Mathematics, Physics and Chemistry/Biology/Biotechnology/Computer Science with at least 45% of total imprints. Online forms are available which I downloaded, filled up and submitted online again.For development of the foundation the contribution of each individual partner like students,parents,faculties,staff or more all the administration is basic in all respect. Therefore, the prime role of the institute is to make the students ready for a bright future and satisfy their parents. Hence, it hires highly qualified and experienced faculties.

Name: Neha Yadav
review: There is no alumni network or association as such but the seniors of the college are white helpful,cooperative and friendly. They are very down to earth and help the juniors in all aspects from practicals to books to exam patter and how to attempt an answer. There is no ragging in the college as the seniors are very respectful and friendly.I applied for admission in this college after appearing the JEE Mains exams where the minimum % for taking admission here was 75% and I had more than that. Also, one can appear the Chattishgarh Pre-Engineering Test and after the results are published, can apply for admission. But I got the admission here through my JEE Mains Score.

Name: Sunish Xaviel
college:
Vishnu Lakshmi College of Engineering and
Technology - [VILCET]
review: You will have to give the entrance examination of TNEA to get admission in this college. Also, you must have completed your class 12th examination form a recognised board of education then you can fill up the application form which is available at the campus of the college. My experience in getting the admission in this college was very fun and interesting. Once I visited the campus and asked for help from the college faculty itself. They helped me in such a nice way.I must say that the college is providing very positive environment for all of the students. The students are very polite and also the members of the faculty are forever encouraging them. There are quite a lot of activities for the students to enjoy their college life also.

Name: Tanzila Maniyar
review: The placement cell of the college is nice as the number of companies visits the campus to recruit students. The average salary package offered is about 5 LPA, its the highest salary package offered here. Companies like HCL and TCS visit our college for placements.The college conducted its own Fest every year in which students hold all the responsibility for carrying out the fest. Many Dance competitions, Nukkad Naatak, various other plays are involved in the fest. Students show great interest in the competition.

Name: SriShti ShaRma
college: Shri Rawatpura Sarkar Institute of Technology
review: Many good scholarship opportunities are provided to the students of the college. Sometimes the scholarships are provided to the students who have scored good in their entrance examination. Also, meritorious students of all courses are provided scholarship on the basis of their academic result. The student securing first second and third position in each year of study in all courses are eligible for the scholarship amount.The admission in the college is given on the basis of the JEE main score. The entrance exam is followed by a counselling which is conducted by the DTE government of CG. Also, the eligibility criteria for the course is to pass your class 12th examination with at least 45% of marks. The marks has been lower for the students belonging to scheduled caste scheduled tribes and other backward caste category.

Name: Amrutha Varshini
review: About 65% of the students got placed in our course. The highest salary of Rs. 52,000 per month and the lowest salary of Rs. 9,000 per month and the average salary of Rs. 30,000 per month are offered. Global Logic, Webkul, Mobiloitte, Genpact, JBM, Smart Chip, Accenture, Informatica, Infogain, Jaro Education, GSWI, Optimus, Nucleus Software and TechMahindra are the top recruiters.The faculties of our college are highly educated. They know how to teach and develop human resources. They are very helpful. They treat us as our family members. They always try to give the ultimate level of knowledge to the students. They also try to develop the extracurricular abilities of the students.

Name: Sahana M Gowda
review: The admission is quite easy; it requires an aggregate percentage of 45% to enroll in the course of Bachelor of Engineering(Computer Science). The decision of admission is taken by the college administrative department, my name appeared on the third admission list. Afterward, I have completed the documentation process.The course curriculum followed in the college is outdated which doesn’t provide us knowledge and skills required in the present time. The college organizes its own technical classes supported by the Training and placement Department to enhance the skills of students technically.

Name: Renu Sangwan
review: If you want to take admission in BTech course of this college then you have to give the entrance exam of JEE mains, two other exams are also applicable in this college. You can give the examination of your choice then you have to fill in the application form which is available at the official website of the college. You can find the application form at the campus of the college also.The fees structure of the college is not very high if you are undertaking the BTech course of engineering from this college then you have to submit the tuition fees of 70000 rupees for each year. Then you have to submit a caution money of 7500 and a one time library security deposit of around 2000. If you are getting admission form the management quota than the fees is quite less.

Name: Diksha Jaiswal
college: Dr. Rajendra Prasad Central Agricultural University
review: As college is located in Bihar we celebrated different festivals together also various events hosted in college debates, Drama clubs were organized. Some of them are Agri-manifest, Hindi pakhwada, Kishan Mela, programs on various occasions like Gandhi Jayanti and many more such events.The process is quite simple, students should have an aggregate 65% marks to apply for B.TECH Agricultural Engineering. Later on the counseling program for admission into college, they had asked us to fill up forms about which course we wanted to take up in the future and so on.

Name: Anisha Christal
review: A very good fee structure has been designed by the college faculty. The duration of bachelors of engineering course is for 4 year. Every year you have to submit the fees of 50000 rupees. The Grand total of the bachelors of engineering program from this college will be around 2 lakh rupees only.One of the most important feature of this college is availability of a very detailed and thorough research course curriculum. The course curriculum is topped of with practical lab session which is a very good thing. I am very comfortable with the surroundings of the college also.

Name: Dhanalakshmi
review: There is an abundance placement opportunities for the students of the college. The statistics of placed students is about hundred percent in every year. Some of the companies which provide the students the jobs are freshworks, zoho, real image, black board, Uber, Paypal, Amazon and many others. The average package of every students ranges up from 6 lakh and above.First of all the student should have passed the class 12th examination with a minimum of 50% of marks in all the subjects then entrance exam is undertaken by the college authority to select the candidates in the course of BTech. You have to give the entrance examination and pass the examination to be selected by the college authority for the course of BTech.

Name: Athira Babu
review: This campus is ragging free. Campus is big enough and the infrastructure of the college is well built. Facilities like libraries, labs are well maintained by the college's management. Name: Swarupendra Nath Chakraborty
review:
For the electrical engineering department, there are a significantly large number( around 30) of faculty members to help the students. The associate professors generally have an experience of around five years, and often come fresh from the industry. Most of the associate professors have PhDs along with a few published paprs under their belt.
The assistant professors generally have an experience of around ten years, and undergo regular training and recertification. Assistant professors have quite a few published papers, regarding the various fields of research they have done. The senior professors are highly experienced, often having been teaching for fifteen or more years, having taken part in several research projects, and mentoring and assisting several students to achieve excellence in their chosen fields.
The faculty of our college are very supportive and helpful in dealing with several problems the students might face in their time in the college.Admission to NIT Silchar is obtained thourough JOSAA counselling, after gaining eligibility by giving JEE(MAIN) for engineering. Based on the rank thus obtained, and the preference list for colleges filled online, a branch is alloted among all of the NITs and other engineering colleges. After that, one has the option to either freeze at that particular branch at the same college, or choose float for a different branch at the same college, or move on to the next round of counselling. All in all there are 7 rounds of counselling, with all thouree options available for the first 6, and the first two options for the last.
Generally all these processes take place over July and August, and I ended up choosing electrical engineering, both because it fascinates me, and also because it is tough for me to sit still for long periods of time, so computer science and electronics ere out of the question.

college: IIT Kharagpur - Indian Institute of Technology - [IITKGP]
review: The campus life is really diverse. From academics to social and cultural events, students can indulge themselves in various events. We have techno-management fest Kshitij, Social and cultural fest Spring fest, Global entrepreneurship Summit, Alumni meets and other events as well. All these activities are managed and organised by the 3rd year students, from the ground up to the top. The gender ratio is one thing that lets you down, we have aa drastic difference in number of girls and boys, on an average the gender ratio is around 1:10(1 girl for 10 boys, duh.). We also have inter hall competitions for sports, tech, and social and cultural, involving exciting events like, product designing, musical events, athletics, water polo etc. Our halls compete for the General Championship trophy in every fields. We also have different societies for students with different interests. We have debating society, robotics society, musical society and others too. Just name it and we have it. Students can fill their choices of Stream and College in the descending order of their priority.
For example, a student will fill like
1. CSE in Jadavpur University
2. CSE in Institute of Engineering and Management.
3. ECE in Jadavpur University
.
.
.

Teams exist for all sports on a university and college level. Over 50 clubs, so many that there is internal competition between each of them. There is also a high amount of collaboration and it is very easy to find one of your calling. Nearly every domain has been covered by a club, from film making to public speaking and modeling.

review: I had come to this college for admission before the entrance exam results were out because people said it would be difficult to get an admission here. The fathers here said it’s not possible and there was some entrance exam conducted here; which I didn’t know and the exam was over. So they said now the only way to get in here was to wait for the results of the KEAM exam. (KEAM exam has this practice of releasing the marks before they generate the rank list. Like so we knew the marks before itself) When we asked about the expectancy to get with the marks what I had secured, they told it’d be difficult if we compare the previous statistics. So we had to go empty handed all way back. But I don’t know to my astonishment the ranks were out in two weeks or so and I had secured marks that fetched me a decent rank enough to get into almost any course I wanted here. So I had given ECE as my first choice as I like to learn more about electronics and communications and it a growing domain. Name: Hinal Vithlani
review: In VIT, all the courses are divided into 4 types i.e. Program Core, Program Elective, University Core, University Elective. Any core subject is a mandatory subject. However, electives can be taken up according to your interests. VIT allows for a flexible credit system so you can advance your skills in your preferred domain of interest. There are 3 examinations per semester, CAT-1, CAT-2, and FAT. CAT-2 is often an open book examination and is entirely application based. The project component involves the student to think out of the box and deepen their learning on the subject and are hence helpful in placements. Industrial visits are also organized by the faculties.The VITEEE (pronounced "witty") examination takes place a few days after the JEE Mains examination. VIT University sends a booklet to your address with some sample questions of the VITEEE examination. It involves MCQ from Math, Physics, Chemistry, and also 5 questions of English. It involves the application of simple formulae and is very easy as compared to JEE Mains. The admission process is based upon the ranks you get in the VITEEE examination. Each branch consists of 5 categories which have different fee structure. The seats start filling up rank wise during the counseling in all 4 branches of the University- Vellore, Chennai, Bhopal, and Amaravati.

Its function is to plan the process of manufacture, develop various tools and machines and integrate facilities required for producing particular products with minimal expenditure of time, labour and material. Coursework is designed to include the art of designing jigs, fixtures, press tools, creating die casting designs, plastic moulds designs, mastering advanced plastic processing technologies and becoming perfect in metrology and measurements. B.E./B.Tech in Tool Engineering is a 4-year programme. Tool engineering is based on the use and application of various industrial tools within a manufacturing set-up. Students specialising in this branch of engineering pay attention to the structure and stiffness of the various industrial tools and machines used for creating certain products. One can pursue M.E./M.Tech in Tool Engineering after successful completion of BE/B.Tech.

There are five main events in our college.
1. Advaya ( Inter college festival)
2. Academia conclave ( By industrial Experts)
3. Yuktaha ( National Level Technical Symposium)
4. Sudeva ( Sports Day)
5. Dhaksha (Annual Day)
1. Advaya:
It is an inter college festival. Students from our college participate in the events conducted and they will be showcasing their talents. No matter what, it is one of the beautiful events in the odd semester of that year. There will be a lot of programs for Advaya. It lasts for 2 days and hopefully it's a good event.
2. Academia Conclave It is a conclave conducted by the institution by calling various industrial experts to give a lecture or talk on their point if industrial experience and what they want from students. It lasts for one day with four sessions. It would be quite interesting. It will be in odd semester every year.
3. Yuktaha
It is a national level Technical Symposium of our college. It lasts for two days. It will be in even semester every year around February. There will be students participating in the events from all over India. People from other colleges are invited and they will be having technical, non technical events. And moreover there will be a stunt show,pro show and many more exciting things that would happen that time. Hope you would know when you see them. 4. Sudeva
Sudeva is our sports day. There will be relay races, 100m Dash and 200m dash. There will be a lot of sports events conducted on and before that day for which the prizes would be given to everyone of them. This is technically the sports day.
5. Dhaksha Dhaksha is our annual day. There will be many cultural events like dance, solondance group dance, music band, solo singing and much more stuffs like skit.
Apart from these very big events there are events for festivals like Onam, Pongal, International women's day, Republic Day, Independence day.The course curriculum is vast and to be frank somethings are not necessary for us to learn. Name: Shreyansh Gupta
review:
Placement and job opportunities are good as being in the IT hub Pune. This year is our first batch yet to graduate out from the College but the companies who already have come and offered the packages made our College a brand with the name in its first placement itself. The best package we had this year was 22 lakhs offered to 3 students from GOJEK an international company who again offered 35000/ month in a 2 month internship to 4 people from 3rd year. Then many such companies having stipend above 7-8 lakhs were allowed to enter too like LNT,TCS etc.
Yes College offers internship not to be done in the College itself but in other well established IITs/NITs/IIITs where the stipend is based on your knowledge and learning or completion of their projects.It's a national importance institute established under MHRD 4 years back. Like all other IIT/NITs, to get admission in any of such IIITs too only entrance exam known is JEE. According to the jee mains ranks, JEE conducts a councelling consisting of 7 rounds at general and then the special CSAB rounds. So if you get it through jee u get it otherwise u dont. Generally the rank cut off Comes out nearby 30 thousands for CSE and 37000 for ECE of IIIT Pune (these ranks are other than the CSAB rounds). My rank was a bit higher than the required rank for CSE, so had no option and chose ECE for staying in branded IIIT with IT hub Pune. Then on merit basis, I changed my branch after the first year of my BTech.

Name: Baisakh Sarangi
review: The placement area of this college is good enough for getting into some non-core as well as some core companies. The Training&Placement Cell of the college is working very hard gradually for engaging companies for recruitment of large number of students. The various core companies visited to the college campus are- Maruti Suzuki, L&T, etc and other non-core or Software companies are- Infosys, TCS, Wipro, Accenture, Cognizant, etc. Although I haven't taken any internships till now but the internship procedure is very simple in this college. One who is willing for taking an internship just have to contact to the Training and Placements Cell of the college and that's it. Then the T&P Cell manages everything and instructs the individual what to do next. Also the college provides special training programs for Placements during the end of 3rd year or starting of 4th year.The course curriculum is prepared being synchronized with the GATE syllabus. So by completely studying according to the course curriculum one can be at least prepared at the base level for attempting the GATE examination at once without taking any external coaching. If one takes the course syllabus seriously into account and starts studying profoundly from day 1 then he/she can definitely assured of cracking GATE examination at once or maximum twice. The practical/ Lab section of the course curriculum is designed to provide industry-specific knowledge to the students, which in return helps in getting various students placed in various core companies like Maruti Suzuki, L&T, etc and non-core companies like Cognizant, Tata Consultancy Services, Infosys, etc. Also from 3rd year industrial visits are organized for the students.

Name: Yash Agarwal
review: The college celebrates all the national days with utmost passion. It has very enthusiastic cultural, literary and technical societies which keep hosting events which involve mass participation. We also have technical fest where students from all the technical departments namely Computer Science, Electronics, Mechanical and Civil create masterpieces and demonstrate them in front of all. the college also has a Formula Student team where petrolheads from all the departments come together and build a professional formula student racing car and take it to the international and national level competitions like Formula Bharat and SAE SUPRA respectively. It offers all the facilities to keep the students going and motivated throughout the 4-year course even when they are away from their hometown. the gender ratio is 60:40. we have various clubs who keep hosting shows all around the year, for example, flash-mobs, musical performances, drama. The college also has an Entrepreneur cell. A lot of students also participate in MUN's as well. The robotic club keeps the robot fanatics busy all around the year. the college has an active formula student team which involve members from all the departments, be it from CS, IT, civil, EnTC, Mech. and participate at national and international level competitions where they compete with the top teams of the top most colleges and have been successful in making a spot in there. Besides this our college organizes an event named OPEN HOUSE, where student share their ideas about innovation and what they want to do etc. And, also a 3 day sports meet is also conducted every year where college witness a massive participation from students of college. Other events are organized by the technical and Cultural clubs we have Dramatics club, Music Club for self development we have societies-: VOYAGERS(event organizing), IMAGES(event organizing), Les Amis, NCC, NSS. Name: G NANDA KISHORE REDDY
review: Usually, VIT refers to the Vellore institute of technology conducts an entrance exam every year for engineering and other branches through which the admission process takes place. Usually, the exam takes place between March-May time for which one should fill an application form which will be opened by December on Vit's official website or you can get it offline through if one visits College. The application fee may be around Rs1400/- at my time. For BTech entrance exam is compulsory and based on the marks scored merit list is given through which one can join based upon his rank. Whereas for my course Mtech software engineering integrated one doesn't need to write an entrance exam but the merit list is based on a 10+2(PUC) percentage of Maths, physics, chemistry. Based on your rank there are ranks allotted and a specific counseling date given on which you must decide under choosing the College branch (Place) basically Vellore is the first priority, next comes Chennai, Amaravati, Bhopal. There are nearly 5 categories of fees that are given based upon one's rank. I got 93% in My 10+2 and I got the Chennai branch in the 2nd category where Vellore seats were done. So one get easily get into Vellore institute of technology as there are many categories of fees ranging from 1lakh to 5lakh. But if you want to get a low category fee then your rank must below to get the main campus i.e Vellore. But one needs to remember in order to get admission one should compulsorily submit the application form without that you can never get into College.Vit follows a different curriculum i.e as it a deemed University it has its own one. Basically, the course curriculum in Vit is really good. Like for example, the course curriculum is prepared as if it is connected to a real-life problem and in a practical way. For example, I have many courses like Programming language Java, Software architecture for each one we have a J i.e project and lab where one can take real-life examples and connect it to theory. The exams in Vit as usually the same as others we have two internal exams i.e Cat(Continuous assessment test) where CAT-2 will be an open book exam. Though it is an open book it will be a bit tough. And finally one final assessment test for lab and theory. If one has a project component the evaluation is based upon the review submitted. And we have three Assignments which is the only one thing one can score directly and easily. So totally it will be like 30% for Assignments, 30% of CAT, 40% of FAT. So one doesn't need to worry about CAT marks. But should make it good in Assignments and FAT. If one fails to clear a course then it's a different way in Vit, like you should re-register the course again with a fee of Rs6000/- and go for all classes and write the exam again. So please be a bit careful with your marks.

The college is pro hindutva, there is a sanskrit morning prayer, have a cultural department which gives courses such as cultural education and amrita value program. Internships:
College provides internships only from the 7th semester (beginning of 4th Year). However, a student can apply for an internship on his own irrespective of his year of study with required help from his faculty members. The college also has a fully functional placement cell, called CIR (Corporate and Industry Relations). They aid in the training and betterment of a student and also help students look for opportunities. Internship experience and stipend:
Some internships include Student Research Fellowship Programme, wherein a student works under a research mentor in any Indian Academy of Science campus. Their stipend comes up to ?12000 for two months. Other internships from college are at Amazon, Cisco and Bosch for relatively minor designations at a stipend of about 4-7k.The curriculum is archaic but still abridged to some extent to allow certain new topics to be taught in a brief manner. Syllabus covered is around 15+ years old but research is vibrant if you collaborate willingly with professors. Course curriculum is comparatively lighter than those offered in other colleges. Exams include 2 periodicals for 50 marks each and 3 quizzes for 10 marks each in a semester. They're easy to score in and aren't all that difficult to cope up with.
