review:
It is very good curriculum observed here in my college. The exam structure follows in the following way 70+30 Marks total of 100 Marks 70 Marks is the final semester paper It consists of a total 10 questions from 5 units of syllabus in every subject. In those 10 questions we should attempt 5 questions that to we can attempt question 1 or question 2 from 1st unit That is a internal choice for 1st and 2nd question like the same way one question from the 3rd and 4th questions should be attempted from unit 2. This process follows for all the 10 questions.
Where the remaining 30 Marks were internals And it was further divided into 20+10 20 marks for mids/internal examinations 2 mid tests will be conducted for 30 Marks and those were reduced to 20 marks in 2/3 ratio.
The highest scored mid will be multiplied by 2 and the low scored mid will be added to that and the total is divided by 3 to get the internal marks of 20 and 10 Marks were taken average of 2 assignments and 2 quiz test of the respective subjects.
Lab examinations: 2 internals and 1 external will be conducted Internal exams will be conducted for 25 Marks each and the final external will be conducted for 50 Marks.They were well trained faculty and were very student friendly. In the first internal theory is conducted for 50 marks and whose weightage is 5 and the weightage of theory is also 5. So total weightage of first internal is 10. Similarly the weightage of second internal is 15 equally divided among theory and practical. The theory is conducted for 75 marks for second internal. The third internal also has a weightage of 15 equally divided by theory and practical but the third internal theory exam is conducted for 100 marks. Another 10 marks is given on the basis of assignments and attendance. 75% attendance is compulsary for all the subjects. So total internal weightage is 50 marks. The semester final theory exam is conducted for 100 marks. The final exam has weightage of 50 marks equally divided among practical and theory. review: Extracurricular activities, sports are maintained by clubs, there are various sports and cultural clubs which include cricket, football, volleyball, basketball, dance, literary, music, dramatics, etc. For these clubs, there is a cricket ground, football ground, volleyball court, basketball court, tennis and badminton court, TT room, chess and carrom. The exam structure consists of two quizzes, one mid-sem and one end-sem exam, the weightage of each exam is decided by the faculty in charge and lab exams (where applicable)

review: A very valid scholarship, I know about is vikram scholarship. Hindi school scolership obc people are granted twenty eight thousand rupees so that they can use the money for studies and other things that scholarship is for people whose family income is less than a thousand rupee and the another scholarship is mukhyamantri medhaavi chaatr yojna which is very good for people students who has scored eight percent plus marksPositive and negative remark about my college the positive is that we get enough time we have good teachers and we have a library also which provide book anytime but the negative points are that the library is open from only ten thirty am to five pm and teachers are not giving their hundred percent not the students or the environment is not that good not study focused on m et cette

Name: Vishal chabhad
college: Parul Institute of Engineering and Technology - [PIET]
review: I am the student of gujarat, here we have to get admission in college through acpc merit list, and via acpc. First we have to clear one exam called GUJCET , our merit list of acpc is generated by combining both gujarat board and gujcet results, when new academic year starts, we have to register through acpc and get our documents verified there. It is round based selection, when we have to select colleges where we would like to take admission, when round starts and it checks by merit list in which college we gets admission, if the college alloted to us we don't like, we can wait for next round. After acpc selects college for you, just visit that college on desired date and confirm your admission there.Our college is too good when it comes to the celebration of festival, they celebrate each and every festival of every religion. And not only this they also arrange their own events like tech fest, fun fair, projection, dhoom the annual fest. As i can say in 365 days we celebrate 600+ events and festivals here.

Name: Shaurya Singh
review:
I think Computer science engineering branch is currently leading over the world. It provides us knowledge about the computer languages such as C , C++ , java & the most important and easy language python. The exam structure are based on University exams. It is conducted semester by semester. And internal exams are also held such as sessional tests & pre University exams.Smalls companies such as wipro, capegemini, etc companies come for placement and their package is also too low around 2.5 lakh to 6 lakh per annum which is very low for CS students.
Yes college provide internship facilities. The experience is not really helpful but wo learn much about leadership qualities , hrd work ,etc.

review: Mostly positives, you are super engaged in the college activities which happen all round the year and at the same time you feel the need to excel in academics. It is sloppy in its works a lot of time and a lot of subjects feel irrelevant.Yes, the most exciting part. The campus provides a lot of opportunities of enjoyment, probably one of the most active campuses for activities in Kerala. The techno cultural fest Dyuthi being the major highlight. There are loads of other events like Union inaugurations, Onam celebs , last year we had Halloween, this year diwali, and many more.

review:

Name: Ananth

When I asked my senior they told it was excellent and great opportunity got into.The course curriculum of the college excellent and there is a LTP takes place in every subject and curriculum is pre defined no change will be there and 4 years and outcome of the curriculum is excellent and there is no defect. There is an instruction plan also which is help full to student to know what is thought today how to prepare for it. Even online reading videos links Are also available in it.

Name: Yogesh
college: R.M.K. College of Engineering and Technology - [RMKCET]
review: The course I study currently is computer science and curriculum is anna University pattern which is a little bit lagging from the external universities as Anna University provide good knowledge but from the basic the subject mainly focuses on theory not much to the practical because of this I think the curriculum and the pattern is lagging behind because the children needs more practicals than the theory part which will gain their knowledge instead filling the papers in the examination.firstly I didn't know about the college and then my father's friend suggested this college and we went for the enquiry and the process of admission from that we came to know that it is based on the 12th mark ok and then we went back to the house and discussed with us and then concluded to go to that college because it is reputed and the food is very hygienic the transportation is provided over all the colleges good and I got admitted.

Name: Nikhil
review: College has a wide network of extracurricular activities.There are many different clubs like nature clu etc, different technical societies like IEEE,ISTE etc. operating in our college.Physical educational department of our college is well developed with good college team for football, cricket, basketball, volleyball etc.2 batches of National Service Scheme is also preaent in our collegeCourses are well selected according to different branches of engineering.Every year there are 2 internal and 1 main university examination.There are total of 8 semester during the entire course.Apart from regular examinations supplementary examination are also conducted for those who failed to attain minimum marks during regular examinations

Name: Keshav Kumar
review: The placement are very good for CS/IT/ECE. Almost 90% of students get placed. But as far as the placements of core branches are concerned, they do not get good placement. Yes there are some students who through their extraordinary skills get placed at high packages also but overall it's not good for core branches.Our college celebrate many fests every year. In March tech fest named PRAYUKTI is celebrated and students from many colleges come to participate and enjoy. Annual cultural fest also takes place in the month of November. Many games , treasure hunts and etc are played every year.

Name: Likhith Kumar Raju Konduru
college: IIT Tirupati - Indian Institute of Technology - [IITTP]
review: The extracurricular activities are really awesome because there will be a active participation in the co curriculuar activities so the college staff also allow and they will encourage us to participate in the extra curriculuar activities. They will also conduct all sports games every year by making groups and there will award the overall performance trophy ? also.We can also get the scholarship if your parental income is below 4.5 lakhs then only your are eligibile for this scholarship and one more condition if your parents are government employees then you will not get this scholarship, the scholarship name is MCM(merit cum member) scholarship.more over we can avial study loan for our studies

Name: Joel Sunny Varghese
college: Sree Buddha College of Engineering Pattoor - [SBCE]
review:
Curriculum is good but not as in industry level.

Lab experiment are more beneficial for practice.
For University exam some eligibility criteria,
There are two series exam in a semester and assignment and projects these are considered for internal mark, to eligible University exam minium of 23 out of 50 are need.Expo- xplore , it technical expo for present projects created by students this expo is opened to public.
By continuation of expo also conduct inter college workshops and Hackthon
Tech fest- this fest is also known as cultural fest the students shown their tallents in dance ,song etc. college band and celebraties are attraction of this event.

Name: Sabarinath J
review: Our college is following Kerala Technical Universities syllabus.The University came around a 5 year it had many mistakes in conducting exams and valuation. The revaluation scheme most of time made failed students pass by a good grades. There are two semesters in each year.Total 4 year course.Each semester had two internal exam and assignment test also.Each subject is given different credits.year out system is also followed those who failed to achieve the required credits got wash out.There are two kind of main events taking place in college along with small small programs.First one is Tech fest which take place in odd semester named as Takshak.And during even semester Sanskriti ,these are the two main events.And also important days are celebrated in college with various programs.

Name: Elvin Jacob
college: Sree Narayana Guru Institute of Science and Technology - [SNGIST]
review: The university is new and they have a credit system. Each subject has a set amount of credits, failure to attain those credit criteria will result in revaluation. The exam structure is as follows, there will be 2 internal exams and one university exam , internal exams are necessary for getting internal marks and you also need 75% attendance if you can't get these you can't attend university examThe fee structure is quite affordable and we get totally worth tution. The regular merit seat fees is 30000, and the same for the management seat. There are also college bus and hostel facilities, you have to pay for your distance and use accordingly for both of them.

Name: Soumyadip Ghosh.
review: The course curriculum is very well planned. It is very rigorous which remains consistent throughout the 10 semesters. There's 5 mandatory subjects. With 2 core lab and 1 extra lab or extra subject. From 7 semester there's an option to select elective subjects as well. The exam structure follows Bloom's taxonomy i.e the toughest questions remain in the last section and the level of hardness increases through every section. There's a mid sem of 30 marks. Internals of 20 marks which depends upon faculty, when he/she will conduct or maybe it will evaluated as assignment. And then there's an end sem of 50 marks. There will be lab exams and viva voce as well of 100 marks.There's no shortage of events that are celebrated in KIIT. From a local Odia festival to halloween. Everything is celebrated. Durga Puja, Saraswati Puja, Ganesh Puja, Laxmi Puja, Diwali, Holi, Christmas, New Year, NSS Week and many many more. There's no dearth of celebration in KIIT. KIIT Fest is the dedicated college fest where big celebrities come to perform over a span of 3 days. And there's many more events from several clubs in KIIT which take place year round.

Name: Preet Nandeshwar

review:
Mhtcet exam.

Placements are good here so overall average college

Name: Shantanu Gupta
college: Mukesh Patel School of Technology Management and Engineering - [MPSTME]
review:
There are a variety of events in our college. There is a cultural fest, tedX(TED talks), YSF(Youth Speak Forum), NMMUN(Narsee Monjee Model United Nations), tech fest.

We do have internship programs and we're supposed to find the companies ourselves for the internship but if we're unable to the University helps us.

Name: Alarik Truman Vaz
college: Mukesh Patel School of Technology Management and Engineering - [MPSTME]
review: I saw an advertisement in the newspaper for the entrance exam of my university. I applied online for the entrance exam. The exam conducted by my university is the NPAT exam. The exam comprises of logical reasoning, mathematics and English questions. Once I obtained a rank I went for counselling for the admission process to choose the course I wanted according to my rank in the exam.My campus is vast and has many facilities for sports and extracurricular activities. We have two tennis courts, a basketball court, two badminton courts, a volleyball court, a full size cricket field with a pitch, a football ground and a swimming pool. Additionally we also have a gym, a movie theatre and a music room.

Name: Sagnik Bagchi
review: The fees are a bit expensive, but the facilities are also pretty good. The fees are expensive because it also gets used for the funding of underprivileged tribal students who are taught at KISS. They study, eat, and wear everything free of cost, which is a very good initiative, but it's the reason why our fees are a bit high compared to other private colleges in the same league.There are labs for each and every department and in multiple numbers with the latest of equipment and technology. Our University also has great activity and enthusiasm in various sports like cricket, football, basketball, hockey, etc and has several courts, grounds, gyms, swimming pools, etc.

Name: Debarghya Majumdar
college: SRM Institute of Science and Technology - [SRMIST]
review: It is expensive because it is a private for profit organization. And i get scholarship of 35000 by getting pass in EAMCET entrance exam.my college provides necessary information for all scholarships.

Name: Rutvik patel
review: The ffcs system is used in this university where a student can study their interesting courses. EXAM STRUCTURE-- there are 3 exams per semester. The first two are 50 marks exam and last is 100 marks exam. where the second exam called CAT 2 is an opened notebook exam. students can bring their notes to the exam. There are 60 percent theory weightage and 40 percent lab weightage.I have given an online-based entrance exam called viteee, the rank list was then declared and I was selected so I had attended counseling and confirmed my seat. At the time of counseling, they will call students which course they are interested in and provided that course according to their rank if there are any seats available.

Name: Salman Hussain
college: NBKR Institute of Science and Technology Vidyanagar - [NBKRIST]
review: In my opinion, course curriculum is perfectly designed and is adaptable and learnable in given period of semester. Maximum of 7 theory subjects and minimum of 5, and 3 practical labs are allotted for a semester(approximately 5 months). Coming to exam structure, 40% are internal marks (exams conducted by self institute and question papers are set and corrected by self faculty). And this 40% is also divide in to two parts for 1st mid term exam and 2nd mid term exam. 80% of highest mark among two mid exams and 20% of least will be considered and equals to 40% of internal marks. And remaining 60% marks are external exam marks (question papers are set and corrected by anonymous paper verifier from main university where our college is under affiliated).Entrance criteria of our college is through entrance exam(EAMCET). Seats are allotted to students who appeared and qualified EAMCET with required rank. Seats are allotted in ascending order of ranks who opted this college in their web counselling options entry. Out of 180 seats in each branch, 20 seats comes under management quota, i.e who has to pay whole tuition fee, whereas entry through EAMCET will get ?.35,000 as reimbursement form government. And, I got admission through entrance exam(EAMCET).

Name: Sahil Hassan
review:
I got admission in this college through an entrance exam known as KEAM. It is an all kerala entrance exam for students who want to go for engineering. There are 2 parts of the exam which are Math and science. After i wrote the exam i got a rank of around 16900. Then the next step was to give different options of which college to go to. I selected Muthoot as one of my options and got a seat at this college. After i got a seat i was asked to pay a fee of Rs. 10,000/- to confirm if I was joining the college or not. So I paid the amount and confirmed my seat at the college. Then I was asked to come to college for the admission process. I reached there and they verified all the documents and told me to pay the college tuition fees and some other fees as well which amounted to Rs. 60,000 almost. I chose to pay only one semester fee and pay the rest in the next semester, and yes this option is available and very convenient as well. After this I was asked to wait for the interview with the HOD of the department i had selected which was computer science. So after waiting for a while I was called and he asked me a few questions, such as why i had joined this college, why I selected this course, what are my ultimate goals, and then I answered them and then he asked me if I had any queries about the college and I asked about the sports facilities which are pretty decent. And then he welcomed me to this college and said I could leave. And then I started going to classes here.The course curriculum in my opinion is still a bit outdated and way too lengthy and there are many unnecessary and insignificant topics to study. In first year I had to study physics, chemistry, engineering mechanics and many more subjects which I had no interest in and also would not be helpful in increasing my skillset in any manner whatsoever.
The exam structure we have at this college includes a total of 3 Internal exams and one external exam for theory papers. Out of the three internal exam the first 2 have more weightage i.e. 20 marks each and the portions are the 1st and 2nd module for the first internals, and the 3rd and 4th module for the second internals. The third exam is given the least weightage which is just 4 marks. The external exam is conducted by the university and corrected by the same. The practical exams are conducted and evaluated by the college itself. We have continuous evaluation at our university so every lab hour's performance is taken into account and the final lab exam is for 30 marks.

Name: Aditya Prakash Gupta
college: IIT BHU - Indian Institute of Technology
review: We have 5 Councils- Games and Sports Council, Science and Technology Council, Cultural Council, Social Welfare Council, Film and Media council. Each council has its own college festa. The KASHI YATRA is one of the oldest fests of IIT BHU. It is organized by the Cultural Council and is a Cultural Fest of the college. Events like singing, dancing, debates take up in this event with prize money of over 3 lakhs. It happens between 15-20 January every year and is a 3 day event. Next fest is Technex- the technical fest of the college- organized by Science and Technology Council. It is a 3 day event taking place in Mid February every year having a prize over 3 lakhs with events and competitions related to Aero Modelling, Robotics, Coding, Startups, Astronomical and Core Engineering Events. Then comes Spardha- the sports fest happening in the end of October. It is 3 day event and the Asia's Largest Sports Festival. Film and Media council has an event called FMC WEEKEND- a 3 day event with competitions like Film Making, Photographies and many others. Each council depends on other councils and helps each other in their respective events.The course structure is well planned and curriculum is also well maintained such that the students get a good time for extra-curricular acrivities and also for studies. We have a credit and CGPA system as in US and other top foreign universities. We have each course of a pparticular credit. Lab courses are usually of 13 credits. The credits are divided as follows-3-1-2, 3 is the number of credit for each class. Each week we have 3 classes so we have 9 credits, 1 credit for tutorial and 1 for self study and 2 for lab. So in this way we have 13 credits of lab courses. We have mid semester and end semester examination. Mid semester examinations carry 30% weightage and end semwstwr examination have 60% weightage. The rest 10% is of Class Assignment/Attendance/Class Tests and Quizzes. Grading system is as follows- A* hrade for outstanding performance and A for excellent. Both have 10 pointer. A- has 9, B has 8, B- has 7, C has 6, C- has 5 and after that it is F or Fail grade. So CGPA is calculated as- Sum of grade×credits of each subject divided by total number of credits.

Name: Dharmik Savaliya
review: The past two years or so have produced perhaps the most rapid changes ever seen in higher education. The “completion agenda” set forth by President Obama and the Lumina Foundation has enabled instituitions to focus on the graduation of all students, rather than only those who enter as part of a specific first-time full-time freshman cohort. Concurrently, the introduction of MOOCs (Massive Open Online Courses) has generated a substantially increased focus on the potential for degree completion through an online environment. These changes have also generated a significant amount of competitive recruiting,Few college-bound students have the financial resources to pay for their post-secondary education entirely out of pocket. Even students with substantial college savings plans typically find that they are left with sizable amounts of unmet need. The average total cost of attending a public four-year college is more than $20,000 per academic year. Students planning to attend a private college or university can expect to spend more than $30,000 per academic year. A college education is a costly proposition, and all indications are that those costs are only going to increase.

1. Curriculum in our institute is a bit outdated and needs to be updated very quickly. Practices like lab file record and tutorial assignments are still prevailing here.
2. This kind of situation is there in almost every NIT system institute and graduates from these instituitions lack up to date knowledge of industrial needs.
3. There is semester system in our institute with each semester lasting about 5-6 months and two major examinations held in each semester.
Mid-Semester Exams - 20 Marks End-Semester Exams - 60 Marks
Teacher's Evaluation - 20 Marks
That makes total of 100 marks.
No. Of subjects in each semester is usually 9-10.
About 6 theory subjects and 3-4 practical subjects depending upon your branch.1. Science Stream students like me who had Mathematics as their 3rd major subject along with Physics and Chemistry, give the National Engineering Entrance Exam known as Joint Entrance Examination or JEE.
2. JEE comprises of two exams ie JEE Main and JEE Advanced. On the basis of JEE Main scores ranks are given to students and on the basis of these ranks students can take admissions in NITs, IIITs, GFTIs , etc. Similarly on the basis of ranks in JEE Advanced students can take admissions in IITs.
3. I gave JEE in 2018 and got decent ranks in both JEE Mains as well Advanced, but rank in JEE Advanced was not enough to get my preferred branch in IITs so I went with MNNIT Allahabad which is best NIT in North India.

In each semester there are 5 to 7 subjects which we need to study out of which 5 are the necessary ones, that makes 40 different subjects in 4 years! In the first year, students in all the branches(CS, IT, Electical etc.) have the same subjects which they're required to study, afterwards they have to study subjects related to their respective branches. During each semester, we face 4 exams of all the subjets of that semester, 3 mid-semester exams(called midsems) and 1 end-semester exam(called endsem), the 3 midsems are 30 marks exams each, which we face during the 2nd, 3rd and 5th month respectively, out of these 3, the one in which our performance was best is selected and its marks are carried forward. Then comes the endsem exams which decide if we're going to pass that semester or not, they're 105 marks exams held on the 6th month of that semester, the pass marks are 33 for endsem.

Name: Krishnakanta Soren
college: Veer Surendra Sai University of Technology - [VSSUT]
review: To get admission in this college one needs to crack jee mains entrance examination.The admission process is done through ojee website as it is a college of Odisha government. First we have to register using ojee website and choose our desired colleges,seat allotment is purely based on merit this selection has three rounds which spans over a month and seat alloted is also subjected to upgradation and after the end of the selection process we need to go for document verification at a nodal centre as suggested by the ojee council here they will check whether one provides legit documents and verify them thoroughly. After this one will be alloted a specific date branch wise where we have report at the institute where the final phase of the admission process will take place but before that we have to make sure we have registered through the college website and pay the academic fees for the first two semesters at once. During the final phase of the admission process at the institution we again had to verify the documents and after that the admission into the college was completed.For extracurricular we have independent clubs here which teach us technical stuff which we generally don't get in classroom teaching there are three types of clubs here technical, cultural and sports club and each of them are very good these clubs are operated by the students body. Technical clubs include enigma ( programming club), robotics society and idea and innovation cell, for your information India's first student based indigenous multipurpose satellite VSLV was built by the members of this club. Cultural club include drama club, literary club, dance and singing club soul and vibrance. We also have sports club here which include cricket, football, badminton and basketball. Each club is unique in its own way and students spend their time here and learn something thing new every day.

They also conducting placement training from third year. And also training for government jobs. More company visiting our college to hire students.

Name: Suhas PS
review: We don't have any negative remarks for the college because, it's not appropriate for a student to talk or project ones college in a negative way, I experience very good decorum in the college, and last but not the least there is always every way to improve and I hope that my college will do that in the coming days for our successors.As far as I know the students get placed in service based jobs, I don't think it's so obvious that they need to implement in their work which they had studied because what we learn in college is in the level of developing something but service based jobs is not a cup of tea for the engineering students.

Name: Shravan jakkula
review: Extra curricular activities lab sports and workshops conducted every month in our college and students are coming from various colleges across our city. My college having cricket ground basketball ground Football ground and indoor and outdoor games facilities.Placement and job opportunities are awesome my college as placement and training cell which is separate Department. My college provide internship opportunities in various companies like Infosys TCS, every year nearly 80% of my college students are placed.

Name: Jigyasa
review: 1.5 lakh per sem. Hostel fees is feasible as hostel facilities are best. You can’t miss home here. Good quality food and big rooms. Daily cleaning of rooms washrooms are cleaned twice a day. Water despenser in every hostel. Whole year hot water is provided for bathing. Tution fee is little bit expensive but are not too much as labs are fully established and equipped.No scholarship is provided by college as it is a private college. 1.5 lakh per sem. Hostel fees is feasible as hostel facilities are best. You can’t miss home here. Good quality food and big rooms. Daily cleaning of rooms washrooms are cleaned twice a day. Water despenser in every hostel. Whole year hot water is provided for bathing.

Name: Sirsendu Maity
review: I have passed Intermediate on 2018.After complete my intermediate i am looking for higher studies.First i applied in Calcutta University for B.sc in Chemistry but the merit list releasing date was too late,then my father suggested me to study in B.Tech Agricultural Engineering.That time i gave WBJEE exam.I had not so good rank.Thats why i was worry about that all of my friend taking admission in good college but my merit list releasing date was too late.Then i decided to study B.Tech.One of my father friends told him to take admission in this college.This course is very good and carrer opportunity also very good.I am studying B.Tech Agricultural Engineering.Here i am studying 4 Engineering branches subject not the full details but i am knowing the basic things of 4 different Engineering branch.Agricultural Engineering is the combination of Civil Engineering,Mechanical Engineering,Electrical & Electronics Engineering & Computer science Engineering.In our course semester wise exam is conduct in every year.Total 8 semester is there.Course duration in this course is 4 years.

Name: Sanket Umredkar
review: I gave the entrance test(MH-CET) of Maharashtra state. Then the results will be announced in one month. And we get our rank based upon our marks. Then we have to fill the preference of college and their respected courses. There are 3 rounds. So based upon your rank you get referenced wise college.Seniors are very helpful. The alumni network is also strong. The college organized many events. In which alumni also taking part. We have a separate website for students and alumni on which a lot of taking advantage of having great alumni. They share there experience on websites.

Name: Rittick Dutta
college: Swami Vivekananda Institute of Science and Technology - [SVIST]
review: The placement are good. I am a 2nd Year student and i noticed that in the previous year there were more than 18 companies came for placement session and till now more than 56percent of the total strength is placed. Yes they provided internship. But unfortunately I couldn't get one. Getting the opportunity of internship totally depends on the candidate. But the college gives ample opportunities for internships and also they sent their students in the other colleges to take part.And in my opinion people who really work hard or are worth it they definately gets placed in reputed conpanies.I am a student of Mechanical Engineering, the sllybus is not very easy. The course curriculum is totally based in maths and physics. But in the 4 years the most important part I personally felt was the practicals. The practical knowledge is the most important thing a student should take care and the college is under Maulana Abul Kalam Azad University of Technology, therefore in every one year there are two semester. And in each semester there are four internals. And before each semester exam there will the practical exam taking place accordingly.

Name: Pratik kumar
review: Our college celebrates different events all the festivals are celebrated I our college. Apart from the festivals we have our fests. The fests of our colleges are CULFEST it is a cultural fest providing opportunity to students to excel I cultural activities. Then we have OJASS a technical fest for technical competitions. The we have URJA a sports meet for the encouragement of sports activities.The placement secnario of our college is great with an average package of 7 lakhs per annum. Being situated In an area with many Industries in the nearby area there is a lot of job oportunity for the core branches. Our college provides us with internship opportunities as well as pre placement offer. Overall this the college you would aspire to be in.

Name: Ayush kumar
review:
We have a Sports club here, who organizes all sporting events here. We've football, Cricket, Volleyball, Basketball, Athletics as outdoor games. In indoor games, We've Table Tennis, Chess and Carom. Coming to lab, In BIT You'll come across oldest machinery and lab instruments. neither there is no proper guidance in labs nor they have proper instruments and infrastructure for labs here.
Though new machines and new labs have been deployed but still most of the laboratories are not much beneficial for practical knowledge required in this era.So, If you are willing to have a memorable college life with least money spend and to get degree from a reputed Gov't College then buddy, come to BIT. Best thing that you'll get here is time, Actually we've plenty of time here for any exam preparation like UPSC CSE, GATE, IES, CAT, etc. It is so because we don't have much classes and too much vacations and this is the reason that most of the BITIANS crack these exams every year with flying colors.

Name: Waquar haseeb
review: Positive remark of my college is that it's infrastructure and faculty are quite good. Library is just like book store. No place to sit and read in library. Nothing is fascinable outside hostel. No competitive as well as friends-like environment. It's due to big campus with less students.College celebrate three festival. One is technical fest which is generally organize in month of March. Secondly, cultural fest which is organize in month of November. Last is FOYC which is organize with cultural fest. All fest are of 4-5 days duration.

Name: Mohd Umar Abdullah Abbasi
review: As I mentioned every thing is good in this college like studies and placements but there is not much crowd and you will never feel like you are living college life you will only get support of college for academics realted. But you will never see any events gonna happen.No, as I mention extra curricular activities are not gonna happen here. You have to do that by yourself like by going pune for events or lonavala city to attend events. No fresher's party even so that is the biggest draw back of college.

Name: Kshitij Gupta
college: Thapar Institute of Engineering and Technology - [Thapar University]
review: A lot of events happen in the college every semester. The main events include FROSH-This is a freshers week only for the newly admitted students. SATURNALIA-The annual techno cultural fest of TIET and is open to all the students of other colleges as well. It is a week ling event. STRATAGEM-The only economic fest of TIET. It is a multi event fest and consists of all types of entrepreneurship, bidding, shares and stocks events.I gave the Joint Entrance Examination (JEE). I filled the application form of the college. The college released a list of ranks eligible for specific branches and in 3 rounds online only. The alloted me my branch according to the preference I had set in my form. Then there was an in person counselling where hostel allotment and fees payment was to be done. The admission letter was given that day.

Name: Uditkamdar
college: Devang Patel Institute of Advance Technology and Research - [DEPSTAR]
review: Yes, we have very good placements and job opportunities. And as it is computer field more companies are there as compare to other fields. As I am in second year only I have not done internship till date but ya after my second year is finished we all have to do internships.As usual all colleges have one technical fest and one cultural fest. Our both events are organised very well and mainly students have to organise this so it also provides students to set a platform. We also have sports week alongside with cultural fest.

Name: Vasu Godhaviya
college: Devang Patel Institute of Advance Technology and Research - [DEPSTAR]
review: There are some positive remarks as well as some negative remarks. Infrastructure, facilities, teaching staff quality, food etc. can be considered in positive remarks. In negative remarks, I would like to share that there are some loopholes in the selection community for any events as all students are not getting equal opportunities.I got admission on the basis of ACPC merit rank. From the 12th standard result all the students get respective merit rank on the basis of which they have to choose the college and respective branch. There are 3 rounds for admission among which 2 are online and last one is offline round.

Name: Ram Adeeth G R
review: The course curriculum is good. There are two internal examinations conducted by the college. And one external examination that is conducted by KTU. Overall marks of a subject is calculated based on the internal examination as well as the external examination.The faculty of my college are very good.They are very supportive in nature. They help the students both in academic and non academic problems. The teachers in my college are highly qualified which is very helpful for the students.

Name: Rohan Verma
review: Good, It's a bit hectic but it is fine 3 internal exams ans then final semester exam one between 6 months. It is of 60 marks and then we get a final result which has a CGPA in net these exams are combined with the internals which we give aduring the semester which are of 30 marks each and 10 marks for assignment.The faculty here is definitely quite helpful. Our teachers are very supportive and their help us getting internships in all the stuff. The best part is whenever you have a problem will help you will help you solve the problem and anything in like if you're having a problem they help you out.

Name: Akshant Ratwan
review:
We have a lot of events performed in our college. We have cultural fest, technical fest, some other festivals which provide numerous options to children to have there talent shown to other fellows.
We have internship talks here, numerous interview and placements talks.
One can take part in seminars,debates ,youth parliament etc.Alumni network and seniors are far good and helpful. we can approach them for whateer help we need and they help us. they are good,resourceful and helpful. some seniors have done their interns from prestigious institutions so they conduct intern talks so that we can take help from them about these matters.

Name: Jenish bhadani
college: Amiraj College of Engineering and Technology- [ACET]
review:

Name: Deepak Tiwari
review:
College is affiliated to Aktu so they follow aktu exam structure.Aktu also change the exam center of student from one college to another.
They are arrange the complete exam from start to end of calendar year.College follow the rule of semester system.There are many extra curricular activities like aktu sport fest and many others events labs are organised on propee basis, all labs are present in my college and the time table of labs are fixed. They also organise many others event in auditorium.

Name: THARUN KUMAR MOTTU
review: First I had written the TS EAMCET exam the after results are announced i had completed my counseling after the verification of the certificates i had selected the college and courses whuch i am interested in then after i had for few dats then after i had got an invitation to the collegeTheir are no good scholarships or loan facility provided by the college bur the gover of telangana provides the good scholarships for the students who are eligible fir the courses and thus is one of the best idea of the governance

Name: Sudhir guntha
college: Shivajirao S Jondhale College of Engineering - [SSJCE]
review: There are Many scholarship available in my college ie Ebc and for obc and St caste theres alot of benefits for those students and I got offered Ebc scholarship from my college and that helped me alot to my parents and my family.There are many scholarships for middle class and low class students in my college.The college infrastructure is really good with many facilities and faculty is good too and they help us every single time with our problems but they give alot of assignment which are really alot it takes so much time to complete those assignments that's the only negative point.

Name: Anshul
review: The placement cell for Computer Science Engineering is good. May good companies come to our college. This year good companies like Samsung and Amazon came to our college. They have given many students placements. The placement for Electronics and Communication Engineering , Civil engineering , Mechanical engineering and Electrical Engineering are not that good but they are not bad too. And yes , college provide internship but I dont know about the stipend.Firstly I cleared a very famous exam known as JEE MAIN. After clearing that exam we go to the website of JOSAA where we get to know about the ranklist.We get to know about the colleges we can apply for.Then we fill the college and branch we want to choose.Then if we are eligible we get the seat.And we to go to the nearest JOSAA centre and register our seat.

Name: Kaushal Agarwal
review: The labs lack mordern equipment. The equipment are old and rugged. But still it works fine. The best thing is at lab there is no final exam but a Viva is taken. The sports culture is fine. Usually the students from sports quota are into sports. Many Inter- University championships are played. We have a team of American football. For other extracurricular activities there are clubs organized by seniors.The course curriculum is quite good. The unnecessary subjects are not included in the curriculum. Also the exam pattern is easy. We have two class tests of 30 marks each which is averaged and semester exam of 100 marks which is scaled to 70 marks and combined with class tests marks. For laboratory there is marks for every attendance and cumulative performance. Instead of final exam, a Viva is taken.

Name: Arpit Jain
college: Veer Surendra Sai University of Technology - [VSSUT]
review: The college doesn't provide much scholarship for the students. if some want to apply for the lian they can apply going to bank itself. In this case the college need to work.Of they provide some loan facilities for higher education then I'm not aware of the programs.It's a clear process.we need to paas each semester without any backlogs to get into the next year correspondingly. I'm pursuing Electrical Engineering and and got to say that they cover alsmost every aspect o the course and have a good practical sessions.

Name: Sanjay Kumar S R
review: There are many sports facilities in our college, our college has got a large space area as the football ground, our students has shining in football, one of my senior has joined in tamil thalaivas,as a teammate, there are many more games are there in our college,according to lab facilities all are good but our college is some what older, so some machines are temporarily not running,it will be rectified quickly.Yeah, each and every alumini are supporting us and teaching how to come back without arrears and they were showing huge intrest in encouraging us, our seniors and us were being like a family, If any problem between other departments we all unite together and finish all the problems. Allways we the mech family is united thats our strength.

Name: Omkar Godse
review: Extracurricular activities like sport tech, dance competition, singing competition, antarang are taken by college, all labs are good in condition also all machines are working in all labs good caring of machine are taken by college, for sports there is only football or badminton ground are available, but football turf is payable for students.First you will register your information on maharashtra government website, then you have to choose your college preference. After some time merit list was declared.if you are in list you will selected for student.managemant admissions are also available in my college.

Name: Harsh
college: Dr. S. S. Bhatnagar University Institute of Chemical Engineering & Technology - [UICTE]
review: Placement record is quite good. Our college has 94.6 % placements last year with average pack of 4 lac approx. Many famous companies like ExxonMobil, Johnson mattey, Honeywell UOP visit our campus. Relaince provide many interships to us and also offers preplacements. We have sponsors like MTV , VERKA, SBI bank, etc. We also have fashion show where many famous celebs. Were invited as guest. We also have starnight where many punjabi singers came.

Name: Srinivas
review: Good, some of the lab teachers don't no anything they also learning from lab attender, but some teachers are very good in teaching they teaches nice, but some teachers even they don't know what they teaching, they are learning still not fit for teaching.Nooo, positive remarks but college is quite decent and the outside students like northes they are driks and they smoke they, Nooo, positive remarks but college is quite decent and the outside students like northes they are driks and they smoke they.

Name: Vivek kumar dixit
college: Feroze Gandhi Institute of Engineering and Technology - [FGIET]
review: In BTech it have various types of branches are there i.e. ME, CSE, EE, ECE, AE, CE and many more specially talk about computer science branch in this there is a lots of job opportunity in private sector and there is also chance to ekrk with multinational companies.Rahamat sir have a very help full nature he always support in each and every feild where i feel need of him he always gives me motivation to do something for the nation and other to and he gives me tips hows to crack gate examination and other compitative exam.

Name: Harsh Goyal
college: Punjab Engineering College University of Technology - [PEC]
review: The course curriculum is good. It covers all the subjects that a student needs to be a part of practical world. Talking about Exam structure there are mainly two exams each semester mid term and end term along with these there are several quizzes and assignments are given to check the performance of the student.There is good interaction between juniors and seniors. Freshers get to know about the experiences of seniors and some secret stuff not shown by the college. But there is less interaction with alumni group it’s moreover restricted to their batch. But overall seniors are helpful in every means.

Name: Akash Kamble
review:
Yes, alumni as well as senior students have good collaboration.
Alumni refers in their companies for students for placement in this college.
They always supports college for placement.
Senior students shares experience with their juniors so they can avoid the mistakes which have been done by senior.There are different scholarships in this college.
For SC , ST caste there are scholarships like government post matric scholarship.
For NT there is also scholarships.
There are many scholarships like Punjabrao Deshmukh Scholarship, Central sector and many more.

Name: Ansh Vaid
review: I gave the LPUNEST exam which provides admission in the University with the scholarship depending upon your marks you achieve in the LPUNEST exam.In the same way I also gave the LPUNEST exam which is just like any other competitive exam but this one was online exam.I cleared the exam with good marks so I got the opportunity to pursue Honors program also.Therefore now I am pursuing B.Tech CSE(Hons.).LPU provides 100 percent scholarship to the students who are among too three in LPUNEST exam, then 90 percent scholarship to those who are among top 10 percent students of LPUNEST and to next 15 percent it provides 80 percent scholarship and so on.

Name: Ankit Kumar
college: ISM Dhanbad - Indian Institute of Technology - [IITISM]
review:
IIT-ISM Dhanbad provides different courses in B.Tech, M.Tech and MBA. The course curriculum and Exam structure in B.tech is as follow: 1.It is a 4 years course. 2.There is 2 semester per year and total of 8 semesters. 3.There is total of 4 to 5 subjects and 2 to 3 labs per semester. 4.Each semester consists of 1 mid-sem exam (30%weitghage), 1 end-sem exam(60% weitghage) and 10% on class test /attendence/behaviour. 5.The result of each semester is in GPA form(out of 10 points) and the final result of complete course is in OGPA(weitghed mean of GPA of 8 sems).many scholarship provided in our college for those who really needed. college also provide tution fee waiver for students having low family income:
1. family income < Rs. 1,00,000- 100% Tution fee waiver( of Rs. 1,00,000). 2. family income < Rs. 6,00,000- 2/3 rd Tution fee waiver( of Rs. 66,666).
Loans are easily available for students in order they can complete their degree.Our college have their own SBI bank from were students can get educational loans in less comparatively interest rates.

Name: Vaibhav Patel
review: There are many types of scholarships in the college. A scholarship which already given by government to obc, SC and st candidate which help to minimize the fees more than half. There is also relaxation given by college if you performance is good in 12thIt is feasible fees structure. It is best fees structure in providing a good learning. There is also many types of scholarship provided by college and government to make fees more feasible. It is a good place in giving good learning with less fees.

Name: Srinath reddy
review: Overall this is a good college for all the engineering aspirants. It is among the top colleges in hyderabad.Under the administration of Matrusri Education Society in the no span it has become best engineering college in the city limits. This college is affiliated to prestigious OU and Monitored by the society.In placements also college has done remarkable things and students who get admission here will be around developed during the course period of 4 years.The curriculum is good so far. It's really flexible and free. It helps you study and understand things in a easy and precise way. The exam structure here is we have 2 internals along with 2 slip tests for theory subjects and only one internal for the practical subjects. The final exams are conducted at the end of the semester.

Name: Ranjan Mishra
college: Veer Surendra Sai University of Technology - [VSSUT]
review: Appeared For Jee Mains. The signed up in Ojee portal. Filled up applications. Gave a choice list in decreasing order of priority list according to the marks I secured. 3 rounds of selection held. In the first round verification of documents held against the college of your choice. Then appeared at college for admission.Fee structure divided into semester wise payment. Every semester you have to Pay Rs 24550 per semester for a boarder. Dayscholar pay way less amount. Separate Rs 14000 to be paid for hostel payment. There is a scheme for tution fee waiver.

Name: DANY VARGHESE
review: Recently we celebrated onam, Kerala's regional festival. We celebrate women's day, Holi and many other events. Technical fest named 'HESTIA' was one of the most memorable event in all these. Those 5 days were so imformative, enjoyable and the experience is actually mind-blowing. College management supported as well.Lot of our seniors are being placed in our college. Many international companies are hiering our students because of the experience and name of our college. Even many are placed, I feel like the salary they are provided is very low. Only some of them gets good offers. So placement cell needed to be improved.

Name: Zuveriya
college: Vidya Vikas Institute of Engineering and Technology - [VVIET]
review: In the first year the admission fee, University fee all over them where totally 21500 +1500(for skill development fee). Gradually in the second year 71500 with a miscellaneous fee of 720 and soft skill training and development fee of 1500 and in the third year gradually increased of amount 74220 and skill development fee of 1500.There are labs workshop stationary student council room for students which were maintained clean and good way  and also many sports like cricket, basketball, throw the ball, etc and many competitions were held like science exhibition and more like mathematics debate competition and hackathons, etc

Name: Varsha Sahni
review: Yes, Roorkee college of engineering does provide internship opportunities for the students in all the branches of the B.Sc students complete their internship from the outside and the college gives them the recommendation letter on the basis of which they can do their internship easily from theirs. Roorkee college of engineering has a separate training and placement cell that takes care of the placement of the students and for the internship.Fees of Roorkee College of Engineering is INR 1.20 lakh per annum. Hostel fees for normal rooms are 55000/- including mess charges for the year. Even the college also provides an education loan facility. Fees are fixed accordingly by the AICTE norms The management quota fees are feasible and flexible. Reductions in fees and various scholarships are provided by the management depending on our performance.

Name: S Sidhartha
college: IIT Kharagpur - Indian Institute of Technology - [IITKGP]
review: Kshitij the techfest, Spring fest the cultural, National students space challenge, Departmental fest like samudhramanthan, Prithvi, Megalith. Kshitij is the techno management fest have a lot of participants from all over the country. Spring fest is one of the most colourful events in college with the programmes of famous artist and speeches of famous people.Yes, the alumni cell works actively keeping tje campus connected with its alumnis. The alumnis include google CEO Sunder Pichai and isro ex chairman K Radhakrishnan. The alumnies give valuable suggestions to the students regarding placements and intership as well as in funding the startuos by students.

Name: Karna
review: College fee is fixed in a range 80k to 100k. They structured the fee only in the name of tuition fees and other requirements like Transport fee and hostel fee. They first permitted to pay the tuition fee by dividing into two but now they asking to pay it within first odd semester itself.If the student had scored more than 95% as cutoff (out of 200) atfirst now I dont know they provided a full free tuition fee and hostel or transport fee as scholarship for students. And also they conducting a talent every year for new students for scholarship.

Name: Pritam Vediya
review: First we have to give GUJCET exam then after results we have to fill ACPC FORM which makes a merit list from all over Gujarat. Then after merit list of first round if we have to change the alloted college then we should go for second and third round then after one offline round is there for those who still can't able to get the needed college.As this is a government college the fees structure is not that much it's just of rs 1500 for admission and other fees like exam fees and all are different. People usually see the fees structure and say that this is just a simple one but in compared to other gec this is a nice one.

Name: ADITYA GEDAM
college: Dr BR Ambedkar National Institute of Technology - [NIT]
review: Each year the is a technical fest called Techniti in which many technical competition and events takes place in which students from various institutions take part. There is also one cultural fest called Utkansh in which various events of dance and singing etc takes place. Also Bharat Dhwani is celebrated as the foundation day of the college.The course is of 4 years and is divided into 8 semesters of 6 months each. In each semester there are 5-6 theory subjects and 3-4 practical subjects. In the first year there is one subject from each branch of engineering and from 2nd year we have subjects of our branch. In each semester we have 2 minor exams and 1 major exam.

Name: Sanket Singh
review:
Technozion- It is a tech fest held every year in the college in the month of October or November. Several stalls are made by students showing their talents. Students from all over the country visit during this time.
Springspree- This fest is mostly about the cultural fest with varioud types of games and programs mostly related to extra curricular activities.Some of them are pretty good, most of them are helpful.Some professors are soo old that they cant even teach nicely. But anyways they try to help the student as far as possible. The new young professors of electronics department are very enthusiastic and they usually talk about the new technologies in the market place right now.

Name: Shrinivas Kulkarni
review: First, I wrote Karnataka CET exam which is required to get admission in top colleges based on the rank given by KCET then I got 2704th rank in CET and in 2018 August I got admission in that college (National institute of engineering) mysore.Extra curricular activities are going on throughout the year and it conducts sports competition and it has well facilities of the lab it has physics lab and chemistry lab and alsoany computer labs and also software labs.

Name: Ankit Kumar Ladha
review: First of all one need to appear for JEE Mains exam and if he\she crack the exam then they have to fill the Jossa college preference which has 7 round of selection in which the selection is made on the basis of the ranks scored by the student in JEE Mains. Better ranked students are given priority in to take seat of their choice as per filled in their Jossa list.Cultural Fest, Technical Fest, Cosmopolitan, Hall Fest each semester, Sports events, Inter Nit sports activity, Inter Hall competition with all these events the college focuses on the all round development of the students since all the events are organised by the SAC (student activity center) and it is runned by the students of the college.

Name: Shivay Bhateja
college: Rajiv Gandhi Institute of Petroleum Technology - [RGIPT]
review: Our college calender has 3 events/fests. Cultural, sports and technical. Cultural fest-kaltrang lasts for 3 days in which there is drama poetry, dance, singing, debate, extempore and many cultural events. Sports fest- energia also lats for 3 days in which other colleges come to our college to compete in many games like football, volleyball, basketball, table tennis, lawn tennis,chess and many more. Last one is techfest-urjotsav also lasts for 3 days. As it is tech fest there are workshops on data science, machine learning, deep learning and many more. Students present their projects in the tech fest.To get admission in rajiv Gandhi institute of Petroleum Technology one has to qualify IIT JEE advance and should have a decent rank in the exam. Process: One had to sit in JEE Mains conducted by National Test Agency and have to qualify the exam. After JEE Mains, he/she has to qualify IIT JEE advance and should have rank less than 16000. He has to fill the form of Rajiv Gandhi institute of Petroleum Technology. Then you are now a student of Rajiv Gandhi institute of Petroleum Technology.

Name: Tawseef gulzar
review: When the new session starts there comes lots of new new admissions all over the India and some other countries firstly there goes activities for about 10 days after that there is hostel night for hostel boys and girls after that Freshers party after that sangria where a actor or actress comesCollege has good environment no problems regarding anything but the university gives too much backlogs as I have face this issue also I written full paper but what I get not even pass marks but the hope I will do my best in future

Name: Vibhu Bhatia
review: Bit mesra is a government funded tecknical institute (gfti) for getting admission in this college you need to attempt jee mains and qualify the exam and then on basis of the merit list the candidates are selection this whole process is under josaa joint seat allocation authority which is a government agencyThe faculty at bit mesra is pretty experienced most of teachers here are PhD qualified and are involved in various tecknical intervention all around the world also the college get new recruits from tequip every now and then most of the teachers are helpful and have deep knowledge about their subject

Name: Deepak
college: Sri Indu College of Engineering and Technology - [SICET] Ibrahimpatnam
review: Our college is known to provide many type of scholarships. We the students studying there get the information about many types of scholarships that even we don't know about them. They personally guide us to apply and prepare for it and finally achieve it. I have a friend named yashowanth he has got the best scholarship that to from iisc Bangalore. Name: Bhanu Prakash
college: ISM Dhanbad - Indian Institute of Technology - [IITISM]
review: There are numerous cultural and technical clubs and societies in this college which compete with other IITs at the annual Inter-IIT. Most of these clubs have built a commendable reputation for themselves by the virtue of their hard work and creativity. Students learn various skills such as photography, videography, art and craft dancing, singing, music, dramatics, poetry, literature, astronomy, debating and public speaking at the different cultural clubs while there are also technical clubs for coding and programming, robotics, formula cars, entrepreneurship-cell too. Students in these clubs also learn team work and event management along with these skills. Sports clubs for karate, chess, squash, boxing, badminton, hockey, football, cricket, athletics along with a few other also provide a good opportunity for the students to follow their hobby in sports and represent the college in Inter-IIT sports meet. But the major drawback of this college is that some of the sports and clubs are still not funded well enough to nurture and bring out the real talent of the students. Srijan(cultural fest) and Concetto(Techno-Management fest) being the most awaited ones and are very well know for their magnificence in all of eastern India. Khanan, organised by mining department is the most famous fest for mining engineering students and attract numerous students from all over India. There are other departmental fests like Vibhav(electrical department) and Pratibimb and annual sports fests (parakram) along with various other events like Fotomela (annual photography exhibition organised by FotoFreaks, the official photography club of IIT ISM Dhanbad) and Basant (annual Alumni meet)

Name: Siddharth Kishan
college: University Institute of Technology, Rajiv Gandhi Proudyogiki Vishwavidyalaya - [UIT- RGPV]
review: Not very good but in my opinion it doesn't matter much. Name: Yasam nikhil kumar
review: Yeah, the placements in our college are more like they are about 20 to 30 companies visit our campus every year and 90% of the students are getting placed in the topmost companies with good salaries and yes there is an internship but I haven't experienced that so no comments.There are positive and negative remarks like our campus is very huge 300 acres we all do what we want in here play games and everything and negative is the infrastructure is somewhat old I think that should be changed.

Name: Pranav M S
review:
First I wrote a National level Entrance exam called CET. Also I wrote a State Level Entrance exam called ComedK.
As my rank was not good in CET, got a seat in this college through my ComedK rank.
There are also college management seats available for those who were unable to take up entrance exams.They secured great jobs at very good companies. Getting Education here is good.
They have all completed their respective courses with great scores and have been placed in very good companies.
We also get help for different completions and hackathons from seniors.

Name: Nidheesh Siddha
college: Vel Tech Rangarajan Dr. Sagunthala R and D Institute of Science and Technology - [Vel Tech]
review: When I was in demise of not getting admission in any good college/institution then through a friend I have heard about this University. But it's too late for then to apply for the entrance exam. So there is a branch office near my home and I had consulted them regarding my problem, what they have said is that I can still get in with the 12th standard Marks I have got. So I shown them all the necessary certificates of my marks and they took me with a 50% scholarship and got admitted.Coming to the faculty for each department there will be only 4-6 professors and rest all are assistant professors with a PhD from a normal college all have studied and got that certificate from the local colleges only. They lack some quality regarding the concept dealing and it needs to be improved literally.

Name: Abhinay Kalyankar
college: Indian Institute of Information Technology Design & Manufacturing - [IIITDM]
review: We celebrate many events like - For the new arrival students we organise Freshers party in this Freshers will be showing their talent.Vashisht is a tech-fest event in which there will be compitation among students robots and also many workshops will be there. Samgatha is the main event of IIITDM kancheepuram.The mode of admission is based on the JEE (Main)1 and Plus-2 Normalized Score. The seat allotment to the B.Tech programmes is based on All India Rank published by CBSE. Admission is based only on All India Rank (AIR). The admission to Foreign Nationals is through Direct Admission of Students Abroad (DASA).

Name: Pruthviraj
review: Pimpri Chinchwad college of engineering is having its social responsibility cell ISR and NSS on national level. Our college is linked with the pimpri Chinchwad municipal corporation for various social activities. College not having good sport facilities.There is a exam called MHT CET conducted by Maharashtra government. Admission is given on basis of the merit and rounds. Three CAP rounds are taken for the admission. cap 1 cap 2 and cap 3. After that one additional round for spot admission.

Name: Shabhareesan S
review: Placement jobs are more in SSN but the students are interested in higher studies.No our college does not provide internship. Our college help us to find internships but they will not provide and you should decide the internship if it is paid or free.Yeah, my course is Chemical engineering ,it is very nice course in SSN ,and exam structure is we have three internal ,in which best two internal marks will taken and next we model practical and semester practical any last we semester.

Name: Dimple Chandnani
review:
From my point of view, the faculty is very competent and experienced. There are a few teachers that may not be upto the mark in terms of communication but their experience is top-notch. It's not possible the entire faculty of a college can be excellent, but some of them can be. There have been no issues or complaints about any faculty member from the students I know. Teachers have always used innovative teaching techniques and put in efforts to make sure we get the best.There are three major events in the college:
1) Vishwakarandak- This is an intra college event where each branch competed for the trophy. Various competitions in technical, extracurricular and sports domain are held. This is a 4 day event 2) Melange- This is an inter college event. Engineering colleges from all over Pune participate in this event. Even this event has various technical, extracurricular and sports sub events. This is the biggest fest of the year.

Name: Anandhu J B
review: I got admission from the kerala entrance examination (KEAM) rank list. The rank is decided by adding both entrance mark and +2 mark. After 1 month of exam result will be published and I got enough rank to get admission there. After getting admission we need to provide our educational and identificatio proofs. Also our rank list. They will check it and approve our admission.Yes our college is well known for its placements and job opertunitie. From the third year onwards various companies visit our college for recruitment. Almost all the well known companies visit our college every year. Also there are various scholarship provided by the college for poor and intelligent students.

Name: Vivin andrews
college: Karunya Institute of Technology and Sciences - [Karunya Deemed University]
review: Positive we have different cultures around the nation studing so we are able to learn more languages and cultures and the thing that irritates me more in my college is as im a dayscholar and my home is located in coimbatore city I need to travel 33km to reach my college so 66 km daily travel.Yeah, they provide us a clear solution towards our future they provide us. Jobs many has become entrepreneurs and they are constantly supporting us towards our placements. They are the building blocks of our karunya family with almighty's help we will do better and we will shine.

Name: Ashmit Ayush
review: Curriculum is good, infact excellent the corses are also at the right pace, and there are also hs subjects in each semester. Examination structure is that there are quizzes, midsem and endsem. Generally there are two quizes per semester.About placement I would like to tell that, being a new institute have accomplished a excellent average package. This year I think cse students have more than 10 lack per annum average package. I don't know much more about internships.

Name: Chavalokesh
review:
It is one of the best,through the courses are heavy we are getting a flexible timetable. We will have class assignments based on the subject credits,each subject will have their own credits more the credits more the weightage for the subject that will be added to your final grade,general for a practical exam there will be 4 practical exams and only one endterm exam and other subjects will have class assignments as mentioned above and a mid term exam and a end term exam.You will get scholarships based in your marks.
If you got above 95% in intermediate,LPU next(conducted by institute)a scholarship of 80000 in the first term of admission and a 60000 if scholarship in the 2nd term.
90% in intermediate,LPU next(conducted by institute)a scholarship of 60000 in the first term of admission and a 40000 if scholarship in the 2nd term.

Name: Karnatikarthik
review: The placement cell very well support as right from the second year they help us to learn what is required for a company and what need to do to enter the company for a job. They help us in many aspects like language improvement. They make us to reduce our stage fear etc.I was placed in the college by entrance exam. The entrance exam is EAMCET and the college cutoff is good. After that we need to go to the college and submit the certificates for submitting to the jntu and then we need to pay jntu and nba fee and that's it.

Name: Aman Singh
review: We have to write mid semester exam, end semester and quizzes to score our CgPA. Course is treated with upmost priority. Teachers are highly educated. They devote themselves in the lectures. We have assignments also twice in each semester.Sports is treated well. We have all the luxury sports ready to play in our campus. Badminton court,tennis court, swimming pool, basket ball court, squash room, table tennis, cricket, football, powerlifting , weightlifting, bodybuilding.

Name: Vipul Anil Devnani
college: Vivekanand Education Society Institute of Technology - [VESIT]
review: Extracurricular activities and sports are conducted once a year in the praxis event. Various outdoor sports like cricket , football and kabaddi are played. There is a indoor gaming room which contains carton boards , tennis tables and chess boards for playing when students have free time. All the labs are well maintained with the latest technologies and a high speed internet connection. A printer is made available for students. Also the labs are air conditioned.There is a placement office which conducted the activities of placements. The placement officers contact the companies which are in need of employees and the interviews are conducted. The percentage of students placed in computer branch was near about 85% and the average salary for them was around 4lakhs , which is pretty good considering a starter. The lowest offer was for 2lakhs per annum and the highest was of 16lakhs per annum.

Name: Parth Deep Matta
review: The course curriculum has been played out such that the topics are covered from complete basics. The mode of teaching is usually from certain prescribed textbooks and ppts prepared by the faculty. But in order to get the in-depth knowledge of the subject, the student must to self study and go for few topics beyond the scope of syllabus. The Exam structure is what I feel is a little not planed properly. There are 2 mid semester exams in which we get 3 compulsory 2 mark questions and 2 out of 3 optional 15 marks question. The total marks is 36. Duration 1 hour. And for the final exam is 3 hours, 5, 2 marks questions and rest 10 marks question, 2 from all the 3 sections.The placement drive held in our college is very vast and a lot of companies from all over the country visit the campus. But unfortunately the scope of my course us limited and the companies directly Core to our field are very less. The students did get placed in companies like, indigo airlines, stipend around 5LPA. Coming to internships, yes we have a lot of opportunities for that as the faculty is supported in that area. We can approach the faculty with a internship plan for company and they are willing to grant the permission along with the letter of recommendation.

Name: Yash Mane
college: Pillai College of Engineering - [PCE] Navi Mumbai
review: The best place for events as Alegria is very famous event conducted here. Throughout the year there are various celebration made in the college the one of the biggest festival is Alegria which is the biggest festival among the Navi Mumbai colleges. Various stars, Sports personality are invited during this festival also various games are conducted during that time.The placement scenario is quite good in our college. It has been successful throughout the years. Many students get placed every year. Infosys never fails to visit out college every year. The college has a good placement history with companies like Infosys, TCS, Wiped and Reliance JIO hiring from here. The average salary package is Rs.275000 per year.

Name: Danish khan
review: The Scheme is in operational since 2008. The objective of the scheme is to provide financial assistance to the meritorious students having family income of less than Rs.6 lakh per annum, to meet a part of their day-to-day expenses while pursuing higher studies. Annual target is 82000 scholarships per year (41000 for boys and 41000 for girls) which has been divided amongst the State Education Boards based on the State’s population in the age group of 18-25 years. Students who are above 80th percentile of successful candidates in the relevant stream from a particular Board of Examination in class XII and pursuing regular course and not availing benefit of any other scholarships, are eligible to apply under this Scheme. The rate of scholarship is Rs. 10,000/- per annum for the first three years and Rs. 20,000/- per annum for the fourth and fifth year.Creating an engaged, supportive alumni network is crucial to an institution’s success. If communication stops once graduates leave an institution, their understanding of the university will become stale. Instead, they should be kept informed so they can remain engaged and keep abreast on the progress of the university. Good alumni relationships bring many benefits to both the institution and the alumni. Here we speak to HE professionals who work in Alumni Relations about the benefits of maintaining an engaged alumni network and how the market is changing.

Name: Bimal Sunny
review: The alumni network here is a very strong group comprising of people in very high sections of the society. Due to the history and heritage of our college, we have a very supportive alumni network. But the best part about GEC Thrissur is the senior students here. From the time you enter college, they are the most friendly people you'd find around. As it is a 100% anti ragging college, seniors and juniors sitting together and enjoying the vibes of the college is a common sight for everyone here.The college is studded with labs and workshops of international quality. Each department has workshops of it's own kind in addition to the general labs for chemistry, physics, computer science, language skills etc. The highlight of the college is it's attention to co curricular and sports activities. There are a variety of activities conducted here,engaging all types of students throughout the year. The college provides excellent avenues for sports and cultural programs.

Name: Sairam
review:
I wrote eamcet to exam I have got 16000 rank which is a better rank when compared to my friends so I choose mallareddy engineering college and I got admission in this college I thought of some other colleges but after i came to know that mallareddy is goodOur college encourage extra curricular activities and labs in our college are good and it is certified by A grade by naac and college also conducts and encourage sports i also play
Sports over all college providers nice sports.

Name: Vismaya v
review: I got in through the management quota. Couldn't get through the merit seat because my rank was quiet less since I wanted to study in a govt college I got through the management quota, admission is mainly based on the entrance that the Kerala examination commission conducts ,in this college there are 10% management seats and 80 % is merit seats and the rest is NRI.It has lot of courses which includes electronics and communication engineering,computer science, chemical, civil, mechanical, mech production and electrical engineering.and our exam structure comprising of 2 series exams in one semester based on different modules hence making it easier for the students to perform well at the university exams.

Name: SALAUDDIN KHAN
college: Techno India NJR Institute of Technology - [TINJRIT]
review: Senior students are very helpful they help you with calmness and softness.
