Faculty is good and best. Exams structure is simple for toppers as well as weak childrens. Exams have gap of 3-4 days so that we can study well.

Name: Sairam
review: In the starting of the college the seniors are entertaining and motivate and said how the college is running and how to survive and how to behave with faculty. InductiOn programme and with orientation programme and middle of the year another events are conducted.Yes, the seniors are very helpful for computer language courses and other similar courses in the providing in the college. Obviously the alumini network also helping very well. Not only that our faculty also take the extra Time to solve our doubts at any time.

Name: Muhammed Nabeel
review: It’s wonderful.Exam, Are done Frequently. And They Provide A Bucket List Of Exams. As Practical And Therory Exams are conducted every week for a mark of 20 and later series exam for modules is also done and at the end sum exams are also done.Yes, They provide a huge number of placement around the country. A group of multinational corporations are tied up with the college management. And at the end of the year mostly every one of student is placed at right place right time.

Name: Alladi Nikhil
review: My college is about to change. Our principal is trying to change our college. For the betterment of students and to give a chance to students to get placed in good company.They conducted incubation center which help the students who are interested in business.Celebrations in our college will be started by freshers day and then a traditional day.On the traditional day all the students must were traditional outfits and participate in the event. Almost every festival is celebrated in our college.

Name: Sohail Makandar
college: SRM Institute of Science and Technology - [SRMIST]
review:
The main advantage of this college is the kind of opportunities that arise for every student to grab and develop themselves towards it. There is a lot of support for ideas and everyone has a good social life among themselves. The job opportunities are nothing to worry about and many different activities remotely related to the main courses like community service, etc. Are also carried out. The large variety of people coming from around the county and a few foreigners even, make it a great environment for everyone. There are some negatives like bad faculty at times and seldom politics involved in many management decisions but regardless a student is meant to have a good time and be properly developed into a good professional.The curriculum is vast and most of it is easy to go through. There are both technical and non technical courses that are needed as both basic and advanced education in technical skills as well as skills such as soft skills, professional skills, general aptitude, etc.
There are 3 CT's (cycle tests) conducted every semester which comprise of the portions completed before each Ct and these marks and marks given for other surprise tests and assignments compromise of 50% of the total marks given for a course. The other 50% is calculated from the final semester examinations.

Name: Yalla kushal reddy
review:

Fitness of students will be perfect due to this grounds.The course curriculum is very very good its updating every year mid exams weightage class internal exams weightage attendance weightage end term exam weightage total will be 100 percent every aspect of student is detailly analyzed by the faculty and marks will be allotted.

Name: Aakash A Das
college: Shri Ramdeobaba College of Engineering and Management - [RCOEM]
review: Admissions in RCOEM (Ramdeobaba College of Engineering and management) is through merit list decided by MHCET exam, conducted for admission in engineering and medical colleges of Maharashtra. Through MHCET, merit list is prepared and admissions are given. Another way for admission is through Management quota, in this procedure, rounds are conducted within the college, according to MHCET or Jee rankings. These are for the students who either want a better branch, or for people who weren't able to apply for MHCET rounds(but have appeared for MHCET). Once admissions is confirmed, we have to pay the fees, give all the necessary documents (informed by the college) and you are admitted.AICTE designs the course curriculum for the college. In my personal opinion, the syllabus for first year is a bit swaying from what branch we get(all branchs have same curriculum for first year). I don't think that a student of CS will ever need quantum physics in his career (and they teach quantum physics). Other than this, the curriculum is good. Exam structure includes 2 unit tests and 1 term test per term. Marks are also given for teacher's assignments, attendence, etc.

Name: Sabrish Dinesh
review: Fess structure is that basic fees is about seventhy five thousand rupees.Apart from that exam fees will be charged separately of about four thousand and many other fees will be charged.about eighty three thousand rupees will be charged.apart from that bus fees will charged according to the distance.it is some what expensive.There are many scholarship available here like scholarships from state government, central government and many scholarship from college for cristian community students. There are special scholarship for sc/st students. There is no loan fecility arranged by the college.

Name: Nabeel k
college: JCT College of Engineering and Technology
review: The fee structure is too high in jct college, and also they want to pay the fee suddenly. In joining time they say that all of you must pay the fee before semester exam but after the class they must want to pay the starting of the semester without pay first of semester they make huge fine for the students.Its a better college, jct got NBA certification so it is so valuable certificate we get. I am studing bachelor computer science its a good and better course in jct, it have a better placement also. Exam is too tough the 2017 regulation is very tough.

Name: Hardik Gori
college: Datta Meghe College of Engineering Airoli
review:
Positive response:- The college provides technical as well as practical knowledge about every particular field. It has the ability change the future of individuals and the country overall. Negative response:- The crowd factor over here is quite depressing. The college has no ground for playing but it does have a badminton court.The college being a technical college celebrates all the technological events.
Technitude is one such event which is intercollegiate and various colleges participate in it.
Along with technitude various other cultural festivals are celebrated as well thereby keeping a perfect balance for the overall development.

Name: Kaushik Shukla
college: ISM Dhanbad - Indian Institute of Technology - [IITISM]
review: Clubs and societies are very good. There are many clubs like litm (dance society) , roboism (robotics and ai club) and many more like photography club , arts club , debating club and more. Each club runs and is functioned by students.good amount of fund is given to each club.overall all clubs are exceptionally good. Sports is also very good. We have good condition playing ground for sports like cricket football, tennis , volleyball, basketball etc.Well overall college is very good and is providing many opportunities for the education as well as personality development of a student. Placement statistics is very good for cse and mnc students and other branch students who go for non-core jobs but in core the condition is not good especially in electronics btanch.core companies dont come to recruit student for ug students.for pg students its fine.

Name: Ishan Shah
college: G H Patel College of Engineering & Technology - [GCET]
review: Till now the college hasn't provided any internship.overall experience of the college is that it is a college to study for but not to boost your overall performance as there is no sports placement and job opportunities are quite good as many companies visit to the college campus for the interview.There is no scholarship facility that our college is offering there is also no loan facility which college offers they just take the money from the students they never give back the money. If they provide scholarship then it would have been great.

Name: Ishaan Salwan
college: Thapar Institute of Engineering and Technology - [Thapar University]
review: There is a merit basis for getting the streams.For instance if you are getting a higher marks in JEE you are eligible for getting good streams such as computers science,electronics and computer etc. There are various counselling rounds and i was called in the second round and there were various formalities which were to be signed and then i got computer science branch on the basis of my JEE marks.Faculty of Thapar is good. There are many hard working teachers which teach with full enthusiasm and passion. There are extra classes if a teacher has to cover up the syllabus. There is 75% attendance criteria which has to be religiously followed. Teachers are very strict about this rule. Also there are many teachers who did not teach up to the level but their number is relatively very less.

Name: Govind B Agrawal
college: IIT Indore - Indian Institute of Technology - [IITI]
review: You have a lordmgr scope here in extra curricular. There are different type like cultural, techicals, sports, etc. Also if you are interested in social help you can participate in it. They provide you with all basic stuff required to develop your gane and also you have the specialized teachers in each field to guide you.It is nice but according to me it is little bit outdated. We have been teaching all the old stuff and the latest stuff will come in the 4th year so it will give is a less. Time to learn since we will be busy in looking placement. Exam structure is nice. Each semester we have two exams one mid sem and then end sem.

Name: Praveen
college: University College of Engineering, Kakatiya University
review: NCC, NSS would take place from time to time in our college. Technical fests like robotics is also conducted from time to time. Sports have a separate effect in our lives we have 400m standard ground,indoor stadium, gym etc for our fitness improvement.Firstly I wrote eamcet entrance exam and applied for counseling.After 3rd phase of the counseling I was alloted a seat in KU College of engineering and technology in IT department. In the first phase I got JNTU(M) in the 2nd phase I was alloted mechanical in KU College of engineering and technology atlast in the final phase I was alloted IT in KU College of engineering and technology.

Name: Kushal kaundal
review: Faculty of college is too good teachers help in each step they are very helpful also teachers help fo compitative exams which is very helpful in every test for govt job also too good teachers from different states well expirenced teacher.Feee structure is 47 thausand for first sem and after that 43 thausand also for different events fees will taken accirdingly fee payments method either cash debit card or online method students can do whatever they want.

Name: JANAK VERMA
review:
There are various events that are celebrated in our College. Naming few of them are - 1: Abhivyanjana -annual festival which goes about 3 days and almost every possible event is included here. 2: Shouryotsav - sports week celebrated every year with every major sports included. And there are many other events which are held on regular basis.Fee here depends on the course you choose to enroll into. Since there are many course here around in this college fee also varies.
For technical course it is quite cheaper as compared to college nearby and realising the facilities and environment given here fees seems really feasible and totally worth it.

Name: Harsh Panwar
college: The LNM Institute of Information Technology - [LNMIIT]
review: All types of extracurricular activities of all the three councils are happening throughout the year in the college. All types of cultural, tech clubs are functioning in the college. Sports facilities are of top notch quality. All types of grounds and fields are present in the college. Gym is also there. Labs are well equipped with the latest technology computers and machinery with air conditioned well furnished furniture.Since I'm in the first semester of second year, I have not applied or I'm not even eligible for internships but yes many of my seniors are well placed and are doing internships. This year average was around 10 lakhs per annum with people placed in companies like Amazon, Adobe, Goldman Sachs, Microsoft etc. Samsung and Amazon also offered internships to the 3rd and 4th year students.

Name: Bharat vaddi
review:
Positive is the campus if fully filled with trees nowhere you could see empty place. The only college in INDIA to have all the trees and zero pollution campus no bikes cars are allowed into college including faculty vehicles. Animals like friendly dogs and lots of friendly monkeys will be roaming on roads. Negative are food they decrease the taste and a bit quality after some days of joining. Slowly you will be distracted and fed up with the food and some faculty they don't know how to deal students and how to make students interested in class.Sports you are free to play sports after or before your college hours. faculty and requirements will be provided.

There are also computer labs both old and new in each block.
Mainly each student has their own laptop.

Name: Akhil Guntupalli
review: I'm still studying in second year but our training for placements have already been started there you can see how much importance our college gives for placements. If we are a part of cloud or adobe courses in our college then we can get free internships in our college.we have to pay 30k for the courses in which we get the certification of course and free internships. These courses are simply.In the starting of our college. we have a freshers party. Later in second sem we can have a cultural event and technical event, in these events we can participate and we can even learn some small courses and win cash prize too. The last event held in our college is the UNDER 25 summit where lots of enterprenuers visited our college.

Name: Arnab roy
college: University Institute of Technology, University Of Burdwan - [UIT]
review: You have to give a semester exam and two internal in 6 months. BE course is for 4 years. There is a mechanics lab for 1st year which is not well equipped at all. For the ECE department, there are labs which are well equipped in the first sem, you have to read computer, math, chemistry, communicative English and mechanics. In the second sem, you have to read math physics mechanics and basic Electrical.I got admission through decentralised counselling of WBJEE. It was arranged just after WBJEE main counselling. It was arranged on 15 July. One can also enter through JEE main and WBJEE. You need not a good rank to enter in this college many seats remain empty so you can enter in it easily by decentralised counselling.

Name: P.H.PRUDHVI SAI
review: I think it's a bit outdated.the trending topics are changing every day but the syllabus is not changing.as per my opinion there should be industrial exposure.for b.tech there are 8 semesters.in each semester we are having 5 to 6 subjects and 2 to 3 labs.each subject and lab will be carrying some credits.every subject will be evaluated for 100 marks.in those 30 are of mid-sem and 50 are of end-sem examination and other 20 for teacher evaluation.using cgp formula cgpi will be calculated.Yes, they are really helpful.many of our seniors are giving us good advices regarding career, academics. Since they are more experienced than us. We do take their advices and suggestions seriously. There is almost zero ragging in the campus.Regarding alumni network it is one of the best in country.the alumni network develops the college and helps us in getting good guest lectures.

Name: Raghav Loya
review: BIT is a GFTI (Government Funded Technical Institution). As it is owned by Birla, it is a private institution (ranked 2nd in private colleges) and fee structure is expensive. Tuition fee every semester goes around 1 lakh which makes it 2 LPA just for tuitions. Hostel fee is around 5 thousand per month. So yeah, annual expenditure for tuitions and hostel is around 2.5 LPA to 3 LPA.The only and most important plus point of the college is its placements. CSE here gets an average package of 10 LPA while the highest package goes aa high as 34 LPA. Not only CSE, even other courses have very decent placements, with over 70% of the students getting placed almost each year. However, the college doesnt provide internships.

Name: YARRAGUNTLA Vedavyas
review: Events that are done are college fest, engineers day annual day freshers day and many other. in the college fest all the students who are interested can keep the stalls of whatever they want food stalls game stalls and many other. During engineers day the students who are interested can submit their project and that one has to be demonstrated to all the students faculty and other people.I got admission through rank gained in Eamcet exam conducted by andhra pradesh state government. It is an common entrence exam for engineering and medical. I got 3256 rank in eamcet. The state government will conduct cousilling for all the colleges in that counselling according to the rank we get and according to the credentials of the chosen college it allots the seat for a candidate.

Name: Aromal TR
college: Thangal Kunju Musaliar Institute of Technology - [TKM]
review:
Placement Cell is working efficiently in our college. And it is very useful for us. In recent days some of our college's students got placed in a company called capgemini.this Happened two days before.

Name: Akhil Raj
review: College follows the course curriculum provided by Kearala Technological University.You have to complete the 4 year course yo get graduation.Each subject has 6 modules and you have to face 2 series exam for 40 marks and an end semester exam which is of 100 marks.You have to obtain 45 marks to pass the sem exam.10 marks is given for continuous evaluation.So the overall total score is 150.All the extracurricular activities are provided in our college.Labs in pur college is of standered level. Cricket, Football, Volleyball, Badminton and Kabbadi teams are provided full support and training. Recently our college cricket team has won the runners up title in intercollege b zone championship.

Name: Amal Pradeep Pothan
review: Admission process is through a state level entrance exam called keam. After evaluation of the exam results the students select the college they wish to study and make a list according with the most preferred college on the top of the list and least preferred at last position and then according to their ranking in the exam results they are given a college in their list. There are more than one round so if a person doesn't wish to study in the college he has gotten admission he can wait for the next round. It all depends on 12th CGPA and exam ranking both combined.All kinds of events are celebrated in our colleges wether it is cultural or non cultural. Cultural events are celebrated by all students of our college and for other kinds of events we conduct events like quiz regarding the event. Last year our college conducted a national wide tech fest which was for 3 days which showcased many kinds of events and technical projects by all departments of our college.

Name: Ega nikhil
review: The fee structure is somewhat expensive that normal people can be baer. The fee is little bit expensive,but also that everyone. Can afford the price range to pay the fee.The college faculty is more convenient for students by giving sufficient time to pay.The senior students are having sufficient talent and they are very helpful for students for each and every problems that are based on and they are also being inspiration for the junior students. They are participating in every events.

Name: SRAVAN KUMAR
review: Course curriculum were so good ,teaching under smart way Technologies according to the syllabus.Reward point systems is one of the main criteria to achievie students in their own interest areas.Eexams were based on multiple choices and fill the blanks under understanding way,.Alumni network was highly good.They were too concentrate on the students growth for getting highly oppurtunities for their life.New ideas for the college to be in topmost interaction with the college transcript were so useful for the gradient students.

Name: Akash Das
review: Gravitas- it's a technical event in which clubs and chapters come forward to showcase their talents and ideas to a presentation as a fare and events conducted with music, stall, scientific things, robots, airplanes, bikes, and many competitions between different colleges. Riviera- it's a cultural event in which there is the arrival of any events related to music, culture, comedy, pop shows, Dj nights and is completely lit with lights and the coming of celebrities from all over India. Like after every month end the exams which are called CAT( continuous assessment tests) namely CAT-1 (closed book) and CAT-2(open book) with quizzes, assignments, and practicals. Then after 2 CATs are over then comes the practical exams followed by Final exams without sufficient time to prepare.

Name: Yeshwanth dasamukha

review: college will keep so many events like pongal and fest and farewell and freshers and during freshers will celebrate in jolly way and fest will done in middle of college and we will dance on stage and floor also And we have all lab facility with high instruments with AC facility And my seniors are very helpful to usTotal my college fee is 95,000/- for management quota and for Em cet qualified students they will reduce fee is 40,000/- rupees only and they will keep separate fee to bus facility and buss fee is 14,000/- and it will be added in yearly fee And they will give student loans for low finance people without interest

Name: Pranav Dharme

As the demand for mechanical engineering is high the cut off for this stream is also high. Curriculum and exam structure is solely provided my mother university- Savtribai Phil's Pune university.
Exams are held in April/may and also in November/December.Got online admission to this college on the basis on my CET score. This college was allotted to me through CAP round 2. This college was in my preference number 5. After allotment I submitted my allotment letter and my original documents in college.

Name: nikhil patil
college: Dr. D. Y. Patil Institute of Technology - [DYPIT] Pimpri

Name: Bibek
review: We celebrate kalataranga(anual feast), sports day,ganesha festivals,etc,etc. But our college helps us build our careers through many co curricular activities and events.The most liked festival for me is the durga puja which is celebrated every year on our sports ground and i love it.I think my course i.e, CSE in BTECH is pretty decent and i enjoy it.My college follows VTU curriculum and its tough as i heard. I prefer students to join autonomous colleges as their subjects and syllabus is quite easier than us and their 4 years will be enjoyable.

Name: Gautam Vince
review: I wrote the amrita entrance exam and came within the required rank after which I was called to the university.I met the campus relations head who spoke about the fee structure and gave suggestions to opt a branch and verified my 12th grade and 10th grade certificate s.Admission was given to me based on the entrance exam mark and 12th grade mark (min 85%)It's a college with good placements and not only focus on academics but also emotional skills of the students.Students are taught to be well disciplined and maintain good habits throughout the life.Only the food has to be improved in the hostel mess.Otherwise it would be the best option to consider.

Name: L vaishnavi
review: The placements in our college are excellent. Especially when it comes to our branch. Highest paid students will be from our branch only. Yes our college provides internship during summer days. It will be very helpful for our students. Not only for our students for all the other students also it is very helpful. They will also provide a certificate which is very valuable.Extracurricular activities are very good in our college. Labs are providing good knowledge to students. All lab materials required for students are present. Many sports tournaments are conducted in our college. Special coaches are also present.

Name: Vaghela Yashrajsinh

Name: G VIGNESHKUMAR
review: Extracurricular activities are great here. It has everything for your activities. It has a big, well facilitated library. It has a fully equipped gym for both boys and girls. The laboratories are well facilitated and neat. Many sports events will be conducted here.I've registered through online. The form required our details like name, 10th mark, 12th mark, JEE mark, caste certificate and so on. They will choose you based on your marks. They mainly see JEE marks and they will give priority to students in and near Tanjore.

Name: Pruthvi batta
review:
In our college annually two fest are celebrated one in odd semester and one in even semester. The odd semester fest is a cultural fest( Le ciel )which last for three days in our college I which students from various universities come and participate in our cultural competition and there will be a pro show on every day of the fest.
The even semester fest is a tech fest ( gyanith) in which there will be workshops conducted in our college and various tech competitions and students from various colleges participate and there will be a pro show related to technology on every day.Course curriculum is student friendly which have 6 theory subjects and 2 labs per semester which is easier to study. In exam structure we are having two cycle test in middle of semester which carry 20 marks each for a duration 1.5 hr for each subject and one assignment which carry 10 marks so a total of 50 marks as internal in which we have to secure atleast 20 marks for qualifying to end sem exam which is for 50 mark and duration is three hours. And result is published based on relative grading for a total of 100 marks converted into GPA.

review: Future of shipping is in sake for the moment but in time it will get back to its standard. Course curriculum is based on shipping, ship repairing and bulding. Exams are conducted each six months in the name of semester exams. There would be 8 semesters in total.No up to the standards as expected. There are various technical facilities available in the college. Some of the facultys are taken in for a year or so and there is no proper teaching staffs here. Other curriculum activities are not promoted by the college.

Name: Shriya Seth
review:
The course curriculum is pretty intensive. There are three theory exams in a semester ie two continuous assessments of 50 marks each and then one Final assessment of 100 marks. The semester will also include multiple digital assignments and quizzes along with project reviews and lab assessments.They offer different criteria
For star students education is free, only have to pay for hostel and food accommodations.
For NRIs it’s pretty expensive, their only criteria are 12th percentage. They have to pay at least 5 times the fee of a norma student.

Name: Fahad Rahman
college: MGM College of Engineering and Pharmaceutical Sciences
review: According to the marks attained by me in grade 12th. I had a pretty good score in grade 12th which helped me in getting admission in the college. They do not have enough equipments for the proper functioning of the labs. The other activities are conducted in an orderly manner giving the students the chance to indulge in various extracurricular activities.

Name: Rohit Pratap Singh
college: Harcourt Butler Technical University, School of Engineering
review:
There are placement opportunities in the college.
It provides campus placements for the students.
There are some unique branches under Chemical department (e.g. Oil ,Paint ,Food,Plastic ) which gives nearly 100 % placement.
Also other branches like CSE provides very high placement statics.
But some branches like Mechanical ,Civil fails in good campus selection. Overall I can say that if you have skills you will be placed in HBTU.
Coming to internship , it provides internship in 3rd year ( also in 2nd year not so sure ). In the branch PT it offers internship in Thailand ( 3 students) each year. Other students also get internship.Yes there are scholarship schemes.
As per my knowledge following are available for B.tech students:-
1. Fee Waiver ( Based on entrance & income , If you are a FW you will not have to pay the tuition fee as in my case)
2. UP scholarship (available for those whose family income is less than 2 Lakhs )
3. It also provides loan systen ( in some cases)
There are also scholarships for projects and GATE which can be checked at University website or through Academics.

Tech cse) i would expect the same in the other courses as well cos it reaches/touches todays trend like ML, AI. exam structure is VG here, 5/100 for attendance >75 and 25/100 for internals(CA) and 20/100 for mid-term exams of half syllabus and remaining 50/100 are from endnterm exams of whole syllabus but this is not the case in lab practical subjects.

It is a nice college. Such a nice environment to study and we get every possible opportunity to be a successful in our life.

Name: Soham Aradhye
review: Admission procedure is just like any other college in Pune. CAP rounds. Based on merit lists, we are alloted in the college. review: Gud year which the students will have with this sooo many workshops will be also provided laboratory and soo events on technical also will be held and calibration is only for juniors year which the students will have with this sooo many workshops will be also provided laboratory and soo events on technical also will be held and calibration is only for juniorsyear which the students will have with this sooo many workshops will be also provided laboratory and soo events on technical also will be held and calibration is only for juniors year which the students will have with this sooo many workshops will be also provided laboratory and soo events on technical also will be held and calibration is only for juniors

Name: Shubhrajyoti Bhattacharjee
review: The placement opportunities are quite good. There is almost 80-90% placement in all the branches. The packages depend upon the branch and the company arriving for placement. Job opportunities open both for fixed jobs after graduation, and for paid internships before that. During placements we can get inernships in different companies and institutes. Our college mainly provides research internships, and the stipend depends upon the research topic and the professor you are working under. Many of them are only for training purposes and experience gaining.We have a vast Alumni network, and this helps many a times during any requirements in any company when you can directly call them and get your purpose done. And about seniors, it can be better than this. The senior-junior bonding becomes very strong right from the Freshers' when the first proper interaction takes place and after that for any need only a call away they remain at any time of the day. They are very much helpful and even if they can't they will give you contacts of those who can help.

Name: Shivam Sharma
review: Admission to NIT Hamirpur, a college that comes under MHRD is purely on the basis of JEE MAINS Paper-1 organised in month of January and April every year by National Test Agency (formely, it was organised by CBSE, Delhi in the month of April). After the result every student who appeared in test is provided with the rank. JoSSA is a central counselling portal for allocation of seats into IITs, NITs, IIITs and other GFTIs of the country. Choice filling is online and after that 7 rounds and 2 special rounds of counselling is organised. If you get seat at JoSSA, you will be admitted at college with further formalities.Course curriculum is designed under the guidance of experts from different parts of naton and faculty viewing the needs of society. Exam pattern includes 50 marks of end semester examinations, 30 marks of mid semester examinations and 20 internal marking. Different courses are given different credits and according to that CGPI is calculated.

Name: Manasi Bandhaokar
college: IIT Kharagpur - Indian Institute of Technology - [IITKGP]
review:
The co curriculuar activities in the college are as prominent as the academic ones. Various clubs , societies keep organizing different events for entertainment or learning purpose. You could be a part of one of these societies of they interest you and pursue your interest in the free time. The major fests and events are -
Spring fest - largest cultural fest in india Kshitij - largest techno management fest of Asia
NSSC - national students space challenge Megalith
Great step
And many more. All the departments have their individual fests. All the clubs and societies have thier individual events too. Thecampus is alive all the time. There are also cultural , technical and other competitions going on all round the year.
The exposure to any field of your choice would be great.Being one of the premier colleges of the country the placement and job opportunities are abundant. You can find opportunities in anyband every forleld you could think of. You coul pursue and achieve excellence in any field of your choice. You will always find like minded people and always be able to find professional opportunities in the field. The academic structure is substantially flexible so you could pursue a minor in some other discipline of your interest , pursue a micro specialisation or just take up electives and additiona subjects to learn about different subjects. There are workshops and guest lectures going throughout the year and you could take bemfit of those.there are variy clubs and societies to induce and help you pursuing what you like.

Name: Vasanth S
review: I am studying b.tech mechanical engineering it's my interest and passion too and this course plays a major role in mathematical talent and interest this course consists of problematic papers and in our college we have 8 semester and 2 internal exams for each semester and it consists of practical exams it's not much difficult to study this course.And negative of our college is there are less number of events are only conducted and it consists of symphosium and exhibition it consists of sports and projects and many competitions and it is based on the students of final year of various departments and the competition will be held in different departments of our college and various games.

Name: Chandan Kumar
review: Labs over here are very good. You will find labs of each and every thing related to your domain and they are well maintained. We have many center of excellence in our campus to provide trainings of different skills. Here you will learn concepts like robotics, industrial automation etc. They will train you for prestigious competition like smart india hackathon, india skills, world skill competition (this year one of our senior won gold medal in world skill in water technology and ceated history of getting first gold ever for india)The curriculum is well organised with ample time for theory(5 units in each subject in a semester) as well as practical. The course will be completed in time. You will be evaluated on the basis of three exams. The 1st one is an online exam of 30 marks comprising of 30 MCQs. The 2nd one is the mid semester exam of 60 marks and the last one is the semester exam of 100 matks. In labs you will be evaluated on the basis of your lab record, performace, involvement and viva.

college: Datta Meghe College of Engineering Airoli

Damn negative- to be precise

Only robots or peasants which think in only one way are appreciated here.

Name: Tirtha Ghosh
review:
There are many events celebrated in our college like:
1. Republic Day: it is celebrated in our college in a grand manner. Students and teachers actively take part in the celebration.
2. Holi: it is also celebrated our college with utmost fun and enthusiasm. Very student enjoy and has fun in playing holi. Even some teacher join to celebrate. 3. Winter fest: here, sports, singing, dancing and other activites are performed by students which are very enjoyable. 4. Tech fest: here, competitions are held that test your technology skills. Robot games are held. Quizzes are held. 5. Independence Day: this day too is also celebrated with very much joy. 6. Summer fest: here, students take part in games, art, sports, and other co curricular activities. Also a bollywood night is organised in which musical bands come and play.I got my admission in my college through West Bengal Joint Entrance Examination (WBJEE). I had to appear for a exam which had three subjects: Physics, Chemistry and Maths. The question paper was MCQ type. The paper's duration was 3 hours. Then I went through counseling which happens online. There I gave my choice of preference of colleges and according to that preference, I got my college. Then I had to book my seat by paying offline an amount of Rs. 5000/- to the North Bengal University. And then I had to go to my college and complete my admission process.

Name: Degavath Anand Nayak
review:
1) Aavartan : It is central Indian's largest Tech fest which will be celebrated annually in our college. It provides platform for students of different colleges of Central India to present their ideas and Projects.
This event will be organised by "Team Technocracy" 2) "ECLECTICA" : It is central India's largest cultural fest organised by the Cultural Committee of our college.
It includes dance, singing, drama competitions and much more.
3) Dandiya Night and Garba Night : These two events are organised by Team Nrityam, the dance club of our college in which I'm working as Coordinator.
The traditional dances will be performed on these events by the members of club and conducts workshops for the people of our college to learn dance for free
4) Shruti : it is the music fest of our college organised by Team Raaga of our college. It is celebrated annually.
5) Samar : Sports fest conducted annually by Team Shaurya of our college.
Students from different colleges of Central India participate in the competition in various sports.
5)E-SUMMIT : conducted by E-Cell of our college in which different speakers come and address the students and give suggestions for start up. Different Business models will also be exhibited and prizes will be given to the winners.Few labs are equipped with advanced technologies and in few labs the instruments will not be working properly.
The computers are very old and even does not have windows.
There is no proper space for sports ground and the college campus is very small. It is unextendible as it is located in the centre of the city.
Very less sports equipments and place for practice.
The college even does not have room for practicing dance for the students of dance club.

Name: Shubham Kumar
review:
I have applied for 4 year Btech course in year 2018.I came through All India Category. Merit list was generated based on jee mains score. I did the offline counselling in Maharashtra. As i was non-maharashtrian and my college being in Pune i had to come twice to the state for the counselling process, first for FC and then for ARC.There are mainly 4 ways to get admission in the college for pursuing Btech. First through mhcet score, the state common entrance exam, 2nd through jee mains score that is from All India category, note Maharashtrians can also apply through this category, then 3rd through diploma directly joining in 2nd year. And 4th option is through management quota.As i applied through all india quota, i had to provide my jee mains scorecard and other necessary documents. A merit list is generated based among the students applied for the engineering Maharashtra state counselling and accordingly seats are allocated based on the preferences a candidate had applied for. 
Placements are good. Especially for the circuit branches such as comp, IT, ENTC, etc. Recently the college claimed the placements of its 4 college students in Microsoft with a yearly package of 53.5 lakhs. A number of other reputed companies do visit the college. One check the complete list on the official website. It was made compulsory to do internships which college provides and if one does well in it he/she may land up getting job also in the same company. Stipends are also provided in some the internships. One can gain a very good experience of working in the corporate world by working in these internships and it make them ready for the placements.

Name: Teres George
review:
I wrote the JEE (Mains) entrance examination and got lucky actually, because there are like 4 different question paper and a single rank list. I was lucky because I received an easier question paper and secured AIR 7377 and got myself into the computer science branch of my home state NIT. It requires a lot of formalities which include going into the NITC website and registering in that(through Josaa) and then being present in the college itself for another round of formalities of getting documents such as our 10th and 13th std Board marks, birth certificate, and all such important documents and getting it all signed by the authorities respectively. It takes quite a while for this whole process to be over with and indeed, it was relief when it was all done. We have two main festivals in our college. Tathva - the technical fest and Ragam - the cultural fest. Tathva includes all kinds of workshops like robotics and all, and we've events including Wheels - a showcase of all amazing and varieties of cars and bikes, and all fun things to do related to the engineering phase. There are also DJ nights where we invite well known people like Amit Mishra, DJ Litchi etc. Ragam is more cultural and we all put in months of practice for this fest. It has more hype and it has been there for decades and hence, it is well known in South India. 
There are also other small events which occur in our college for specific people and it is very entertaining to be part of them or to be the people conducting them.

Name: Prakash Panigrahi
college: National Institute of Science and Technology - [NIST]
review: The course curriculum is quite tiring. Lots of classes and lots of subjects. There is one main semester exam, 2 internal classtests, 4 internal quiz tests and one surprise test. The main semester exam and the internal classtests are of 100 marks each but the quizzes are of 25 marks and surprise test depends on the teaching faculty. The placement and job opportunities are quite good in NIST. Every year nearly 60-70 companies come for a campus drive and successfully recruit more and 70 percent of the graduating batch. Yes my college provide internships during the summer. The stipend depends on what area the internship is about.

Name: Karan jaiswal
review: The placement are very good here. Almost everyone gets placed. Microsoft, Intel are the top recruiters coming to our college who provide a good package. Tcs and Infosys are the mass recruiters.I don't have any idea regarding the internship offers but I think You have to manage yourself as the college doesn't provides any internship opportunities There are many extra curricular activities organized by the college. Labs are good with good instruments. But they don't provide separate instruments for each student generally two students for one instrument. College has a football ground where you can play cricket as well

Name: Abhishek Chandra
review:
Course and Curriculum is decided by the Indraprastha University that we are affiliated to. It gives a good Curriculum that involves all round development. So, it is great to be a part of the institution for all round development. 
Exam pattern is like we have two main exams each semester each subject, First is called as sessional which carries 25 marks that has been divided into 15+10 as of 15 marks we have an 30 marks written test and score will added as half, and 10 marks will be based on internal performances like assignments, case studies etc.
75 marks are totally dependent on the written exam at the end of each semester organised by University.Firstly, I have taken IPUCET exam that is organised by our Indraprastha University in year 2018. I have secured a rank of 3270 among 50-60 thousand students. Then we have a 3 round counselling schedule that we have to pay for and submit some preferred college names in order to get the job done( Admission). So, I haven't got my preferred seat, so I waited for the spot round that is the final round, there I got the seat in Bharati Vidyapeeth's College Of Engineering Information Technology. Also there we have to pay some entrance fee for the spot round.

Name: Rahul Singh
review:
The course curriculum is not so different from other colleges regarding B.Tech.

Name: PRITISH GOYAL
college: Punjab Engineering College University of Technology - [PEC]
review: As i have said earlier sports meet takes place every year helping the students of our college to out perform in different sports. Different labs are also available for the research departments also workshops are available to give practical knowledge to the students.The institute has a very good and a proper course curriculum helpful for us in each and every field. Exams are divided into two parts mid-semster which take place when half of the semester is finished which comprises of half of the syllabus completed till then in that semester and end semesters which include all the syllabus covered in that semester. Along with this monthly quizzes are also held which also holds a weightage in the final totalling of marks.

Name: Vijayaraj R
review: The course curriculum is not at its best to be honest. It's not updated for years. Regarding the exams, two semesters are held per year. Each semester involves both internal and external marks. Internal marks are calculated by the marks we secure in Cumulative AAssesment Test (CAT) and daily assignments. CAT is conducted twice per semester. Final exams are held at the end of the semester. Grade is calculated as 50% CAT marks + 50% Final exam marks. And the GPA is given accordingly.Events are conducted regularly but not celebrated. Events conducted here are not very interesting. They conduct it for reputation's sake, in my opinion. College does not wish to spend more money on events. No celebration for Christmas and other festivals. Symposia are conducted by the departments in the College and interestingly the students spend money to conduct them. Concluding, no fat-events.

Name: Nitin Das
college: Institute of Engineering and Rural Technology - [IERT]
review:
Frankly I believe the curriculum is focused mainly on the theory part. The practical knowledge you will get is close to zero , unless you are a proactive student and really crave for that knowledge. You will get ample time here to prepare for GATE, CAT and other government examination. There are two semesters each year. In each semester there are two internal examination and one external examination at other college centre. You'll get UCER in Karchhana to give your end semester paper. Scoring here is very easy . Practical marks internal and external you'll get 90 % , and if you are active in class if you attend you can easily cross 85 -90 % in end semester with 2-3 days preparation.There are two main events that happens every year for B.tech section . Diploma have their own fests
1. UDBHAV - The cultural fest which happens late September . It's very fun and the auditorium is very large. You'll enjoy for sure. It's a three day 
Function.Freshers is combined into it. Lots of events like singing to dancing to fashion show happens.
2. TECHNOVATION- Happens mid April . It's very competitive and fun and engaging three day function with a surprise at the end . Lots of hub hub in the college . Robo war , coding competitions, quizzes and student of the year.
Beside these many sports event happens from time time . But you need to be active otherwise you'll miss them.

Name: Rohit Paul
review:
There are tons of extracurricular event going on every week through out the year. Just name the field you have interest in and there is a club organising an event for in that field. Every semester has 3-4 lab works included in the course. They arent anything great, just typical labs you get at your college. There are quite a few number of tornaments that take place in college. There are inter hostel, inter branch, intra branch olympic fashioned sport weeks. The most commonly played games are cricket, football, basketball, table tennis, lawn tennis, chess and badminton. Inter hostel video game competitions are also organised with rainbow seige, cs go, fifa, cod played most commonly.The course has been recently improved and is in quite with other nits though subjects like mechanical workshop, environmental science are not neccessary for computer science students in my opinion.
We write the mid sem exam which is of 30 marks, end sem exam which is of 50 mark and 20 marks are given by evaluating attendance, minors, quizes and assigments. All the marks are added up and we are given a grade in accordance to total scores out of hundred

Name: Kartik ladha
college: The LNM Institute of Information Technology - [LNMIIT]
review: College grants admission on the basis of JEE Mains marks and rank. You have to fill the application form and according and pay a provisional fee and after the counseling begins branch according to your marks will be given to you. On the further rounds of counseling you can have a upgrade in your branch if your JEE marks allows you. If you are satisfied with the branch you get you have to pay the rest of the fees or you can opt out of counseling and get refund of the provisional fee that you have paid.We have 3 big fests in our college usually in last days of January and first few days of February. Tech fest name is Plinth, sports fest is Desportivos ,which is also the largest sports fest in Rajasthan, and the main cultural fest is Vivacity. Apart from fests all festivals are celebrated with great enthusiasm in college and events like Torque, Quiz competition, MUN also happens in college.

Name: Archit
college: The LNM Institute of Information Technology - [LNMIIT]
review:

Once u are selected in the first round u will receive a message and mail for your selection it would ask u to pay 25000 Rs which would refundable upto a given date. review: Placements are not so good as compared to tier 1 colleges like IITs and NITs or Bits. Name: DASARI AKHIL
college: IIT Hyderabad - Indian Institute of Technology - [IITH]
review:
First I have appeared for jee main exam and then after qualifying for jee main I wrote jee advanced and based on my rank I got into this college.The admission process is called Josaa(joint seat allocation authority) counselling .There will be 7 rounds in josaa councelling. First we should register ourselves in josaa with jee main roll number and then we fill our choices (IIT's,NIT's,IIT's and other GFTI's),As per our choices and our jee advanced/jee main rank josaa allots us a college, if we like the course and college you can freeze it then you have to pay the registration fee online and you should go to any college given in josaa instruction for certificate verification and seat confirmation.Or if we don't like the course or college we can opt for slide which means we can participate in remaining josaa rounds and then the process is same. If we don't get a seat in all 7 rounds there will be a special round after all 7 rounds we can register for it.We should be very careful when entering options during josaa councelling,once we submit our choices we can't change them after some rounds.If we don't get a seat in first round we don't need to fill our choices again the same choices are used so be careful when filling options.And the opening and closing ranks of all IIT's,NIT's,IIT's and other GFTI's are available in josaa website we can use this when filling our choices 
Our academic system is called fractal academic system which very few colleges have.In this system every semester is divided into three segments.Each course has credits(1,1.5,2,3) and the runtime of the course depends on number of credits if it's a 1 credit course it runs for one segment or if it's a 2 or 3 credit course it runs for 2 or 3 segments.There will be no mid-semester and end-semester exams.
Exams are conducted after every segment.Classrooms are limited so Professor takes the exam based on the availability of classrooms it may be morning 7 or night 10.
Apart from that there will be some surprise quizzes or assignments or some small projects ,it depends on the professor.
Also there are some courses which are not related to our department but we should complete them for credits ,they are Liberal arts and creative arts.Liberal arts contains courses such as learning new languages like German,French, Japanese.These courses will focus on our society problems.But in creative arts courses there will be courses such as writing review after listening to a story or after watching a movie.These LA's and CA's are one or two credit courses.If we are interested in other department's course we can register for that course.We can do a double major here that is we can get two degrees by completing some courses in our interested department

And the biggest cultural and technical fest in Gujarat is SPARSH which consists of four days and three nights. Techincal, school events take place in days and in three nights- Singing night, Dancing night and celebrity night take place. Events never end. A sports fest also takes place which is IGNIS (colleges from every corner participate in this event).Every club of the college conducts events during the entire year. The first event of the college is conducted by HINDI CELL during September. events like WOW, SPANDAN, SYNCRONIZE, SYMPHONY, UNPLUGGED, SHAMIYANA happen which are cultural events (dance, music, art, poetry, drama etc.). Being an NIT certain admission process is to be followed for getting enrolled in this college. Firstly you have to give the entrance exam which is JEE MAINS. If you fulfill the criteria for selection then counselling process starts which is done by JOSAA. In this in the beginning preferences are to be filled since JEE MAINS makes it possible for admission in NITS, IIITs and GFTIs. review:
Biotechnology is a budding Course in india and it is developing at rapid pace. The exam structure is given by Vishweshwaraya Technological University (VTU) as my college and majority of the Eng. Colleges are affiliated to VTU. So they fix the exam structure. Basically, there is 1 monthly test, that makes up 3 monthly test/sem. Thet take the average marks scored and add it to the marks which you score in the Final exam conducted by VTU.
The final paper is for 100 marks and they reduce it to 60 so as to add the monthly test marks out of 30 and 10 marks for Assignments given. Thereafter, the CGPA and SGPA are calculated and results are released online in the official VTU website.I got in through management Quota. I just approached the college since it had 1st Rank From biotechnology in 2018. So i just called up and set an appointment. They walked me through the admission procedure and the Fee details. I got admission in the college by securing a decent rank in JEE(ADVANCED).

The seats in the institute are allocated on the basis of the ranks obtained by the candidates and on the basis of their choices filled. The better the rank is , the better the chances of getting your desired branch in your desired college. Once the candidate locks his/her choice in the portal. The college provides admission to them when they report at the institute. The course curriculum here at IIT Kharagpur is very flexible and extensive. Students can explore their interests and opt for courses of other branches as well. They can do a minor or opt for a micro of other branches subjects. The curriculum is according to the latest industry. 

The exams here are conducted mid semester and end semester. Those are subjective exams which evaluates the students knowledge of the subject. Apart from this some quizzes also play part in evaluation of the student. Lab exam are also taken.

Classes start from 9:15 and last till 17:15 generally. Apart from the core subjects like Microbiology, Plant science, animal science and many others which vary in each semester, subjects like Behavioural sciences, English and a foreign language are also taught. I find these subjects unnecessarily burdening us. Well, that's my personal opinion as many students love these as such subjects are scoring. 
Coming to the examinations, minors (class tests) are held during the semester (1 minor per subject) and the datesheet is decided by the class apart from the assignments(1 per subject).
End term examinations (Finals) are held at the end of each semester.Placements are average. Packages offered are of average 2.5-4 LPA. Major recruiters are Cryogene, Biocon and many other companies including many startups.
Just a piece of advice: Don't join Biotechnology (in any Pvt. Or Govt. College) if you are looking for a job with a high package just after graduating.
Internships are to be done by the students. LoRs are provided if you are a decent student. In the first two years, in house training is done and then you may join. However, if you have the knowledge, you can apply to various places. P.S.- I did an internship in a governmental institute in the field of ecology in my 1st year.

Name: Rajat Sablok
review: There is a 100% placement in VIT, Vellore. All sorts of companies visit college every year. This year 502 companies visited the campus. Name: Ankish Gupta
review: BTech exam structure is now more easier than the last year because students have to read only 3 subjects where as students have to read all 6 subjects in first semester. It is good to have two internal exams plus one pre university test before the semester exam. That will really boost up the Confidence of students for semester exams to give their best.I had heard about this college in a newspaper. I got to know that this college provide very good education and the placements after the B tech are quite high, in comparison to other colleges un the city.Although, I have taken direct admission in this college. I got a fee concession because of my acadamics marks and UPSEE rank.

Name: Firoj Mani Debbarma
college: North Eastern Regional Institute of Science and Technology - [NERIST]
review: A note on campus life for me is Full of freedom. Full of diversity because here we come from different states and different cultures. Yeah we do NCC or NSS as extracurricular activities and we even do have a robotics,debates in an event called Shristi which will organized by the final year students.Sports like football,cricket,volleyball,tennis,badminton,table tennis etc are there and students play.First of all, I have to give an entrance examination called NEE-1 which consist of 100 (M.C.Q)questions of three subjects Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics. Once I passed the entrance exam and I got selected then the institute calls us for the counseling in the college. After then we need do registration.

Name: Rushikesh Bharat Sonar
review:
The campus life is best hear you will never experience such clean and green campus any where other . The gender ratio would be 70:30 boys:girls .

Name: Abhishek sharma
review: Great placement like Wipro TCS amazon Paytm and etc. The college has a good placement cell and provides fine placement with an average package of 2.4 lacs and the highest package is 6 lacs and you can also apply for placement easily. The placement has a big indulge in the Indian army also.The fee structure is perfectly fine it is feasible and hence all the facilities are provided as described in which yearly books are included and other small charges and the fees include everything ni other charges are asked after the fee payment of 88500 + 10000(only once refundable)

Name: Ajay karle
college: KJ College of Engineering & Management Research - [KJCOEMR]
review: For open fees is allowed is 1lakh and for other caste like sc / St they have 15k fees and there they have scholarship for scholarship students which TFWS and it should be important thing to students to get there Education cheaper and student loan facilities is also available to get poor students to get help and complete to there EducationI have put this college at 32 in my preference list and I got detail information through my friends elder brother that kjes is good college although I was worry about did I will get admission but the cutoff and composite score was less and I easy got admitted and I like the staff that help me get and easier to admission  process

Name: Uday Bhaskar
review:
The process of getting into this college is only from REAP (JEE Main and also from Board's mark).
After registering to REAP,Merit List was out and based on your choice preferences and seats availability you be allotted your college.
the marks cutoff trends are like if you belong to rajasthan than yor marks should be around 40+ in Jee Main you will get this college(civil, mechanical branch).
If you doesn't belong to rajasthan then to get this college approx 850+ marks should be scored(electrical,CS,IT branch).
And of course for OBC,SC/ST,Ex-Army Reservation students: They should have 10+ marks in jee (rajasthan belonging)The campus life is quite good you will get so much of leisure time to study and do whatever you want.
College gives you a lot time to enhance your skills.
the gender ratio is quite less as like in engineering colleges.
In electrical its almost 8:1 (boys : girl).
College ground and fields are not well structured for sports but campus area is a lot there is a lot of free space provided..you can organise sports events and other activity.No one will bother you.

Name: Prajwal sureshrao nistane
review: The addimission process for this college was on the merit list. I was appeared for the CET exam and got 124 marks in CET.there was no other exam taken for the addimission.at first I did registration on the dtemaharashtra website and also filled form on that website. The college was then allotted to me.for the addimission only original leaving certificate was taken.and no after filling admission fees I was admitted to the college. The admission staff was helpful. Antiragging certificate was signed by me.The college is autonomous and as well as government. The college is included in top engineering colleges of Maharashtra and placements at this college for CS and it departments are really good. As I am From Wardha and the best engineering college that I could get from my marks was this college. this college is satisfactory but not that best. Students from other cities like Sangli Nanded also come to this college.

Name: Ayush verma
review: I have taken admission from management quota at first we met the admission authorities of the college ,they asked me about my performance in JEE MAINS,12th boards ,and UPSEE EXAM (Aktu) . once they find my result quiet satisfactory then they allow me to give a seat after a personal interview.after submitting a part of fee my seet is locked and i have started my course.there is one more method of admission in it which is the counsilling method by UPSEE after filling the councilling form online, the students get options of the college according to their rank in the exam conducted by UPSEE if their marks are beyond a certain level than they are selected for the college but before alloting seat in the college they have to pass a interview round .the interview was held with in the college and its main purpose is to check the conceptual knowledge as well as the thinking and reasoning ability.once a student has passed the interview ,he/she get the addmission in the college. Through out the admission the authorites and staff was really helpful and humble to everyone .The main reason behind selecting this college is that it is affiliated to AKTU (Abdul Kalam technical university) which is very reputed and good university and the reputation of the college is really good in this region and it is among the top 10 colleges in Uttar Pradesh which brings me to the conclusion to take admission in it. the admission was quite simple as my marks were satisfactory.

Name: Muhammed Basil P
review: The college treats everyone equally.the teachers the staff the management etc.The girl students and boy students are treated equally.Girls are given the amount of care and safety they require.The college always conducts annual sports meets and other cultural programs.Another notable achievement is that the UN Students assembly was held at our college it was an all India program.After keam ranklist was published i gave the college options on the internet.when the first allotment came I got allotted to a college.But I needed a better one.on the third allotment I got allotted to this college.the next day I came and took admission.filling up a form.After that I came on the day of opening and gave the required certificates and paid the merit fees.

Name: Mayank
review: Fees is affordable no need of loan. Fees is  affordable for middle class family. Name: Vatsav
college: Sathyabama Institute of Science and Technology
review: The course I have taken is CSE which I realized that the future is going to be that. Name: Sachin Yogesh
college: Faculty of Engineering and Technology, Jain University - [FET JU]
review: The course I chose is a very good one. I have chosen Bachelor of Technology in Aerospace Engineering. The Jain university is a deemed university. So they focus on practical education. There are many research initiatives going on in my college. They also give more importance to dull students or those who are weak in some of the subjects. I was a little weak in maths , my college offered special lecturing classes on math. As well as computers.They say that the placements are very good. Most of the companies come for placements. There was placement going on few weeks before. I got to know about this from my senior. I heard that companies like capgemini, infosys, etc come for placements. There is a special placement training cell in my college. This cell gives knowledge about the placement. They train us to be prepared for the placenta and interview.

Name: Rohan Pradhan
review: Yes, the college provides the internship for both the freshers and for experience also and during the process of the internship the college will provide the stipend and the stipend was so good.The course chosen by me is so good and the practical experience was so good and a line is of proper engineering purpose. the practical work done by me is very interesting.

Name: Vaibhav

review: Yes, college provide us scholarship which is under bihar govt. However this year it was only for SC students. This is a matter to think upon. But no research initiatives are taken until now. College should provide more materials in order to make us a good and liable engineer.

review: Ph.D. and it faculties teach here. they are good at interacting with students and clears doubts.. they provide information about internships in our country as we as foreign countries. Name: Ritik agarwal
review: Very experienced teachers. They are very interactive. The availability of teachers after the college duration is good. The teacher takes a lot of effort in making students understand each and every topic clearly. The preparation of the topic is good from the teacher's side. Teachers at ABES ES are very interactive as they motivate students to study and do well in exams .the teachers in ABES provide a good environment to study and regular event organizing makes students and teachers a healthy interaction.The placement of the student at ABES Engineering college starts at the beginning of the seven sem. The placement of the students is good as companies start to come at the starting of seven sem and remain till December. The percentage of students placed in ABES engineering college is quite high at nearly approx 80% placement.

review: It is affordable and around 1.75 lakh including hostel experts time it is total fees of B.Tech 1st year. PIET is the best college in this region so far. Infrastructure infrastructure. good. Nice greeny pollution free environment. Several industry experts from time to time came here for the expert lecture on latest industry trends. So far everything is good.

Name: Akash sharma
review: The college provides the scholarship for the one who has performed really well on 10+2 and on basis of that college provide a scholarship to the student and besides this, the one who has good grades can also avail the facility of a loan from banks.The fees are also not so expensive but it is about 450000 for 4 years BTech programme and scholarship is also available. For the students who have scored good percentages that are above 70, they are eligible for taking a scholarship or else no.

Name: Fathima
review: The course curriculum is good, but when it comes to practical and research work, i think this is not the right place for sure. there is a lack of interest in both the management and faculties to provide us with equipment, knowledge and experience in the practical field. elective options are the goof, fare enough, but the execution of the elective subjects failed.yes we were asked to do a 4 week internship during the summer holidays. no stipends were provided till now. the experience was not that good , due to the lack of practical knowledge.

Name: Deep
review: Teachers (faculty) are highly qualified and have good experience among their relative subject and the most important thing that they don't interact as faculty or we can say strictly. They always interact normally.I don't know much more about placement scenario.. But the percentage that student got placed is above 90. Companies are Hcl, tech Mahindra, Infosys, etc

Name: aniket adarsh
college: University Institute of Engineering and Technology -[UIET]
review: UIET follows the syllabus and curriculum of IITs. Syllabus of all 6 branches is quite refined. The course curriculum is excellent. Much focus is on Practical Learning. Yes there are research initiatives taken by the college. The syllabus doesn't even matter in college, frankly speaking. So its on how you take things, what's your ultimate goal and the type of guidance you are seeking and not the syllabus that matters.Yes the college do provide an internship here for 6 months in 3rd year.Actually I am an 1st year studenet and haven't experienced but after discussing from seniors that it was just helpful in getting practical knowledge and a lot to learn.The average stipend here is around 20,000 INR.

Name: Thomas thushar george
review: Events will be conducted in the college the main events are Oxytech, ethnic day, innovate me, etc also department vice fests will be there. The college will contribute to that.  The staff will be highly supportive.The placements at Oxford college are not so good. Only a few students get placed through campus selection. Major companies include  Wipro, Bosch, Tech Mahindra, TVS, etc. I don't know much about their packages.

Name: Ajmal Khan
college: Atal Bihari Vajpayee Indian Institute of Information Technology and Management - [ABVIIITM]
review: This is one of those courses which have a great demand in the market, so many students opt for this course as they know this will give then good campus placement. The college is also well known for this course. The practical knowledge given is average but I think this is going to get better in 2-3 years. No research related works for newcomers and also no electives are being provided for freshers.The placement record here is pretty good comparing to other colleges, but not the best among all. Companies that visit us are Infosys, Paytm, Smartprix, Amazon and the average package offered is around 7-9 LPA and also almost 75% gets placed as per the records.

Name: Saransh Ambarte
review:
MIT is known for conducting the best events in the country. Every year Mit conducts the National Robocon competition in which many colleges from all over india take part. The sports event 'SUMMIT' is also a famous national sports event. There are many other teams like accelaracers , piranha racing , pro-karters , skytrooper and also the famous cultural team known as Aarohan. Overall , one can find a team for any interest and hobby here.

Name: Vipul singh
college: SRM Institute of Science and Technology - [SRMIST]
review:
SRM entrance exams.
I had the choice of Manipal and other colleges too in the north, but srm was my first choice because it gives is various opportunity in different fields and also help is in our overall development. They are no.1 research institution in India and provide quality education. 
It's very easy to get in entrance just clear the entrance exam and you will be divided according to your rank and called for your campus selection on a particular day. Do required formalities as summiting all original documents of 12th and 10th. And after small verification, you are in.The course curriculum of SRM Is really very fine. They have different departments of different domains where you need to show your knowing skills and give some selective questions answer and you department HOD will recommend you into research sector if you are able to cross some different test. You have different ways to get selected, be a member of a reputated club and then try to improve your skills and have some innovative ideas and this will surely help you to the same.

Name: SUMAN HEMBRAM
college: Indian Institute of Engineering Science and Technology - [IIEST] Shibpur
review: The campus is clean and well observed. The debates, gender, politics are not a matter at all. The teachers of workshop are very helpful and teach carefully. The students are far away from politics and other external matter. In this institution the birthday party held at hostel. For other matter money collection process is held and all are happy by the processes.A counselling process was held before admission. The authority checked results, mark sheets, various certificates etc. Also they verified wait, vision, medical report, cast and other details .This admission process has a payment of rupees from bank .The payment of admission is merely 20000. The academic records of this institution is very good  and well.

Name: AKASH KUMAR
review: The course structure is awesome.Here the entire 4 year course is divided in 8 semesters.The 1st and 2nd semesters include subjects of all branches,which helps us to be familiar with the courses of other branches too.Then from 3rd semester onwards our branch splits up in different specialisations like-structural engineering, geo technical, environmental ,offshore,etc.Our faculties are wonderful. In our college each subject is taught very nicely and our faculties of some important subjects like graphics and mechanics are experienced and teaches us beautifully . I just love the way our faculty teach us.Our teacher is highly qualified also,our maths teacher is from IIT MADRAS,and many others are from iits or nits,etc.

Name: G Manohar
review: There is good placements and job opportunities in my college but there is only software based companies are came for placements but  i am not interested in software side so i took forward and prepared for m.tech admission in  iit's.4 years of course 1 year - basics of mechanical engineering, 2 year - eng.,  drawing, electrical labs.3 year - mechanical core subjects like thermal ,  automobile ,  production ,  design ,  industrial etc.
